safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (بشّر) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction; (عملوا) a verb and its fāʿil; (الصالحات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the kasra, since it is a sound feminine plural; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
(جنات) the noun of anna, postponed, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra.
The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by an omitted bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (بشّر) «[Note: This is the doctrine of al-Khalīl.. or it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi according to the doctrine of Sībawayh, but the first is more consistent with analogy.]» .
(تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري) «[Note: In it a muḍāf is omitted, i.e.: the rivers flow from beneath its trees.]» and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative. (كلما) adverbial, conditional, non-jussivizing «[Note: See another way of parsing it at verse (20).]» . (رزقوا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (من) a preposition and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by (من), attached to (رزقوا) ; (من ثمرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رزقا» «[Note: Or it is a badal (substitute) from the preceding genitive (منها), a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl), so it is attached to what the substituted-for word is attached to.]» - a naʿt (adjective) that has been placed before the word it qualifies - (رزقا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (قالوا) a verb and its fāʿil; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar, and it involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "like that which we were provided".. (رزقنا) a past verb in the passive, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil - the second object is omitted, i.e. "we were provided it" (رزقناه) - (من) a preposition; (قبل) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive by (من), attached to (رزقنا) . (الواو) parenthetical or circumstantial; (أتوا) a past verb in the passive, and (الواو) nāʾib fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أتوا) ; (متشابها) a ḥāl, accusative, from the hāʾ in (به) . (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (في) a preposition, (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar; (أزواج) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (مطهّرة) a naʿt of (أزواج), nominative like it. (الواو) conjunction; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (فيها) attached to (خالدون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «بشّر ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive; it is not valid to conjoin it to the clause «اتّقوا» in the previous verse.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «تجري ... » is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (جنّات) .
The clause «رزقوا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi «[Note: The utterance made up of the conditional particle, its protasis and its apodosis is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «آمنوا», i.e. "being provided for perpetually"; it may also be a ḥāl of «جنّات» - since it has been qualified - and in the clause there is a pronoun referring back to it.]» The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «هذا الذي ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «رزقنا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «أتوا ... » has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, or circumstantial with «قد» implied.
The clause «لهم فيها أزواج» has no grammatical position, being cut off as resumptive «[Note: Or it is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «تجري», and likewise the clause «هم فيها خالدون».]» .
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (لهم), the governing word (ʿāmil) in it being the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār).

* Morphology:
(الصالحات) , plural of صالحة, the feminine of الصالح, an active participle of the triliteral صلح, its pattern فاعل.
(جنّات) , plural of جنّة, a primitive (jāmid) noun taken from the verb جنّ meaning "to cover"; it was so called because it is a covered place, or a covering one, owing to the abundance of trees; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(الأنهار) , plural of نهر, a primitive noun, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, or with two fatḥas.
(أتوا) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is أتيوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so the yāʾ was made quiescent and the ḍamma transferred to the tāʾ; then, when two quiescent letters met, the yāʾ was deleted; its pattern is فعوا.
(متشابها) , active participle of the five-letter verb تشابه; it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last.
(أزواج) , plural of زوج, a word used for the man and the woman, each of them being the زوج of the other; in the verse women are meant. زوج has the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مطهّرة) , its masculine is مطهّر; it is a passive participle of the four-letter verb طهّر, and is on the pattern of its passive imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma.
(خالدون) , plural of خالد, active participle of خلد يخلد, of the class of نصر, its pattern فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Synecdochic metaphor (al-majāz al-mursal): in the words of Allah the Exalted تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ, the relation being locality (maḥalliyya); this is if النهر means the channel of the water; but if it means the water in the channel, then there is no figure in it.
2- The eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh): in the words of Allah the Exalted هذَا الَّذِي رُزِقْنا مِنْ قَبْلُ, i.e. this is like that which we were provided before, i.e. before this, in this world; but since the resemblance between them was so firm, He made the one's very self the other's self. The particle of comparison has been omitted from it, and for that reason it is called "eloquent" (balīgh).

* Benefits:
In His words: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ.
- The dropping of the preposition is regular before the maṣdar-forming «أن» and the emphatic «أنّ» with fatḥa on the hamza: «وَبَشِّرِ ... أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ». Likewise the preposition may be omitted on the basis of attested usage (samāʿan), so that the genitive noun becomes accusative and is parsed as accusative by the dropping of the preposition - in the expression of the early grammarians «على نزع الخافض» (accusative by removal of the preposition) - as in the words of Jarīr: تمرّون الديار ولم تعوجوا ... (You pass by the abodes and do not turn aside ...); «الديار» has been made accusative after the dropping of the preposition.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (لا) negative; (يستحيي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يضرب) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil being "he"; (مثلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (ما) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: He strikes as a likeness some thing among things; or it is an adjective of (مثلا) or a badal (substitute), and (بعوضة) is a badal from (ما) .]» , (بعوضة) a badal, an adjective or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of (مثلا), accusative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to «بعوضة» «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of accusative, conjoined to «بعوضة».]» , (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb is in the position of genitive by an omitted (من), attached to (يستحيي) , i.e.: He is not ashamed of striking a likeness.
(الفاء) resumptive; (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); (الذين) a mubtadaʾ (subject) in the position of nominative; (آمنوا) a verb and its fāʿil; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (أنّ) as before, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna; (الحقّ) the khabar (predicate) of anna, nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الحقّ», and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction; (أمّا الذين كفروا فيقولون) is parsed like its counterpart.. (ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (ذا) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar «[Note: It is permissible to parse (ماذا) as a single word: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of the verb «أراد», the implied form being: what thing did Allah intend.]» - i.e.: "so what is it that" - (أراد) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أراد) ; (مثلا) a tamyīz (specification) of the demonstrative, accusative, or a ḥāl, i.e. "being given as a likeness". (يضلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يضلّ) . (كثيرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (يهدي به كثيرا) is parsed like its preceding counterpart. (الواو) resumptive or circumstantial; (ما) negative; (يضلّ) like the first, and likewise (به) ; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الفاسقين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله لا يستحيي ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يستحيي ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «يعلمون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) «[Note: In this expression the apodosis of (أمّا) must be joined with the fāʾ.. The fāʾ may enter the khabar of a mubtadaʾ, because His words: أما الذين آمنوا فيعلمون ... are originally: "whatever be the case, then those who believe know".. So when (أمّا) was substituted for (مهما) and its verb, the connecting fāʾ was moved to the khabar, in effect. And so in every expression where the mubtadaʾ comes after (أمّا), the fāʾ is joined to the khabar.]» .
The clause «الذين كفروا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the second resumptive clause.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «يقولون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (الذين) «[Note: See remark no. (2) on the previous page.]» The clause «ماذا ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أراد الله ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ذا) .
The clause «يضلّ به كثيرا» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (مثلا) «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty; or have no grammatical position, being resumptive to explain what preceded - this is the view of Abū Ḥayyān, who rejected its being a naʿt so that it would not be part of the words of the disbelievers.]» .
The clause «يهدي به ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «يضلّ».
The clause «ما يضلّ به ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive, or is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(بعوضة) , a primitive (jāmid) singular noun for the well-known insect; its plural is بعوض; its pattern is فعولة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(فوق) a noun, an adverb of place, the opposite of تحت; it may be used for time: أقام في المدينة فوق شهر (he stayed in the city more than a month). It indicates excess: هذا فوق ذاك (this is above that). Its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الحقّ) , maṣdar (verbal noun) of حقّ يحقّ, of the classes of نصر and ضرب.. its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أراد) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is أرود with fatḥa on the wāw, its pattern أفعل, because its bare past is راد يرود meaning "to seek"; the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the rāʾ before it, then the wāw was converted into alif because what preceded it had fatḥa and it was originally vowelled, so it became أراد.
(يضل) , in it the hamza which is in the past أضل has been deleted; its origin is يؤضلل, and the deletion took the same course as in يؤمن, يقيم and ينفق.
(كثيرا) , an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from كثر يكثر, of the class of كرم, its pattern فعيل.
(الفاسقين) , plural of الفاسق, an active participle of فسق يفسق of the class of نصر, its pattern فاعل.. or of the class of ضرب, a dialect reported by al-Akhfash.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representation (al-tamthīl): in this noble verse a likeness is struck for this world and its people; for the gnat lives as long as it is hungry, and when it is sated it dies; likewise the people of this world, when they become filled with it, perish. This points to the excellence of the representation in the verse.

* Benefits:
- أمّا comes in three cases: for condition, for detailing and for emphasis.
We find condition and detailing occurring in the noble verse: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ...
وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا.. As for condition and emphasis, it is in the words of our master ʿAlī: أمّا بعد فإن الجهاد باب من أبواب الجنة (To proceed: jihad is one of the gates of Paradise). This is one of the features of oratory and a practice followed among pulpit preachers, and in traditional letters.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (الفاسقين) «[Note: It may be in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is «هم», and the clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive.]» . (ينقضون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (عهد) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينقضون) . (ميثاق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction; (يقطعون) like «ينقضون»; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of accusative, and the clause «أمر الله..» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما) .]» , (أمر) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أمر) . (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يوصل) an imperfect verb, accusative, passive, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), referring to (ما) .
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "and the verb" is meant.]» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of (ما) , i.e.:
they cut the joining of what Allah commanded; or a badal of the hāʾ in (به), i.e. they cut what Allah commanded to be joined.
The clause «ينقضون ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «يقطعون ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أمر الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
(الواو) conjunction; (يفسدون) like «ينقضون»; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يفسدون) - (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address. (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is «الخاسرون», and the clause «هم الخاسرون» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك».]» «الخاسرون» the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولاء», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «يفسدون ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ينقضون».
The clause «أولئك هم الخاسرون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(عهد) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb عهد يعهد, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(بعد) a noun, an adverb of time, the opposite of قبل; it is bound to annexation (iḍāfa); if it is cut off from it, it is indeclinable on the ḍamma, or accusative with nunation; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ميثاق) , a mīmī maṣdar, irregular, from وثق يثق, of the sixth class; its pattern is مفعال with kasra on the mīm. In the word there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is موثاق; the wāw came quiescent after a kasra, so it was converted into yāʾ and it became (ميثاق) .
(الخاسرون) , plural of الخاسر, an active participle of the triliteral خسر, on the pattern فاعل.
(يفسدون) , in it the hamza is deleted; its origin is يؤفسدون, because its past is أفسد ...

* Rhetoric:
1- The implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in the words of Allah the Exalted: الَّذِينَ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ.
النقض (untwisting) is used for annulling the covenant inasmuch as a rope is borrowed for it, because of the binding in it of the words of one of the two covenanting parties to the other.
2- Counterpoint (al-muqābala): it is the multiplication of antithesis (ṭibāq) in speech; He has set in antithesis يضل and يهدي, and يقطعون and يوصل.

* Benefits:
1- كيف: one of the indeclinable nouns; it is indeclinable on the fatḥa, and is mostly interrogative. It has four i'rab states: it comes as a khabar, as it comes as a second object of the verbs «ظن وأخواتها» (ẓanna and its sisters).
It comes as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of what follows it, and it comes as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), as in «أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحابِ الْفِيلِ ...

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(كيف) an interrogative noun expressing wonder (taʿajjub), indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in (تكفرون) , and it is the governing word (ʿāmil); an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the head «(تكفرون)» appears to have dropped out before "an imperfect verb".]»; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تكفرون) , (الواو) circumstantial; (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna; (أمواتا) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أحيا) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (ثمّ) a conjunction in all three places; (يميت) an imperfect verb, nominative; (كم) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he"; (يحييكم) like «يميتكم» ... (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ترجعون), which is an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and (الواو) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «تكفرون بالله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كنتم أمواتا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with «قد» implied.
The clause «أحياكم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «كنتم أمواتا».
The clause «يميتكم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «أحياكم».
The clause «يحييكم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «يميتكم».
The clause «ترجعون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «يحييكم».

* Morphology:
(كيف) a vague (mubham) noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; it may come as an interrogative and may come as a conditional; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, then indeclinability on the fatḥa.
(أحياكم) , the alif in (أحيا) is written tall even if no accusative pronoun or other is attached to it, because the alif is preceded by a yāʾ; were it not for the yāʾ it would be written short, in the form of an undotted yāʾ, because it is the fourth letter.
(أمواتا) , plural of ميّت, whose pattern is فيعل; in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is ميوت, because its alif is a wāw, its maṣdar being الموت. When the wāw and the yāʾ came together and the first was quiescent, the wāw was converted into yāʾ and assimilated with the first yāʾ, so it became (ميّت) ; its plural is أموات, its pattern أفعال.

safi-cedvel:29-29.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); (خلق) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلق) , (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, i.e. "gathered together"; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (استوى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (إلى السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استوى) by its being made to include the meaning of «عمد» or «قصد» (to direct oneself, to intend). (الفاء) conjunction; (سوّى) like «استوى», and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and (النون) a particle of the feminine plural, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he". (سبع) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (سموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction or circumstantial; (هو) a pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم) , (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عليم) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «استوى ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «سوّاهن ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «استوى».
The clause «هو.. عليم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause; it may also be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, the governing words (ʿāmil) in it being the preceding verbs.

* Morphology:
(جميعا) a noun meaning "the group" and the opposite of dispersal; its pattern is فعيل, and it may be used as an adjective.
(استوى) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is استوي - with a yāʾ with fatḥa at its end - the yāʾ was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa, so it was converted into alif, and the alif was written in the form of yāʾ because it is a five-letter word.
(سوّاهنّ) , in it there is an iʿlāl like that of «استوى».
(عليم) , a derived adjective, an intensive form (mubālagha) of the active participle of the transitive علم, and of it is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:62-62.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), for emphasis. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the ism of inna. (آمنوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو): conjunction. (الذين): a relative noun, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first noun, in the position of accusative. (هادوا): like آمنوا. (والنصارى والصابئين): two nouns conjoined by the two conjunctions to the first relative noun, both accusative (manṣūb); the sign of the accusative in the first is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the sign of the accusative of the second is the yāʾ.
(من): a relative noun in the position of accusative, a badal (substitute) from the preceding nouns [Note: It may be in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), being either a conditional noun or a relative noun, its khabar (predicate) being the clause لهم أجرهم.. and the nominal clause is the khabar of inna.], (آمن): a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمن), (اليوم): conjoined by the wāw to the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الآخر): a naʿt (adjective) of (اليوم), genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (عمل): like آمن. (صالحا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الفاء): redundant (zāʾida). (اللام): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (أجر): a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم): attached, muḍāf ilayhi. (عند): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أجر. (ربّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم): attached, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negating, inoperative (muhmala) [Note: Or it operates as laysa does, (خوف) being its ism and (عليهم) its khabar.. See verse (38) of this sūra.] (خوف): mubtadaʾ, nominative. (على): a preposition, and (هم): attached, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): redundant, to reinforce the negation. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (يحزنون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الواو): an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause «هادوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «آمن ... » has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «لهم أجرهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم أجرهم.
The clause «لا هم يحزنون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم أجرهم.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (هم).

* Morphology:
(هادوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion (qalb), since the alif is converted from a wāw, because it is from هاد يهود, meaning "to repent". Some said its origin is a yāʾ, from هاد يهيد, meaning "to move".
(النصارى): plural of نصرانيّ, a nisba (relative adjective) to نصران or ناصرة.. and it is one of the irregular (shādhdh) nisbas in the language.
(الصابئين): plural of الصابئ, an active participle from the triliteral صبأ, its pattern being فاعل.
(صالحا): an active participle from the triliteral صلح, its pattern being فاعل.
(أجر): originally the maṣdar (verbal noun) of أجره الله يأجره, of the paradigms نصر and ضرب; it may be used to express the very thing with which one is rewarded, and the noble verse admits both meanings. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:63-63.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكروا". (أخذ): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا): a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (ميثاق): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (رفعنا): like أخذنا. (فوق): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رفعنا), and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi. (الطور): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (خذوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (آتينا): like أخذنا, and (كم): mafʿūl bihi; the second object is omitted, i.e. آتيناكموه. (بقوّة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of آتيناكم, i.e. "possessed of strength". (الواو): conjunction. (اذكروا): like خذوا. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (في): a preposition, and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (لعلّ): a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, the ism of laʿalla. (تتّقون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «أخذنا ... » is in the position of genitive, by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «رفعنا..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «خذوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an omitted saying [Note: The clause may be the answer to an oath, because taking the covenant is an oath.], and the implied clause is in the position of a ḥāl.
The clause «آتيناكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative.
The clause «اذكروا ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «لعلّكم تتقون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تتّقون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الطور): a general noun applied to every mountain, or a specific one applied to a particular mountain; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(خذوا): the hamza has been dropped from its beginning for lightening; its pattern is علوا, with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(قوّة): a samāʿī (heard, non-standard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb قوي يقوى, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn. Its ʿayn and lām have been assimilated after conversion. Its origin is قوية: the wāw and the yāʾ came together, the first of them having sukūn, so the wāw was converted to yāʾ, giving قيّة with ḍamma on the qāf; and because the first yāʾ came with sukūn preceded by a ḍamma, it was converted to wāw, and the yāʾ with sukūn was made to follow it to match the doubling, giving قوّة.

safi-cedvel:64-64.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ): conjunction. (تولّيتم): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and its fāʿil (agent). [Translator's note: the source sentence stops here; the fāʿil is evidently the attached pronoun (تم).] (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تولّيتم), (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address.
(الفاء): resumptive. (لولا): a particle of impossibility due to existence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd), a non-jussive conditional. (فضل): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the khabar (predicate) is necessarily omitted, its implied form being "موجود". (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (على): a preposition, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فضل), (الواو): conjunction. (رحمة): conjoined to فضل, nominative like it, and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام): occurring in the answer of lawlā. (كنتم): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم): an attached pronoun, the ism of kāna. (من الخاسرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of كنتم, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause تولّيتم is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أخذنا in the previous verse.
The clause «لولا فضل الله ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كنتم من الخاسرين» has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(فضل): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فضل يفضل, paradigm كرم; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(رحمة): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb رحم يرحم, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (علمتم): a verb and its fāʿil (agent); it requires a single object because it means "to know (recognise)". (الذين): a relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (اعتدوا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the dropped alif.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من): a preposition, and (كم): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of اعتدوا. (في السبت): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اعتدوا); it involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "on the day of the Sabbath". (الفاء): conjunction. (قلنا): a verb and its fāʿil. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قلنا), (كونوا): a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the ism of kāna. (قردة): the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative. (خاسئين): a naʿt (adjective) of (قردة), accusative like it [Note: It may be a ḥāl of the ism of kāna, or a second khabar of (كونوا).].
The clause «علمتم..» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «اعتدوا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قلنا ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause علمتم.
The clause «كونوا قردة» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

* Morphology:
(اعتدوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is اعتداوا: two sukūns met, the alif and the wāw, so the alif was deleted. Its pattern is افتعوا.
(السبت): originally the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb سبت يسبت, of the paradigms نصر and ضرب, meaning "to rest" or "to cut off"; then the day was named سبت [Note: Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal ʿalā al-Jalālayn.. and the root سبت is found in Lisān al-ʿArab.]. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn; when one says يوم السبت, it has been used as a maṣdar.
(قردة): plural of قرد, the name of the well-known animal; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn, and the pattern of قردة is فعلة, with kasra, then fatḥa, then fatḥa.
(خاسئين): plural of خاسئ, an active participle from خسئ يخسأ, paradigm فرح; it is intransitive, meaning "to be distant and driven off"; and خسأ يخسأ الكلب, i.e. "he drove the dog away", is of the paradigm فتح, and this paradigm may also occur as intransitive. The pattern of خاسئ is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (جعلنا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (ها): a pronoun in the position of accusative, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), referring to the punishment. (نكالا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نكالا), (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (يدي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, since it is a dual, and (ها): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a relative, conjoined to the first. (خلف): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما, and (ها): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (موعظة): conjoined by the wāw to (نكالا), accusative like it. (للمتّقين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (موعظة).
The clause «جعلناها ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(نكالا): a noun for that with which you make an example of another, i.e. punish him; or a noun for what is made a lesson for others or a deterrent to them. Its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(بين): a noun meaning "middle", an adverb of place; the maṣdarī-temporal particle ما may enter it: بينما, or the alif may enter it in compensation for ما: بينا.
(يديها): dual of يد; it involves the deletion of the lām. Its origin is يدو, because the wāw returns in the nisba: يدوي. See verse (79) of this sūra.
(موعظة): a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun with mīm) from وعظ يعظ, paradigm ضرب; its pattern is مفعلة, with kasra on the ʿayn, and the tāʾ is for intensiveness.

safi-cedvel:98-98.t:
* I'rab:
(من كان عدوّا لله): the i'rab of its counterpart was given in the previous verse. (وملائكته ورسله وجبريل وميكال): genitive (majrūr) nouns, maʿṭūf (conjoined) by conjunctions to the Name of Majesty. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (عدو): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (للكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عدوّ) «[Note: Or attached to (عدوّ).]».
The clause «من كان عدوّا»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كان عدوّا»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «إن الله عدوّ ...»: in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(ميكال): a foreign noun; what is said about it is like what is said about جبريل «[Note: In verse (97).]»: that it is derived from the dominion (ملكوت) of Allah, or that ميك means "servant" and ايل is one of the names of Allah, and that its composition is a genitive-construct composition ... etc. There are seven dialectal forms of it, the most eloquent being ميكال on the pattern مفعال, which is the dialect of the Hijaz; or with a hamza after the alif without a yāʾ after it, or with a yāʾ after it ... etc.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
Disjointed letters (ḥurūf muqaṭṭaʿa) with no grammatical position. This relies on the soundest, easiest and least far-fetched of the opinions [Note: from other ways of parsing these letters, which we have passed over because they are closer to complication and artificiality.].

* Rhetoric:
- These letters at the beginnings of the surahs are of the ambiguous (al-mutashābih) whose knowledge Allah has kept to Himself; they are the secret of the Qur'an, and the benefit of mentioning them is to demand faith in them.
Calling them "letters" is figurative; rather, they are names whose referents are the letters spelled out.

* Benefits:
- This sūra is among the first of the surahs revealed after the Hijra. What is meant is not its revelation in full, but rather the revelation of its beginning, since what counts in the chronological order of the revelation of the surahs is the revelation of their beginnings.
- The sūra opens by establishing the components of faith that come in the saying of the Exalted (from verse 1 to 5): «الم ذلِكَ الْكِتابُ لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدىً لِلْمُتَّقِينَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْناهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَما أُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ. أُولئِكَ عَلى هُدىً مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ».
- There are numerous opinions about what is meant by these letters that come at the beginnings of the surahs.
We mention, by way of example, the opinion that the occurrence of these letters is a kind of inimitability (iʿjāz) carrying within it a sort of musical cadence that harmonises with the music of the verses of the whole sūra. We add to that the possibility that Allah is reminding us by these letters of the alphabet, from which words are formed, and these in turn carry to us the message of the Qur'an and the message of the letter and the word, by which man has been distinguished from the rest of Allah's creatures among the animals. Al-Zamakhsharī said: the letters at the beginnings of the surahs are fourteen letters, half the letters of the alphabet, and they comprise the classes of the kinds of letters, such as the voiceless (al-mahmūsa), the voiced (al-majhūra), etc. So glory be to Him whose wisdom is so precise.

safi-cedvel:99-99.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (اللام): the lām of oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath. (قد): a particle of realization. (أنزلنا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (الى): a preposition, and (الكاف) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلنا). (آيات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (بيّنات): naʿt (adjective) of آيات, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negative. (يكفر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (الباء): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكفر). (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الفاسقون): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «أنزلنا»: has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «ما يكفر بها إلا الفاسقون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزلنا.

* Benefits:
1- إلا: it may be a particle of exception and it may be a particle of restriction. For it to be a particle of restriction, the condition is that the verb be negated and that the exception construction be "emptied" (mufarragh), meaning that the thing from which the exception is made (al-mustathnā minhu) is omitted. Both conditions are met in this verse, and therefore we are entitled to state that it is a particle of restriction.
As for its being a particle of exception, it has conditions and cases that may be consulted in the books of grammar.

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (الكتاب) badal (substitute) of (ذا), or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), following it in the nominative [Note: It may be a khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذا), and the clause لا ريب فيه.. a ḥāl (circumstantial).]. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (ريب) the noun of لا, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive by (في), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of لا. (هدى) a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذا), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its appearance being prevented by impossibility [Note: It may be a ḥāl from the pronoun in (فيه), i.e. "there is no doubt in it, as a guide"; and what governs it is the meaning of the demonstrative.]. (للمتقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدى), or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of it; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
The clause «ذلك الكتاب..» has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «لا ريب فيه..» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذا).

* Morphology:
(ذا) a demonstrative noun; the alif is part of the root of the noun, and some of its letters have been deleted, because its diminutive is ذيّا. So its pattern is فع, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its alif is converted from a yāʾ — as Ibn Yaʿīsh says. They said: its origin is ذيّ, on the measure of حيّ; then the lām (third radical) of the word was deleted, leaving ذي with a vowelless yāʾ; then the yāʾ was converted to alif so that it would not resemble particles such as كي and أي.
(الكتاب) a primitive (jāmid) noun indicating the Noble Qur'an; the word is originally taken from the maṣdar (verbal noun) الكتابة.
(ريب) maṣdar of راب يريب, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(هدى) a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb (هدى), of the class of ضرب. The word contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is هدي with a yāʾ at its end, because you say هديت. The yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to alif; thus the change was made in the maṣdar as it was made in the verb.
(المتقين) active participle, its singular being المتّقى, from the five-letter verb اتّقى, on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last.
In (المتقين) there is iʿlāl by deletion: the first yāʾ was deleted after pluralisation because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; its pattern is مفتعين. In (المتقين) there is also ibdāl (substitution) — as in its verb: in the verb (اتّقى), whose bare form is (وقى), the fāʾ (first radical) of the word — which is the wāw — was converted to tāʾ because it came before the tāʾ of iftiʿāl. This is regular for both wāw and yāʾ when they come before the tāʾ of iftiʿāl: they are converted to tāʾ in the verbs and their derivatives. And the ibdāl that took place in the verb took place in the active participle (المتقين).

* Rhetoric:
1- Fronting (al-taqdīm): (الريب) was put before the preposition and its genitive noun because it is more worthy of mention, and He, Glorified and Exalted is He, did not say (لا فيه ريب) in the manner of «لا فِيها غَوْلٌ», because fronting the preposition and its genitive noun would suggest what is far from the intended meaning, namely that another book contains doubt; just as what is intended in that verse is to prefer the wine of Paradise over the wines of this world in that it does not seize the minds as they seize them, so there is not in it the defect that is in others.
2- The maṣdar «هدى» is put in the place of the derived adjective, which is هاد (guiding), and that goes deeper in expressing its perpetuity and continuity.
3- If you say: how did He say «هُدىً لِلْمُتَّقِينَ», when there is in it the obtaining of what is already obtained, since the God-fearing are already guided?
I say: they became God-fearing only by benefiting from the guidance of the Book; or what is meant by guidance is steadfastness and perseverance in it. Or He intended both groups but confined Himself to the God-fearing because they are the ones who win the benefits of the Book, and for concision, as in the saying of the Exalted سَرابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ, i.e. "and the cold", where the second was omitted for concision.

* Benefits:
- An orthographic benefit: many words in the Noble Qur'an have kept their spelling as they were written from the days of ʿUthmān, such as: «الكتب، الصلوة، رزقهم، الحيوة», whereas they have changed in school writing. We know that Abū al-Aswad al-Duʾalī began laying down the vowel signs, and al-Ḥajjāj ibn Yūsuf al-Thaqafī dotted the letters of the alphabet, but we do not know from history when the development of Arabic writing took place by which it came to differ from the writing and spelling of words in the Muṣḥaf.
- The three-letter noun with a weak final letter and the three-letter verb with a weak final letter, such as «هدى وغزا»: if the origin of the alif is yāʾ, it is written with yāʾ, and if it is wāw, it is written as alif. This leads us to the necessity of knowing the origin of the weak letter, whether wāw or yāʾ. There are three means of knowing this:
The first: that we turn the verb into its imperfect. The second: that we attach its past to the tāʾ of the agent. The third: that we return it to its maṣdar. For example: رمى يرمي رميت رميا and غزا يغزو غزوت غزوا.

safi-cedvel:100-100.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī). (الواو): conjunction. (كلّما): a temporal (ḥīniyya) conditional adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis «[Note: It may also be parsed as follows: (كل) an adverb, (ما) a maṣdar particle which, with the verb after it, is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.]». (عاهدوا): past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (عهدا): a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), by عاهدوا being made to include the meaning of أعطوا ("they gave"); the first object is omitted, i.e., «they made a covenant with Allah, a covenant» «[Note: (عهدا) may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar).]». (نبذ): past verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object. (فريق): fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (من): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريق). (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and of beginning. (أكثر): mubtadaʾ (subject), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (لا): negative. (يؤمنون): imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) the fāʿil.
The clause «عاهدوا»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نبذه فريق»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أكثرهم» لا يؤمنون: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤمنون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أكثرهم).

* Morphology:
(عهدا): a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb عاهد, because the regular maṣdar is معاهدة; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 27).
(أكثر): a derived adjective on the pattern أفعل; most likely it is stripped of the elative (tafḍīl) meaning, so it means كثير ("many").

* Benefits:
أو كلما: كلما is one of the non-jussive conditional particles. It is in the position of accusative as a temporal adverb. As for the hamza, it is for the interrogative of disapproval, and it was placed before the verb and the wāw,
because interrogative particles take the front position (ṣadāra).
Three of the conjunctions come after it, namely «الواو, الفاء and ثم».

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of (المتقين) [Note: It may be in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هم; or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause أولئك على هدى.]. (يؤمنون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is the retention of the nūn, as it is one of the five verbs; (الواو) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
(بالغيب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون) [Note: This attachment goes back to the meaning of الغيب as a maṣdar (verbal noun) intended as a description, i.e. "in what is absent from them", such as Paradise, Hell or the Resurrection.. etc. It may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of يؤمنون, i.e. "while being in a state of absence".]. (الواو) a conjunction. (يقيمون) like يؤمنون. (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) a conjunction. (من) a preposition. (ما) relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by (من), attached to (ينفقون) [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun described (mawṣūfa) in the position of the genitive, and the clause after it its naʿt.]. (رزقنا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nominative pronoun (نا), which is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (الهاء) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and (الميم) is a particle indicating the masculine plural.
(ينفقون) like يؤمنون.
The clause «يؤمنون بالغيب..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «يقيمون الصلاة..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «رزقناهم..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ينفقون..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يؤمنون بالغيب.

* Morphology:
(يؤمنون) contains the deletion of a hamza for lightening; its origin is يؤأمنون, and its past is آمن. The madda is made up of two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second vowelless, i.e. أأمن on the pattern أفعل. In the imperfect one of the two hamzas is deleted because three hamzas would come together in the first person singular, and that is heavy in pronunciation; then the deletion remained in the third and second persons, so it was said يؤمنون, on the measure يفعلون with ḍamma on the yāʾ. This deletion is regular in such verbs and in their derivatives: the active participles and the passive participles.
(الغيب) maṣdar of غاب يغيب, of the class of ضرب. It is in the sense of الغائب (the absent), i.e. they believe in what is absent from them; and it may be in the sense of the object, i.e. المغيّب (what is hidden). Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(يقيمون) the deletion of the hamza for lightening has taken place in it as in يؤمنون, because its past is أقام, on the pattern أفعل.. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by converting the ʿayn (second radical) of the word, the wāw, to yāʾ. Its origin is يقومون with kasra on the wāw; the kasra was felt heavy on the wāw, so it was made vowelless — this is iʿlāl by taskīn — and its vowel was transferred to the qāf. When the wāw became vowelless and what preceded it had kasra, it was converted to yāʾ, so it was said يقيمون; its pattern is يفعلون with ḍamma on the yāʾ.
(الصلاة) a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the four-letter verb صلّى, or it is its maṣdar. The alif in الصلاة is converted from a wāw, because its plural is صلوات; its origin is صلوة: the wāw came vowelled with a fatḥa before it, so it was converted to alif. The maṣdar has been used here as nouns other than maṣdars are used, because it indicates specific words and actions.
(ينفقون) its past is أنفق on the pattern أفعل, so there is a deletion of the hamza as happened in يؤمنون.

* Rhetoric:
1- Repetition (al-takrār): in the saying of the Exalted يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ and يُؤْمِنُونَ بِما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ, and in the repetition of the relative noun (الذين) even though the one described is the same; and the one described may be different, in which case it is a repetition of the word without the meaning. Its benefit is fixing in the mind and affecting the emotions.
- «وَمِمَّا رَزَقْناهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ»: He attributed the provision to Himself to make known that they spend from the absolutely lawful, which deserves to be ascribed to Allah and to be called provision from Him. He brought in the partitive «من» to protect them and to restrain them from the extravagance and squandering that are forbidden.
He put the object before the verb to indicate that it is more important, as if He said: and they single out part of the lawful wealth for giving in charity.

* Benefits:
1- الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ «al-Baqara, verse 3»: faith in the unseen was, and still is, the first distinction between man and animal, contrary to the materialists of every age who believe only in what is subject to the senses.

safi-cedvel:101-101.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لمّا): an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna), including the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis نبذ. (جاء): past verb. (وهم): an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (رسول): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (من عند): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (رسول). (الله): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (مصدّق): a second naʿt of (رسول), nominative like it. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (مصدّق) «[Note: Or the lām is the redundant lām of strengthening (taqwiya), and (ما) is the direct object of (مصدّق), since it is an active participle.]». (مع): an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (نبذ): past verb. (فريق): fāʿil, nominative. (من): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of (فريق). (أوتوا): past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الكتاب): direct object, accusative, its governor being أوتوا. (كتاب): direct object, accusative, its governor being نبذ. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (وراء): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (نبذ). (ظهور): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (كأنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for comparison, and (هم) the noun of كأن. (لا): negative. (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاءهم رسول»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نبذ فريق»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أوتوا الكتاب»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كأنهم لا يعلمون»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of فريق «[Note: The indefinite noun here has been specified by the description.]». The clause «لا يعلمون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of كأنّ.

* Morphology:
(أوتوا): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion. Its origin is أوتيوا; the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so it was transferred to the tāʾ and the yāʾ was made quiescent (iʿlāl by quiescence), then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, while quiescent, the wāw of the plural. It also contains a lightening of the second hamza, turning it into a wāw; its origin is أؤتوا. Its pattern is أفعوا.
(ظهور): plural of ظهر, a noun for the well-known body part ("back"); it is non-derived (jāmid), its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn. The pattern of ظهور is فعول with two ḍammas.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ كِتابَ اللَّهِ وَراءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ.
Not turning towards the Book of Allah, not caring about it and not following it is likened to one who has thrown something behind his back, so he does not turn to it and pays it no heed. Nabdh in its literal sense is casting a thing away; here it is used for not following, so that it appears in a tangible image that falls before the sight and whose seeing is vividly represented.

safi-cedvel:102-102.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اتّبعوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma,
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the referring pronoun being omitted. (تتلو): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw. (الشياطين): fāʿil, nominative. (على ملك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تتلو), by its being made to include the meaning of تتقوّل ("fabricate"). (سليمان): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote. (الواو): parenthetical. (ما): negative. (كفر): past verb. (سليمان): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (لكنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk). (الشياطين): the noun of لكنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (كفروا): like اتّبعوا. (يعلّمون): imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الناس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (السحر): a second direct object, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السحر. (أنزل): past verb, passive; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على الملكين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, as it is a dual. (ببابل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملكين «[Note: Attaching it to (أنزل) is valid.]», the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is barred from nunation on account of being a proper name and foreign. (هاروت): badal (substitute) of الملكين, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and foreign. (ماروت): maʿṭūf by the wāw to هاروت, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote.
The clause «اتّبعوا..»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the whole of the conditional clause and its apodosis in the previous verse (لمّا جاءهم رسول.. نبذ فريق..).
The clause «تتلو الشياطين»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ما كفر سليمان»: has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
The clause «لكنّ الشياطين كفروا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the parenthetical clause.
The clause «كفروا»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ.
The clause «يعلّمون الناس»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of اتّبعوا «[Note: It may be considered resumptive with no grammatical position; this is if the pronoun in (يعلّمون) refers back to those who followed what the devils recited. But if it refers back to the devils, the clause may be a ḥāl of the fāʿil of كفروا, or in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (لكنّ), or in the position of nominative as a badal of the clause كفروا.]».
The clause «أنزل ...»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
(الواو): resumptive. (ما): negative. (يعلّمان): imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (أحد): genitive in form, accusative in position, direct object. (حتّى): a particle of limit and of the genitive. (يقولا): imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after حتّى, the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن يقولا) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (يعلّمان).
(إنّما): the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa). (نحن): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (فتنة): khabar, nominative. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition. (لا): prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تكفر): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الفاء): resumptive. (يتعلّمون): like يعلّمون. (من): a preposition, and (هما) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يتعلّمون). (ما): a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun that is described, and the clause is its naʿt (adjective).]» in the position of accusative as direct object. (يفرّقون): like يعلّمون. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يفرّقون). (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يفرّقون). (المرء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (زوج): maʿṭūf by the wāw to المرء, genitive like it, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): parenthetical or circumstantial. (ما): the Hijazi negative ما, which operates like ليس. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of ما. (الباء): a redundant preposition. (ضارّين): a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (به): like the previous one, attached to an omitted ḥāl of أحد, i.e., «any one falling under it». (من): a redundant preposition. (أحد): genitive in form, accusative in position, direct object of the active participle ضارّين. (الا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (بإذن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the hāʾ in به, i.e., «coupled with the permission of Allah», or of the pronoun in ضارّين, or of أحد «[Note: The ḥāl may validly come from an indefinite noun here because it rests on a negation.]». (الله): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «يعلّمان»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّما نحن فتنة»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا تكفر»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e., «if we are such, then do not disbelieve».
The clause «يتعلّمون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يعلّمان.
The clause «يفرّقون»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun.
The clause «ما هم بضارّين»: has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
(الواو): conjunction. (يتعلّمون): like the previous one. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object. (يضرّ): imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (هم) an attached pronoun, direct object. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative. (ينفع): imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (هم) direct object. (الواو): conjunction. (اللام): the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realization. (علموا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and its fāʿil. (اللام): the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), which suspended (ʿallaqat) علم from operating. (من): a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (اشترى): past verb, and the hāʾ is the direct object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): negative, non-operative (muhmala). (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (في الآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of خلاق (a naʿt placed before the noun it describes) «[Note: Or attached to the omitted khabar.]». (من): a redundant preposition. (خلاق): genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يتعلّمون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause يتعلمون,
or it is resumptive.
The clause «يضرّهم»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما), or it is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما) taken as a described indefinite noun.
The clause «لا ينفعهم»: conjoined to the clause يضرّهم and takes its i'rab.
The clause «علموا»: has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «من اشتراه»: stands in place of the two objects of علموا.
The clause «اشتراه»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun.
The clause «ما له» في الآخرة من خلاق: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
(الواو): conjunction. (اللام): the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (بئس): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; the fāʿil is a necessarily latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): an indefinite noun in the position of accusative as tamyīz (specification) of the latent pronoun «[Note: (ما) may be definite, the fāʿil of بئس, with the clause after it as its ṣila; or it may be a maṣdar particle, with the interpreted maṣdar as the fāʿil of بئس, and the thing specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "disbelief" or "sorcery".]». (شروا): a verb and its fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شروا), by its being made to include the meaning of استبدلوا ("they exchanged"). (أنفس): direct object, accusative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle. (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the noun of كان. (يعلمون): like يعلّمون.
The clause بئس ما شروا ...: has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath; the oath and its answer are conjoined to the first oath.
The clause «شروا ...»: in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما).
The clause «كانوا يعلمون»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يعلمون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا. The apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being: «they would not have done that of learning sorcery and harming people», or «they would not have sold themselves».

* Morphology:
(ملك): a noun for what a person owns and disposes of; it may also be a maṣdar of the verb ملك يملك, of the pattern-class ضرب. Its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(سليمان): it is said to be a foreign proper name, which is the reason it is a diptote; and it is said that the alif and nūn in it are augmentative, and its origin is سليم, the diminutive of سلم with fatḥa then sukūn.
(السحر): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb سحر يسحر, of the pattern-class فتح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(ببابل): a foreign proper name.. It is said that it was so named because of the confusion (tabalbul) of the tongues of the creatures.
(هاروت وماروت): two foreign proper names, Syriac, and that is not correct. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase "and that is not correct" is unclear in reference.]»
(أحد): a derived adjective, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas; the hamza is changed from a wāw, its origin being وحد. Its feminine is احدى, and it only occurs together with another.
(فتنة): maṣdar of فتن يفتن, of the pattern-class ضرب; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn.
(المرء): the mīm may take any of the three vowels; a noun meaning "a human being". Its plural is رجال, not from its own root letters, and مرءون is also attested. Its feminine is مرأة and مرة. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ضارّين): plural of ضارّ, the active participle of the triliteral ضرّ; its pattern is فاعل, and its second radical has been assimilated into its third.
(خلاق): a noun for the good that a person obtains; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the first radical.
(شروا): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion: its third radical, a weak letter, was deleted because it came quiescent before the wāw of the plural. Its pattern is فعوا, with fatḥa on the second radical.

* Benefits:
هاروت وماروت: the names of two angels from among the angels of heaven..
Curious stories have been woven around these two angels, most of them weakly authenticated.
Many hadiths on the subject of these two angels have been attributed to the Messenger ﷺ, some of them weak and most of them fabricated. Ibn Kathīr cited in his tafsir some of these narrations, which do not go beyond being legends; he declared some of them weak and rejected others. Ibn Kathīr comments on the narrations reported about their story with his words:
«Their upshot, in their details, goes back to the reports of the Children of Israel, since there is among them no authentic marfūʿ hadith with a connected chain going back to the truthful, the believed, the infallible one who does not speak from desire.»
Whoever wishes more, let him consult the tafsir of Ibn Kathīr, volume one, from p. 135 to p. 148, for in it there is a long discussion of sorcery and sorcerers and the opinion of the jurists and hadith scholars about them..

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(وإذ قال موسى لقومه): its i'rab has preceded [Note: In verse (54) of this sūra.]. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), for emphasis. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the ism of inna, accusative. (يأمر): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الكاف): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (الميم): a particle for the masculine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (أن): a maṣdarī and subjunctive particle. (تذبحوا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بقرة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أن) and the verb is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمركم) [Note: It may be accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi governed by يأمركم, i.e. "He commands you the slaughter of a cow".], i.e. يأمركم بذبح بقرة.
(قالوا): a verb and its fāʿil. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disavowal (istifhām inkārī). (تتّخذ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", and (نا): a pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (هزوا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (قال): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (أعوذ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعوذ), (أن): a subjunctive particle. (أكون): a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (من الجاهلين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of أكون, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أكون..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (أعوذ), i.e. من أن أكون من الجاهلين.
The clause «قال موسى ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «إنّ الله يأمركم» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «يأمركم..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أتتّخذنا هزوا» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أعوذ بالله» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(بقرة): a primitive (jāmid) noun for a single one of البقر (cattle); its pattern is فعلة, with three fatḥas — it may apply to male and female. This genus was called بقر because it splits (يبقر) the earth, i.e. cleaves it by ploughing; and from it comes بقر بطنه ("he slit his belly open").
(هزوا): lightened from هزؤا, which is a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb هزأ يهزأ, paradigm فتح, and هزئ يهزأ, paradigm فرح.. In the verse it is used in the sense of "the one mocked". (الجاهلين): plural of الجاهل, an active participle from جهل يجهل, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (ادع): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (اللام): a preposition, and (نا): an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ادع), (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (الكاف): muḍāf ilayhi. (يبيّن): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (لنا): like the first, attached to (يبيّن), (ما): an interrogative noun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (هي): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate). (قال): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء): a pronoun, the ism of inna. (يقول): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (إنّها): like إنّه. (بقرة): the khabar of إنّها, nominative. (لا): negating, inoperative (muhmala). (فارض): a naʿt (adjective) of (بقرة), nominative like it [Note: It may be made the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being لا هي فارض ... and likewise (لا بكر).], (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negating, obligatory. (بكر): conjoined to فارض, nominative like it, (عوان): a second naʿt of (بقرة), nominative. (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (عوان), (ذا): a demonstrative in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (الفاء): connecting the answer of an implied condition. (افعلوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (تؤمرون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو): an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no [grammatical] position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ادع» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «يبيّن» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما هي» is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb يبيّن [Note: The verb has been suspended (ʿulliqa) by the interrogative (ما).. It is possible that the object is omitted, so the clause is an explanatory resumption with no grammatical position.].
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّه يقول» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يقول ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «إنها بقرة» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «افعلوا ... » is in the position of jussive as the answer to an implied condition, i.e. "if you know that, then do".
The clause «تؤمرون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(فارض): an active participle from فرض سنّه, i.e. "its tooth cut it" [Translator's note: literally "he/it cut it"; the sense is reaching full age], its pattern being فاعل, of the paradigms ضرب and كرم.
(بكر): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from بكر يبكر, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn. It is used for masculine and feminine; its plural is أبكار.
(عوان): in al-Miṣbāḥ: العوان is the one of middle age among women and beasts; the plural is عون, with ḍamma on the ʿayn and sukūn on the wāw; originally with ḍamma on the wāw, but it was given sukūn for lightening. It is a ṣifa mushabbaha, and the pattern of عوان is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
