safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا ادع ... يقول إنّها بقرة): the i'rab of its counterpart has preceded in the previous verse, word by word and clause by clause.. (صفراء): a naʿt (adjective) of (بقرة), nominative like it. (فاقع): a second naʿt of (بقرة), nominative like it [Note: It may be a fronted khabar (predicate), with (لونها) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).. and the clause is a naʿt of (بقرة).], (لون): fāʿil (agent) of the active participle فاقع, nominative. (ها): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (تسرّ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (الناظرين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause تسرّ الناظرين is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of (بقرة).

* Morphology:
(لون): a noun for the state of a thing in its appearance and form, in respect of its whiteness and blackness; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(صفراء): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective), the feminine of أصفر; the hamza is added for the feminine; its pattern is فعلاء.
(فاقع): an active participle from فقع يفقع, paradigms نصر and فتح; its pattern is فاعل.
(الناظرين): plural of الناظر, which is an active participle from نظر ينظر, paradigm نصر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا ادع لنا ربّك يبيّن لنا ما هي): its i'rab has passed [Note: See verse (68), word by word and clause by clause.], (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). (البقر): the ism of inna, accusative. (تشابه): a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على): a preposition, and (نا): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تشابه), (الواو): conjunction. (إنّ): like the first, and (نا): the ism of inna. (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (شاء): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (اللام): the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis. (مهتدون): the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «إن البقر تشابه» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya) or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تشابه علينا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (إنّ).
The clause «إنّا ... لمهتدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the causal clause, or resumptive.
The clause «إن شاء الله» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then our guidance is attained".

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab:
(قال إنّه يقول إنّها بقرة): its i'rab has passed [Note: See verse (68).]. (لا): negating. (ذلول): a naʿt (adjective) of (بقرة), nominative like it [Note: Or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هي".. and the clause is a naʿt of (بقرة).], (تثير): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (الأرض): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negating. (تسقي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (الحرث): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (مسلّمة): a naʿt of (بقرة), nominative like it. (لا): the lā of generic negation. (شية): the ism of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative. (في): a preposition, and (ها): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of lā. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الآن): an adverb of time, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative, attached to (جئت), which is a verb and its fāʿil. (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جئت), and the bāʾ is for transitivity (taʿdiya) [Note: The preposition-phrase may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ of جئت, i.e. "you have come clothed with the truth".].
(الفاء): conjunction. (ذبحوا): like قالوا, and (ها): mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (ما): negating. (كادوا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the ism of kāda. (يفعلون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّه يقول» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «يقول ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «إنّها بقرة» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of the verb يقول.
The clause «تثير الأرض» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of (بقرة), falling under the scope of the negation before it, i.e. "not docile and not ploughing the earth".
The clause «لا تسقي الحرث» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause تثير الأرض.
The clause «لا شية فيها» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of (بقرة).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جئت بالحقّ» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ذبحوها» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "they searched for it, found it, and slaughtered it".
The clause «ما كادوا يفعلون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.. i.e. "they slaughtered it in a state of accusative [Translator's note: so in the source, «في حال نصب»; the word نصب appears to be a slip] of the negation of their coming close to the act of slaughter", the time of the negation having preceded the time of the slaughter.
The clause «يفعلون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kādū.

* Morphology:
(ذلول): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from the verb ذلّ يذل, paradigm ضرب; its pattern is فعول, with fatḥa on the fāʾ. It is one of the adjectives in which masculine and feminine are the same.
(الحرث): a primitive (jāmid) noun for land or what is sown; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its verb is of the paradigm نصر. The word is also a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb.
(مسلّمة): feminine of مسلّم, a passive participle from the quadriliteral سلّم, in the sense of "sound"; its pattern is on the pattern of its passive imperfect, by dropping the imperfect prefix and replacing it with a mīm with ḍamma.
(شية): originally the maṣdar of the verb وشي, of the paradigm وعد, [said] when one mixes one colour with another; what is meant here is the colour itself. The word contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its fāʾ was deleted, as happened in عدة; its pattern is علة.
(الآن): the alif and lām in it are redundant and inseparable; it is an adverb of time, permanently indeclinable.
(جئت): it contains iʿlāl by deletion to suit the indeclinable form: its ʿayn was deleted because it came with sukūn after its lām, which is indeclinable on the sukūn, so the ʿayn was deleted for the meeting of two sukūns. Its pattern is فلت, with kasra on the fāʾ, to indicate the kind of weak letter deleted, which is the yāʾ.
(كاد): it contains iʿlāl by conversion; its origin is كود with kasra on the wāw: the wāw came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to an alif, becoming كاد. Its alif is converted from a wāw, because its maṣdar is كود, on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its fāʾ only takes kasra when it is attributed to a nominative pronoun, because of the kasra vowel of its ʿayn, so it is of the paradigm فرح.

* Rhetoric:
1- In these preceding verses there is the art of repetition (takrīr), which falls under the heading of prolixity (iṭnāb).
2- His saying, the Exalted, وَما كادُوا is an embodied picture of the natures of the Jews and their resort to obstinacy and stubborn arrogance, for they carried out the slaughter after long obstinacy.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «قالوا» that comes later «[Note: Or it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb whose implied form is "remember when your Lord said ..." (اذكر).]» «[Translator's note: the source has «قول ربّك»; the implied verb is presumably «اذكر».]» , (قال) a past verb; (ربّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (الكاف) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (للملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال) . (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الياء) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as its noun; (جاعل) khabar (predicate), nominative; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاعل) . (خليفة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «جاعل», accusative. (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (تجعل) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (في) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تجعل) . (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يفسد) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (فيها) like the first, attached to (يفسد) . (الواو) conjunction; (يسفك) like «يفسد»; (الدماء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) circumstantial; (نحن) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (نسبّح) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن); (بحمد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «نسبّح», i.e.: "encompassed by Your praise", and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (نقدّس) like «نسبّح»; (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نقدّس) . (قال) like the first; (إنّي) its i'rab has preceded; (أعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, "he" «[Translator's note: from here to «(سوّاهنّ) ، فيه إعلال مثل استوى» below, the source repeats, evidently by a copying error, the i'rab, clause analysis and morphology of verse 29; it is translated here as written. The analysis of verse 30 resumes after it with «and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "I"».]» (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (خلق) , (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; (جميعا) a ḥāl, accusative, i.e. "gathered together"; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (استوى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (إلى السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استوى) by its being made to include the meaning of «عمد» or «قصد». (الفاء) conjunction; (سوّى) like «استوى», and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and (النون) a particle of the feminine plural, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he". (سبع) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (سموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction or circumstantial; (هو) a pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم) , (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عليم) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «استوى ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «سوّاهن ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «استوى».
The clause «هو.. عليم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause; it may also be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, the governing words in it being the preceding verbs.

* Morphology:
(جميعا) a noun meaning "the group" and the opposite of dispersal; its pattern is فعيل, and it may be used as an adjective.
(استوى) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is استوي - with a yāʾ with fatḥa at its end - the yāʾ was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa, so it was converted into alif, and the alif was written in the form of yāʾ because it is a five-letter word.
(سوّاهنّ) , in it there is an iʿlāl like that of «استوى».
and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "I" (أنا); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]» (لا) negative; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال ربّك ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of «إذ» to it.
The clause «إنّي جاعل ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تجعل فيها ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «يفسد فيها» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من) .
The clause «يسفك الدماء» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «نحن نسبّح ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «نسبّح ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «نحن».
The clause «نقدّس ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «نسبّح».
The second clause «قال» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إني أعلم ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «أعلم ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «تعلمون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .

* Morphology:
(إذ) an adverb of past time, after which only a clause comes; the clause may be omitted and compensated for by nunation; it may be for surprise (mufājaʾa): بينما أنا جالس إذ جاء زيد (while I was sitting, suddenly Zayd came).
(ملائكة) , it was said: plural of مألك, on the pattern مفعل, derived from الألوكة, which is "the message"; so the hamza is the fāʾ of the word, then it was moved back and placed after the lām, and they said ملأك, so its pattern became معفل, and the plural is ملائكة on the pattern معافلة. It was also said: the root of the word is لأك, so the ʿayn of the word is a hamza, and the origin of ملك is ملأك without transposition; the vowel of the hamza was thrown onto the lām and the hamza deleted; when the noun was made plural the hamza was restored, so its pattern now is مفاعلة. Some said: the ʿayn of the word is a wāw, and it is from لاك يلوك, "he turned (أدار) - wanted (أراد) - the thing about in his mouth" «[Translator's note: so in the source, «أدار أراد»; one of the two words is likely a slip.]», as though the bearer of the message turns the message about in his mouth; so the origin of ملك would be ملاك, like معاذ, then its ʿayn was deleted for lightness, so the origin of ملائكة would be ملاوكة, like مقاولة, and the wāw was replaced by hamza, as the wāw of مصائب was replaced. Others said: ملك is like «من الملك» «[Translator's note: so in the source; a pattern word such as «فعل» seems intended before «من».]», from الملك, which is strength, so the mīm is radical and there is no deletion in it, but it was given the plural on the pattern فعائلة irregularly «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī, from the book (Imlāʾ mā manna bihi al-Raḥmān min wujūh al-iʿrāb wa-l-qirāʾāt fī jamīʿ al-Qurʾān).]» .
(جاعل) , active participle of the triliteral جعل, its pattern فاعل.
(خليفة) , فعيلة in the sense of فاعل, the tāʾ being added for intensiveness; so it is an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha).
(الدماء) , plural of دم, whose lām (final radical) is omitted; its origin is دمي with a yāʾ at its end, because the dual is دميان «[Note: As stated in al-Qāmūs al-Muḥīṭ.]» . In the word (الدماء) the yāʾ is converted into hamza because it is final after a quiescent alif; its origin is الدماي.
(حمد) , an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb حمد يحمد, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Interrogation: the one occurring in the words of Allah the Exalted أَتَجْعَلُ departs from its original meaning, outside what it was coined for.
It is a seeking to uncover the hidden wisdom and what would remove the doubt; it is not a question about the making (of a vicegerent) itself and the appointment as successor, because they had known of it beforehand. What is asked about is the making, but not with regard to itself, rather with regard to its wisdom and what removes the doubt about it; or it is wonder that one who would cause corruption in the earth should be made successor to cultivate the earth and set it right.

* Benefits:
1- إذ is an adverb for past time, and a clause comes after it. In its i'rab there are five views:
a- an adverb..
b- mafʿūl bihi..
c- a badal (substitute) of a mafʿūl bihi..
d- muḍāf ilayhi, provided that the muḍāf is a noun of time.
e- It occurs after بينا and بينما, and then it is for surprise: «فبينما العسر إذ دارت معاسير (While there was hardship, suddenly ease came round).

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (علّم) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), i.e. Allah; (آدم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الأسماء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كلّ) a tawkīd (emphasis) of meaning (maʿnawī), accusative, and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (عرض) like «علّم», and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (على الملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عرضهم) ; (الفاء) conjunction; (قال) like «علّم»; (أنبئوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (النون) for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) mafʿūl bihi; (بأسماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنبئوني) . (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (أولاء) a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (تم) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna. (صادقين) the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «علّم ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: It may be conjoined by the wāw to the clause: «قال ربك للملائكة ...», so that it would be in the position of genitive.]» .
The clause «عرضهم ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «علّم».
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «عرضهم».
The clause «أنبئوني ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: if you are truthful, then inform Me of their names.

* Morphology:
(آدم) , a proper noun; the madda in it is converted from two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second quiescent, on the pattern أفعل; it is derived from أديم الأرض (the surface of the earth) or from الأدمة (tawny colour).
(الأسماء) , plural of اسم ... see the basmala of Sūrat al-Fātiḥa.

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «نسبّح» (we glorify); (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (علم) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (إلا) a particle of exception; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) of the position of the pronoun in the khabar of lā.]» (علّمت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (نا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) the noun of inna; (أنت) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is «العليم», and the clause is the khabar of inna.]» with no grammatical position; (العليم) the khabar of inna, nominative; (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحان» has no grammatical position, being a parenthetical supplication.
The clause «لا علم لنا ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «علّمتنا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما) .
The clause «إنّك أنت العليم» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما علّمتنا) is in the position of nominative as a badal of the position of the pronoun concealed in the khabar of lā, which is «كائن» or «موجود» (existing).

* Morphology:
(سبحانك) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb سبح يسبح, of the class of فتح, its pattern فعلان with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(علم) , an aural maṣdar of the verb علم يعلم, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with kasra on the fāʾ.
(الحكيم) , an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حكم يحكم, of the class of نصر, its pattern فعيل.

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (ياء) a vocative particle «[Translator's note: so in the source, «ياء», for «يا».]»; (آدم) the one addressed, a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (أنبئ) an imperative verb, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (بأسماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنبئ), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) resumptive; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when" (حين) that includes the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis «قال»; (أنبأ) a past verb, and (هم) mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil "he"; (بأسمائهم) like the first, attached to (أنبأ) . (قال) like the first; (الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion (qalb, of the imperfect to past meaning) and jussive; (أقل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "I" (أنا); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أقل) . (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الياء) the noun of inna; (أعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil "I"; (غيب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined to «السموات», genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (أعلم) like the first; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle.. and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.]» «[Translator's note: the note has «المصدر المسئول» ("the asked maṣdar"), evidently a slip for «المؤوّل» (interpreted).]» , (تبدون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a relative, conjoined to the first «ما» «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.]» (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; (تم) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna; (تكتمون) like «تبدون».
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «of the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أنبئهم ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative, and it is a kind of resumption.
The clause «أنبأهم ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The second clause «قال» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «لم أقل» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported of the verb «قال».
The clause «إنّي أعلم ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported of the verb «أقل».
The clause «أعلم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The second clause «أعلم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first clause «أعلم».
The clause «تبدون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
The clause «كنتم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما), and the clause «تكتمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».

* Morphology:
(أقل) in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is (أقول) , its pattern أفل.
(تبدون) , in it there is an iʿlāl by quiescence and an iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is تبديون; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so the yāʾ was made quiescent and the ḍamma transferred to the dāl - this is iʿlāl by quiescence - then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, quiescent, with the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is تفعون. In the verb the hamza is deleted for lightness, as it was deleted from يؤمنون and يقيمون (see verse 3).

* Rhetoric:
- Counterpoint (al-muqābala): where He has set in antithesis السموات and الأرض, and تبدون and تكتمون.
Antithesis (al-ṭibāq) is among the expressions whose terms contrast in content; therefore some called it «التضاد» (contrariety) and «التكافؤ» (equivalence); it is the combining of two contrary meanings.

safi-cedvel:134-134.t:
* I'rab:
(تي): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn upon the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) denotes distance and (الكاف) denotes address. (أمّة): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (قد): a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). (خلت): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa upon the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns; (التاء) marks the feminine, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (اللام): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar. (ما): a relative noun in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "جزاء ما كسبت" «1». (كسبت): a past verb; (التاء) marks the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; the referent pronoun is omitted, i.e. "كسبته". (الواو): conjunction. (لكم): like (لها), attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (ما): like the first one «2». (كسبتم): a verb and its fāʿil; the referent pronoun is omitted, i.e. "كسبتموه". (الواو): resumptive. (لا): negative. (تسألون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (عن): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (تسألون) «[Note: (ما) may also be a maṣdar-forming particle or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.]». (كانوا): a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); the wāw is the noun (ism) of kāna. (يعملون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «تلك أمّة..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قد خلت..» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of أمّة.
The clause «لها ما كسبت» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may also be in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of أمة, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلت.]».
The clause «كسبت» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «لكم ما كسبتم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause لها ما كسبت and takes its grammatical position under all three views.
The clause «كسبتم» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «لا تسألون..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of (كانوا).

* Morphology:
(خلت): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is خلات: the alif came with sukūn before the tāʾ with sukūn, so it was dropped. Its pattern is فعت.

safi-cedvel:135-135.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (قالوا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (كونوا): a defective imperative verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the noun (ism) of kāna. (هودا): the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb). (أو): a conjunction. (نصارى): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (هودا), accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. (تهتدوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the command;
the wāw is the fāʿil. (قل): an imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being (أنت). (بل): a particle of iḍrāb (digression) and of beginning a new sentence. (ملّة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "نتبع" «[Note: It may also be accusative by way of incitement (ighrāʾ) by an optionally omitted verb, its implied form being "الزموا".]». (إبراهيم): muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (حنيفا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from إبراهيم «[Note: What permits the ḥāl to come from the muḍāf ilayhi is that the muḍāf is a part of the muḍāf ilayhi: the milla, which is the religion, is part of Ibrāhīm.]». (والواو): resumptive. (ما): negative. (كان): a defective past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من المشركين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of kāna.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كونوا هودا» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تهتدوا..» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e. "إن تكونوا هودا تهتدوا".
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause « (نتبع) ملّة» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «ما كان من المشركين..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(حنيفا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from حنف يحنف of the pattern-class of فرح, and حنف يحنف of the pattern-class of كرم; its pattern is فعيل.

* Benefits:
حنيفا: al-ḥanaf is inclination (mayl); it occurs frequently in the feet and rarely in the hands. Among the secrets of the philology of the language is that ḥāʾ and nūn at the beginning of a verb indicate inclination, softness and bending, as in حنف, حنث, حنق and حنو «حنا»: all of them indicate softness and bending in one way or another, so reflect …

safi-cedvel:136-136.t:
* I'rab:
(قولوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (آمنّا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; (نا) is the fāʿil. (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنّا). (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty. (أنزل): a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun. (إلى): a preposition, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزل). (الواو): conjunction. (ما أنزل): like the first. (إلى إبراهيم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل). (إسماعيل، إسحاق، يعقوب، الأسباط): nouns conjoined to the word إبراهيم by conjunctions, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (ما أوتي): like ما أنزل. (موسى): nāʾib fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif. (عيسى): conjoined to موسى by the wāw, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (ما أوتي النبيّون): like ما أوتي موسى, the sign of the nominative in the nāʾib fāʿil being the wāw. (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the first or the second (أوتي);
(هم) is an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (لا): negative. (نفرّق): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (بين): an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (نفرّق). (أحد): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (من): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد. (الواو): conjunction. (نحن): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (مسلمون), which is the khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قولوا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنّا» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أنزل» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «أنزل (the second)» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «أوتي» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «أوتي (the second)» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the fourth relative (ما).
The clause «لا نفرّق» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of آمنّا.
The clause «نحن له مسلمون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا نفرّق «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of نفرّق.]».

* Morphology:
(أحد): a noun with the meaning of a group, in which masculine, feminine, dual and plural are alike; it is other than the أحد that is the first of the numbers. Its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Benefits:
1- al-Sibṭ: it is reported that the sibṭ is the son of a daughter, and in al-Kashshāf of al-Zamakhsharī that the sibṭ is the ḥāfid, in the sense of grandson (ḥafīd). In Lisān al-ʿArab: every child of every child among the descendants of Isḥāq is a sibṭ; it also says that the sibṭ is a group (firqa), and that the Asbāṭ among the descendants of Isḥāq are like the tribes (qabāʾil) among the descendants of Ismāʿīl.

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): conjunction. (إن): a jussive-governing conditional particle. (آمنوا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الباء): a preposition «[Note: Or a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (مثل) is then genitive in form and accusative in position, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective; (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar (ما آمنتم) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "آمنوا إيمانا مثل إيمانكم به".]». (مثل): a redundant noun, lest it entail affirming a likeness to Allah or to the Qur'an. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive by the bāʾ in the remote position, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا). (آمنتم): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; (تم) is a pronoun, the fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (آمنتم). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قد): a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). (اهتدوا): like آمنوا, the vowel of indeclinability being implied (muqaddar) on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. (الواو): conjunction. (إن تولّوا): like إن آمنوا, the vowel of indeclinability being implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis. (إنّما): a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (في شقاق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of (هم). (الفاء): connective for the implied apodosis. (السين): a particle of futurity. (يكفي): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma; (الكاف) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (هم) an attached pronoun, second mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): resumptive. (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (السميع): khabar, nominative. (العليم): second khabar, nominative.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «[Note: The clause قولوا in the previous verse.]».
The clause «آمنتم به» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (ما).
The clause «قد اهتدوا» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تولّوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «هم في شقاق» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سيكفيكهم الله» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "إن أرادوا الكيد لك فسيكفيكهم الله".
The clause «هو السميع» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(اهتدوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the weak letter, the lām of the root, was dropped because it met, with sukūn, the wāw of the plural, which also has sukūn. Its original form is اهتدوا. «[Translator's note: the source gives the original form in the same spelling as the final form; presumably اهتديوا is meant.]» Its pattern is افتعوا, with a fatḥa on the ʿayn to indicate the dropped alif.
(تولّوا): it contains an iʿlāl running along the lines of اهتدوا (see verse 115 of this sūra).
(شقاق): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb شاقّ, which is on the pattern فاعل; its pattern is فعال with a kasra on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:138-138.t:
* I'rab:
(صبغة): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "صبغنا الله صبغة" «[Note: Or mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "نتبع صبغة الله", that is, the religion of Allah; it may also be accusative by way of incitement (ighrāʾ), i.e. "الزموا صبغة الله".]». (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو): parenthetical. (من): an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أحسن): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (من الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحسن). (صبغة): tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): conjunction. (نحن): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (عابدون), which is the khabar of نحن, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.

* Morphology:
(صبغة): a maṣdar (verbal noun) of manner (hayʾa) from the triliteral صبغ; its pattern is فعلة with a kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(أحسن): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral حسن; its pattern is أفعل.
(عابدون): plural of عابد, an active participle from the triliteral عبد; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
The actualised explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taḥqīqiyya al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the words of the Exalted صِبْغَةَ اللَّهِ, where it is used to express purification by faith, because its trace appeared on them as the dye appears on the dyed thing, and it penetrated their hearts as the dye penetrates it, and became an adornment for them. The contextual indicator (qarīna) is the annexation (iḍāfa).
It is also said: it is by way of implied verbal correspondence (al-mushākala al-taqdīriyya), for the Christians used to dye their children in yellow water which they call baptism (al-maʿmūdiyya), claiming that it is the water in which ʿĪsā, upon him be blessing and peace, was born, and believing that it is a purification for the newborn like circumcision for others.

safi-cedvel:139-139.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (تحاجّون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحاجّون), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "في شأن الله". (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ربّ): khabar (predicate), nominative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (ربّ) the second: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first by the conjunction, nominative like it, and (كم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (اللام): a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (أعمال): delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لكم أعمالكم): like لنا أعمالنا. (الواو): conjunction. (نحن): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (له): like لنا, attached to (مخلصون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أتحاجّوننا» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هو ربّنا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the wāw in تحاجّوننا.
The clause «لنا أعمالنا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause هو ربنا.
The clause «لكم أعمالكم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لنا أعمالنا.
The clause «نحن له مسلمون» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads نحن له مخلصون]» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause هو ربّنا.

* Morphology:
(ربّنا): see verse (2) of Sūrat al-Fātiḥa.
(أعمالنا): plural of عمل, which is a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb عمل يعمل, of the pattern-class of فرح.
(مخلصون): plural of مخلص, an active participle from the quadriliteral أخلص; its pattern is مفعل with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction. (الذين) relative noun in the position of the genitive, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the relative noun in the previous verse. (يؤمنون) like the first in the previous verse. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون).
(أنزل) past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو (it). (إليك): (إلى) is a preposition and (الكاف) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive by (إلى), attached to (أنزل). (الواو) a conjunction. (ما أنزل) is parsed like the first, conjoined to it. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل), and (الكاف) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) a conjunction. (بالآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يوقنون). (هم) an overt pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يوقنون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is the retention of the nūn, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
The clause «يؤمنون..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «أنزل إليك..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما). The clause «أنزل من قبلك» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما). The clause «هم يوقنون..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause يؤمنون.
The clause «يوقنون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(قبل) a noun, an adverb of time, declinable (muʿrab); it may be indeclinable on the ḍamma if it is cut off from the construct in wording. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الآخرة) feminine of الآخر, on the pattern of the active participle, but it is used here as a primitive (jāmid) noun is used, because it indicates the Abode of Permanence. The madda in it is converted from a hamza and a vowelless alif; the origin is (أأخرة).
(يوقنون) the deletion of the hamza has taken place in it as it did in (يؤمنون).. And in the verb there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion): its past is أيقن, and the origin of its imperfect is ييقن. The second yāʾ came vowelless after a ḍamma, so it was converted to wāw and it became يوقن. The pattern of يوقنون is يفعلون, with ḍamma on the yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (على هدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility.
(من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (هدى); (الهاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (الواو) a conjunction. (أولئك) is parsed like the first. (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: It may be parsed as in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is المفلحون.. and the clause هم المفلحون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).] with no grammatical position.
(المفلحون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.
The clause «أولئك على هدى ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «أولئك هم المفلحون..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(أولى) a demonstrative noun that comes both shortened (maqṣūr) and lengthened (mamdūd) (أولاء); the wāw in both is extra.
(المفلحون) plural of المفلح, active participle of the four-letter verb أفلح; it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last. For this reason the hamza was deleted from it for lightening, as it was deleted from its imperfect, whose origin is يؤفلحون.

* Rhetoric:
1- «عَلى هُدىً»: the vagueness in this expression, understood from the indefiniteness, is for its perfect magnification, as if it were said: "upon what a guidance, whose essence cannot be reached and whose worth cannot be estimated!"
Bringing in the word of superiority (عَلى) is based on representing their state in their being clothed with guidance by the state of one who mounts a thing and takes possession of it so that he disposes of it however he wishes; or on its being a borrowing for their holding fast to guidance, a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya) branching from likening it to a rider's mounting and settling on his mount; or on making it a contextual clue (qarīna) for an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra bi-l-kināya) between guidance and the mount, to announce the strength of their hold on it and the perfection of their firmness in it.
2- What is more established in the usage of rhetoric is to say that His saying «الم» is a clause by itself, or a group of letters of the alphabet standing independently by itself; «ذلِكَ الْكِتابُ» is a second clause; «لا ريب فيه» a third; and «هُدىً لِلْمُتَّقِينَ» a fourth. In their arrangement the very joint of eloquence and the requirement of good composition has been hit, for they have been brought in harmony like this without a conjunction, because they come as sisters, each taking hold of the neck of the other. The second is united with the first, embracing it, and so on to the third and the fourth.
The explanation of that: He first drew attention to its being the speech with which the challenge is made; then it was pointed to as being the Book described with utmost perfection, which was a confirmation of the aspect of the challenge and a strengthening of its limbs. Then He denied that any trace of doubt clings to it. Then He stated of it that it is guidance for the God-fearing, and thereby established its being a certainty around which no doubt hovers. Then, none of the four is without a point of excellence: in the first there is the omission and the alluding to the purpose in the subtlest and most elegant way; in the second, the grandeur that is in the definiteness; in the third, what is in putting الريب before the adverbial (al-ẓarf); and in the fourth, the omission, and putting the maṣdar (verbal noun), which is «هدى», in the place of the adjective, which is «هاد», and bringing it indefinite, and the concision in mentioning the God-fearing.
May Allah increase us in insight into the secrets of His speech, in clarification of the fine points of His revelation, and in success in acting upon what is in it.

* Benefits:
1- The saying of the Exalted: أُولئِكَ عَلى هُدىً مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ.
In this verse there is a noble rhetorical point: He, Glorified is He, pointed to their firm hold on guidance by making them mount it as the rider mounts the riding beast. It is a dependent metaphor because it runs through the particle instead of the noun, and through the part instead of the whole. In this expression there is one of the marks of Qurʾānic inimitability: instead of the direct description, by saying «أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ», He stated that they are upon guidance, pointing to the strength of the guidedness and the believer's firm hold on guidance.
2- It is necessary to establish this rule, which is one of the self-evident truths and which the seeker of knowledge, whatever his level, would do well to keep before his eyes: «Every pronoun attached to a noun is in the position of the genitive by the construct (iḍāfa)», unlike the pronoun attached to the verb, which may be a fāʿil (agent), as in «يخادعون», where the wāw is the fāʿil, and may be a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), as in the saying of the Exalted: «فَزادَهُمُ اللَّهُ مَرَضاً», where the pronoun «هم» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
To complete the benefit, it must be pointed out that when parsing a pronoun one must mention its type, its indeclinability and its grammatical position.
3- Sībawayh and al-Kisāʾī differed about the root of «الناس». Sībawayh held that it is from the root «أنس», from الأنس (sociability), and al-Kisāʾī inclined to its being from the root «نوس», from movement.
Since sociability is the dominant quality of man, and he is almost alone in it among the animals, whereas he shares the quality of movement with all living beings — and we cannot deny that some kinds of animals are more mobile than man — it therefore appears that the truth is on the side of «Sībawayh», and we would not be departing from what is right if we adopted his opinion rather than the opinion of al-Kisāʾī, and so we judge it more likely that the name الإنسان is from الأنس and not from movement, which is «النوسان».

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; it puts the mubtadaʾ (subject) in the accusative and the khabar (predicate) in the nominative (inna and its sisters). (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ.
(كفروا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). (سواء) a fronted khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: Or the khabar of (إنّ), with the interpreted maṣdar (أأنذرتهم) as its fāʿil, because it is in the sense of مستو (equal). Or a mubtadaʾ, with the interpreted maṣdar as the khabar.]. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سواء). (الهمزة) maṣdariyya (infinitival), of equalisation (al-taswiya). (أنذر) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to a nominative pronoun; (التاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (الهاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (أم) a conjunction counterbalancing the hamza of equalisation. (لم) a particle of negation, apocopation (jazm) and conversion (qalb). (تنذر) imperfect, jussive (majzūm), and (هم) is an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from the hamza and the verb is in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ, i.e. "your warning them or your not warning them is the same to them". (لا) negative. (يؤمنون) imperfect, nominative, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
The clause «إن الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «سواء عليهم ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) [Note: Or the khabar of (إنّ), with the interpreted maṣdar (أأنذرتهم) as its fāʿil, because it is in the sense of مستو. Or a mubtadaʾ, with the interpreted maṣdar as the khabar.].
The clause «أنذرتهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause «لم تنذرهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle relative.
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (إنّ). [Note: The clause «سواء عليهم» may be in the position of the nominative as a first khabar of (إنّ), and the clause (لا يؤمنون) a second khabar; or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive; or it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).]

* Morphology:
(الذين) relative noun, plural of الذي — according to the view of Ibn Yaʿīsh — and the (ال) in it is extra and permanent. (سواء) a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in the place of the active participle, i.e. مستو (equal) ... It contains the substitution (ibdāl) of the weak letter after the alif by a hamza; its origin is سواي, because it is of the type of طويت and شويت.. When the yāʾ came final after a vowelless alif, it was converted to hamza. Its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إذ): an adverb of past time, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكروا". (قتلتم): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (نفسا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء): conjunction. (ادّارأتم): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (التاء): fāʿil, and (الميم): for the masculine plural. (في): a preposition, and (ها): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ادّارأتم), (الواو): parenthetical. (الله): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (مخرج): khabar (predicate), nominative. (ما): a relative noun [Note: (ما) may be maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.] in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مخرج, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (كنتم): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb.. and (تم): the ism of kāna. (تكتمون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قتلتم ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ادّارأتم» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause قتلتم.
The clause «الله مخرج» has no grammatical position: parenthetical between the conjoined and that to which it is conjoined.
The clause «كنتم تكتمون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «تكتمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of (كنتم).

* Morphology:
(ادّارأتم): its origin is تدارأتم, from الدرء, which is "pushing away". The tāʾ came together with the dāl, and they are close in point of articulation, so assimilation between them was easy, but by converting the tāʾ into dāl. When the verb began with a letter with sukūn because of the assimilation, a connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was added, giving ادّارأتم. Its pattern is أتفاعلتم, converted from تفاعلتم, and it may be افّاعلتم.
(مخرج): an active participle from the quadriliteral أخرج, so it is on the pattern of its imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving kasra to the letter before the last.

* Rhetoric:
- Synecdochic metaphor (majāz mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْساً فَادَّارَأْتُمْ فِيها وَاللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ ما كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ, i.e. each of you cast the accusation of the killing upon the other; the killing did not issue from all of them but from one of them only, so He expressed the general and meant the particular. The relation of the majāz is generality.

safi-cedvel:73-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): conjunction. (قلنا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (اضربوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ببعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اضربوه), and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi. (الكاف): a preposition [Note: Or a noun meaning "like", in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description, i.e. "a reviving like that".] (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (يحيي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الموتى): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (يري): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (كم): a pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (آيات): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi. (لعلّ): a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم): a pronoun in the position of accusative, the ism of laʿalla. (تعقلون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قلنا..» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ادّارأتم in the previous verse.
The clause «اضربوه» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «يحيي..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يريكم ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يحيي.
The clause «لعلّكم تعقلون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تعقلون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الموتى): plural of ميّت.. see verse (28) of this verse [Translator's note: so in the source, «من هذه الآية»; "of this sūra" is evidently meant].

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ): conjunction. (قست): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped for the meeting of two sukūns. (التاء): for the feminine. (قلوب): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قست), (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (الفاء): causal. (هي): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (كالحجارة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (أو): a conjunction for permission (ibāḥa). (أشدّ): the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي" [Note: It may be conjoined to the preceding khabar to which the preposition-phrase (كالحجارة) is attached.]. (قسوة): tamyīz (specification), accusative. (الواو): resumptive or of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (من الحجارة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of inna. (اللام): for emphasis. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, the postponed ism of inna. (يتفجّر): an imperfect verb, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يتفجّر). (الأنهار): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (إنّ منها): their i'rab has passed. (لما يشّقق): like لما يتفجّر. (الفاء): conjunction. (يخرج): an imperfect verb, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (الهاء): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يخرج), (الماء): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (إنّ منها لما يهبط): the i'rab of its counterpart has preceded. (من خشية): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهبط). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): resumptive. (ما): negating, operating as laysa does. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the ism of mā, nominative. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (غافل): genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of mā. (عن): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun [Note: Or a maṣdarī particle.. and (ما) with the verb is construed as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to the active participle غافل.], indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the active participle غافل, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. تعملونه.
The clause «قست قلوبكم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "so they struck him with it and he came to life"..
The clause «هي كالحجارة» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «(هي) أشدّ قوّة» [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads أشدّ قسوة] has no grammatical position: conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «إن من الحجارة ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive, or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يتفجّر منه الأنهار» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ منها لما ... » is conjoined to the clause إنّ من الحجارة ...
The clause «يشّقّق» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «يخرج منه الماء» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يشّقّق.
The clause «إنّ منها لما يهبط» is conjoined to the clause إنّ من الحجارة ...
The clause «يهبط» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «ما الله بغافل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the fourth relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(قست): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is قسات: the alif came with sukūn before the tāʾ of the feminine, which has sukūn, so it was deleted to escape the meeting of two sukūns. Its pattern is فعت.
(الحجارة): plural of الحجر (see verse 60) of this sūra.
(أشدّ): an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the verb شدّ; its pattern is أفعل, and the ʿayn has been assimilated into the lām.
(قسوة): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb قسا يقسو, paradigm نصر. There are other maṣdars of the verb, among them قسوا with fatḥa then sukūn, قساوة with fatḥa on the qāf, and قساءة with the wāw converted to a hamza. The pattern of قسوة is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(يشقق): its origin is يتشقق: the tāʾ was converted to a shīn and assimilated into the second shīn; its pattern is يفّعّل, and its origin يتفعّل.
(خشية): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb خشي يخشى, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other maṣdars of the verb: خشي with fatḥa or kasra on the khāʾ, خشاة with fatḥa on the khāʾ, خشيان with fatḥa on the khāʾ and the shīn, مخشية with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the shīn, and مخشاة with the yāʾ converted to an alif and fatḥa on what precedes it.
(غافل): an active participle from غفل يغفل, paradigm فرح, and from it. فاعل. [Translator's note: so in the source; the intended wording is evidently "its pattern is فاعل".]

* Rhetoric:
1- Consequential implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya al-tabaʿiyya): in His saying, the Exalted, ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ, where hardness is borrowed for their hearts' recoiling from being affected by the admonitions and the striking warnings by which mountains melt and rocks soften.
2- Unrestricted simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): where He likened their hearts to stones, or to what is harder than stones; and He mentioned the particle of comparison, so the simile is mursal.
3- And the presenting of the clause as nominal, although what preceded was verbal, is to indicate the continuance of the hardness of their hearts.
4- Rational metaphor (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī): in His saying, the Exalted, وَإِنَّ مِنْها لَما يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ, for it is a figure for submission to His command, the Exalted. The meaning is that there is no single one among the stones but it is submissive to His command, Mighty and Exalted is He, carrying out what it was created for without resistance, whereas their hearts are not so.

safi-cedvel:75-75.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of disavowal (istifhām inkārī). (الفاء): conjunction [Note: Some verifying scholars — among them ʿAbbās Ḥasan, author of the book (al-Naḥw al-Wāfī) — hold that the fāʾ may be, according to the meaning....
resumptive, or conjunctive, or something else in such a construction, contrary to the view of the earlier scholars that it is for conjunction and nothing else. Moreover, the majority of the earlier verifying scholars hold that the hamza is fronted from a later position, because it has the right of first place (ṣadāra), and there is no omission in the speech, the implied form being أفتطمعون..
Al-Zamakhsharī held that it enters upon something omitted, indicated by the context of the speech; the implied form here is "do you hear their reports and know their conditions, and so hope". We have adopted al-Zamakhsharī's view in the i'rab above.],, (تطمعون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).. (أن): a maṣdarī and subjunctive particle. (يؤمنوا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنوا), by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "submit" (ينقادوا).
The interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being في أن يؤمنوا, attached to (تطمعون).
(الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (كان): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. (فريق): the ism of kāna, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريق), (يسمعون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (كلام): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (ثمّ): conjunction. (يحرّفون): like يسمعون, and (الهاء): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحرّفون), (ما): a maṣdarī particle. (عقلوا): a verb and its fāʿil. (الهاء): mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar from (ما) and the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الواو): of the ḥāl. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (يعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause تطمعون has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
"Do you know their reports, and so hope?"
The clause «قد كان فريق منهم ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يسمعون ... » is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
The clause «يحرّفونه» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يسمعون.
The clause «هم يعلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(فريق): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning "party" and "group", having no singular from its own root; its plural is فرقاء, أفرقة and فروق with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(كلام): a noun meaning "speech", or a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral كلّم; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(أم): it is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of "بل" plus the hamza. (تقولون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), for emphasis. (إبراهيم): the noun (ism) of inna, accusative (manṣūb); it is denied nunation because of being a proper name and foreign. (إسماعيل ... ، الأسباط): nouns conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إبراهيم by the conjunction wāw, accusative like it. (كانوا): a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the wāw is the noun of kāna. (هودا): the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative. (أو): a conjunction. (نصارى): conjoined to (هودا), accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. (قل): an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "أنت". (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (أنتم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أعلم): khabar, nominative. (أم): a conjunction; it is the connective (muttaṣila) one. (الله): the Name of Majesty, conjoined to the detached pronoun, and it is nominative «[Note: The Name of Majesty may also be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "أعلم", and the clause is conjoined to the clause أأنتم أعلم.]». (الواو): resumptive. (من): an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (أظلم): khabar, nominative. (من): a preposition. (من): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم). (كتم): a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (شهادة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; it is the second object, the first being omitted, its implied form being "الناس". (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شهادة, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (من الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second naʿt of شهادة, or attached to (كتم) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "من عباد الله". (الواو): resumptive. (ما): negative, operating like laysa. (الله): the noun of mā, nominative. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (غافل): genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of mā. (عن): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, the clause after it being its naʿt.]» in the position of genitive, attached to غافل; the referent pronoun is omitted. (تعملون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «تقولون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّ إبراهيم..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كانوا هودا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أأنتم أعلم» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «من أظلم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كتم شهادة» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (من).
The clause «ما الله بغافل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of (ما).

* Morphology:
(أعلم): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral علم; its pattern is أفعل.
(أظلم): an elative noun from the triliteral ظلم; its pattern is أفعل (see verse 114 of this sūra).
(شهادة): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb شهد يشهد, of the pattern-class of فرح and of the pattern-class of كرم; its pattern is فعالة with a fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
The i'rab of this verse, its words and clauses, has already passed just above «[Note: See verse (134) of this sūra.]»..
[End of the first volume]-....-....- The first volume is complete, and it is followed by the second volume. The second volume:
The remainder of Sūrat al-Baqara,
from verse 142 to verse 249.. ..

safi-cedvel:142-142.t:
* I'rab:
(السين): a particle of futurity. (يقول): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (السفهاء): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (من الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of السفهاء. (ما): an interrogative noun in nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ولّى): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (عن قبلة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ولّاهم); (هم) is an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (التي): a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قبلة. (كانوا): a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable on ḍamma; the wāw is the noun (ism) of kāna. (على): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كانوا, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "على توجّهها". (قل): an imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (المشرق): delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (المغرب): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المشرق by the conjunction, nominative like it. (يهدي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من): a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is "هو", i.e. Allah, and the object of يشاء is omitted, its implied form being «هدايته». (إلى صراط): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهدي). (مستقيم): a naʿt of صراط, genitive (majrūr) like it.
The clause «سيقول السفهاء» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما ولّاهم ... » is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ولّاهم ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما).
The clause «كانوا عليها» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (التي).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لله المشرق» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «يهدي» has no grammatical position: resumptive, carrying the sense of giving a reason.
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position: ṣila of (من).

* Morphology:
(السفهاء): plural of السفيه, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from سفه يسفه of the pattern-class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل. There is another plural, سفاه with a kasra on the sīn. This verb means to lack good character, or to be ignorant, or to be of bad character.. And السفيه may come from سفه يسفه of the pattern-class of كرم, meaning to be ignorant, nothing else (see verse 13).
(ولّى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is ولّي with a yāʾ bearing fatḥa: the yāʾ was vowelled and the letter before it had fatḥa, so it was changed into alif, and it is written as a tall alif in (ولّاهم) because it became medial.
(قبلة): the name of the direction which the one praying faces; its pattern is فعلة with a kasra on the fāʾ, on the pattern of the maṣdar of manner (hayʾa) from قبل يقبل of the pattern-class of نصر.

safi-cedvel:103-103.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse is أنّ.]» (آمنوا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar (predicate) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being ثبت ("it was established"). (الواو): conjunction. (اتّقوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (اللام): occurring in the apodosis of لو «[Note: This is the choice of al-Zamakhsharī. According to some verifying scholars it is the lām of oath, for an implied oath — Ibn Hishām pointed to this in al-Mughnī — and on this view the apodosis of (لو) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah would have rewarded them for it". According to Ibn Ḥayyān it is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), the apodosis of لو is omitted, and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive.]». (مثوبة): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (من عند): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (مثوبة). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (خير): khabar, nominative. (لو): like the first. (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is the noun of كان. (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ثبت إيمانهم (the omitted one)»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «اتقوا»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «مثوبة.. خير»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كانوا يعلمون»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يعلمون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا. The apodosis of the second (لو) is omitted, its implied form being: «they would not have preferred [something] over it».

* Morphology:
(اتقوا): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion: the alif, the third radical of the verb, was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. Its pattern is افتعوا, and it also contains a substitution (ibdāl).
(مثوبة): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar meaning "reward".
