(ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (في السموات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, genitive like it. (كلّ): mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: What made its parsing as a mubtadaʾ permissible, though it is indefinite, is that it indicates generality; and it is on the deletion of a muḍāf, i.e., "everything that Allah created".]». (له): like the first, attached to (قانتون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: Some conjoin it to the clause قالوا لن يدخل in verse (111).. and that is far-fetched..]».
The clause «اتّخذ الله ولدا»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سبحانه»: has no grammatical position, being a parenthetical clause of supplication.
The clause «له ما في السموات»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كلّ له قانتون»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ولدا): originally it is a derived adjective from ولد يلد, of the pattern-class ضرب; then it came to be used as a noun for everyone who is born. It is applied to the male and the female, the dual and the plural. Its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(قانتون): plural of قانت, the active participle of قنت; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- The expressions «سبحانه وتعالى» and «جل جلاله» and the like are all parenthetical clauses, and by them is intended declaring Allah free of imperfection, glorifying Him, and ...

safi-cedvel:117-117.t:
* I'rab:
(بديع): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو". (السموات): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw to السموات, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb for the future including the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis. (قضى): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (أمرا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (إنّما): the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa). (يقول): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "هو". (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يقول). (كن): a complete (tāmm) imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الفاء): conjunction «[Note: Or it is resumptive according to some.. and Ibn Hishām rejected that.]», linking the effect to the cause. (يكون): a complete imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو".
The clause «(هو) بديع السموات ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قضى ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّما يقول ...»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كن»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause يقول, or it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بديع): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from بدع يبدع, of the pattern-class كرم; its pattern is فعيل.
(قضى): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion. Its origin is قضي, its imperfect being يقضي; when the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, it was converted into an alif.
(كن): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion to suit the indeclinability on the sukūn; its origin is كون, with ḍamma on the kāf and sukūn on the wāw. Its pattern is فل.

* Rhetoric:
Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted فَإِنَّما يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ, where the form of the coming-about of what is intended, after the will has attached to it, without delay, is likened to the obedience of the obedient one commanded, immediately after the command of the one obeyed, without hesitation.

safi-cedvel:118-118.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (قال): past verb. (الذين): a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). (لا): negative. (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil. (لولا): a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). (يكلّم): imperfect verb, nominative, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (أو): a conjunction. (تأتي): imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and (نا) direct object. (آية): fāʿil, nominative. (كذلك قال الذين من قبلهم مثل قولهم): the i'rab of its counterpart has been given «[Note: See verse (113).]». (تشابه): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (قلوب): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قد): a particle of realization. (بيّنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil. (الآيات): direct object, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بيّنا). (يوقنون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا اتّخذ «[Note: In verse (116).]».
The clause «لا يعلمون»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لولا يكلّمنا الله»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تأتينا آية»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object-of-speech clause.
The clause «قال الذين ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تشابهت قلوبهم»: has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical.
The clause «قد بيّنا ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يوقنون»: in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

* Morphology:
(يوقنون): see further explanation of its morphology in verse (4) of this sūra.

* Benefits:
لولا: a particle of non-occurrence because of existence; [here] its meaning is urging, like «هلّا», and it is called:
a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ)..

safi-cedvel:119-119.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (أرسلنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, (نا) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent or the object. (بشيرا): ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), of the object. (نذيرا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw to (بشيرا), accusative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative. (تسأل): imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (عن أصحاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تسأل). (الجحيم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «إنّا أرسلناك»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أرسلناك»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «لا تسأل ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّا أرسلناك.

* Morphology:
(بشيرا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb بشر يبشر, of the pattern-classes ضرب and فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(نذيرا): an irregular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أنذر; it is used as adjectives are used, as a ṣifa mushabbaha meaning المنذر (with kasra on the dhāl). Its pattern is فعيل.
(الجحيم): a noun for fire that blazes fiercely. It is originally a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل meaning الجاحم, so it is one of the intensive patterns.

safi-cedvel:229-229.t:
* I'rab:
(الطلاق) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (مرّتان) a khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif; (الفاء) a conjunction; (إمساك) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "واجب عليكم" (incumbent upon you), and it comes before the mubtadaʾ; (بمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of إمساك, or to the maṣdar (verbal noun) إمساك; (أو) a conjunction; (تسريح) conjoined to إمساك, nominative like it; (بإحسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of تسريح or to the maṣdar تسريح.
The clause «الطلاق مرتان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «(عليكم) إمساك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negating; (يحلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يحلّ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (تأخذوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيئا [Note: Or attached to (تأخذوا).]; (آتيتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and the mīm is a particle for the masculine plural; (الواو) a redundant (zāʾida) letter for lengthening the vowel of the mīm; (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (شيئا) a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is تأخذوا, and the second object of the verb آتيتموهنّ is omitted, its implied form being "آتيتموهنّ إيّاه".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأخذوا) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يحلّ.
(إلّا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يخافا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الألف) is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخافا) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, with an omitted muḍāf, and the preposition with its genitive noun, in its specific, delimited sense, is excepted from the most general of states before the particle of exception [Note: The implied meaning: it is not lawful for you to take anything of what you have given them in any state whatsoever, except in the state where the two spouses fear not keeping the limits of Allah; then the taking is valid and lawful. Abū Ḥayyān makes it an "emptied" exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh), it being a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. it is not lawful for you to take for any reason whatsoever except out of fear of not keeping the limits of Allah, for that is what makes the taking permissible for you.]; (أن) like the first; (لا) negating; (يقيما) like يخافا; (حدود) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يقيما) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is يخافا.
The clause «لا يحلّ..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الطلاق مرّتان.
The clause «تأخذوا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آتيتموهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يخافا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «يقيما» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third particle relative (أن).
(الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (خفتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun, the fāʿil; (ألّا يقيما حدود الله) its i'rab has already been given ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يقيما) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is خفتم.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (عليهما) like لكم, attached to the omitted khabar of lā; (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of genitive, and the clause after it its adjective.]; (افتدت) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (افتدت).
The clause «خفتم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقيما» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the fourth particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا جناح عليهما» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «افتدت به» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (حدود) a khabar, nominative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تعتدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) a conjunction; (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يتعدّ) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (حدود) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: It may be a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الظالمون, and the clause the khabar of أولئك.]; (الظالمون) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause تلك حدود الله has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause لا تعتدوها is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if you have understood them, then do not transgress them.
The clause من يتعدّ ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تلك حدود الله, and the clause «يتعدّ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis.].
The clause «أولئك..» الظالمون is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(مرتان): dual of مرّة, which is a noun meaning "a single instance" (al-faʿla) or a maṣdar; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(إمساك): maṣdar of the verb أمسك, a regular maṣdar: أفعل → إفعال.
(تسريح): maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb سرّح, a regular maṣdar: فعّل → تفعيل.
(حدود): plural of حدّ, maṣdar of حدّ يحدّ (category نصر); its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn (see ayah 187 of this sūra).
(خفتم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the quiescent weak letter was deleted because the verb is built on the sukūn; its pattern is فلتم with kasra on the fāʾ.
(افتدت): it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the alif was deleted because it came quiescent before the tāʾ of the feminine; its pattern is افتعت.
(تعتدوها): i.e. تتعدّوها; both mean "transgress them". The first is from the verb اعتدى الحقّ, اعتدى عن الحقّ and اعتدى فوق الحقّ, i.e. went beyond it; the second from the verb تعدّى الشيء, i.e. went beyond it. In تعتدوها there is iʿlāl by deletion: its original form is تعتديوها with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the dāl, so it became quiescent, then the yāʾ was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is تفتعوها.
(يتعدّ): its final radical was deleted for the jussive; its pattern is يتفعّ.

safi-cedvel:120-120.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لن): a particle of negation and the accusative. (ترضى): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (عن): a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ترضى). (اليهود): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): conjunction. (لا): redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation. (النصارى): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to اليهود by the wāw, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma. (حتّى): a particle of limit and of the genitive. (تتّبع): imperfect verb, accusative by (أنّ) concealed after حتّى «[Translator's note: so in the source; the concealed particle is أن, as the following line shows.]»; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (ملّة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تتّبع) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (ترضى).
(قل): imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (انّ): a particle resembling the verb. (هدى): the noun of انّ, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the implied fatḥa. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (هو): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or it is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is (الهدى), and the clause هو الهدى is the khabar of انّ.]». (الهدى): the khabar of انّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma. (الواو): resumptive. (اللام): preparing for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). (ان): a conditional particle causing the jussive. (اتّبع): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. (أهواء): direct object, accusative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بعد): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (اتّبعت). الذي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (جاء): past verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun, direct object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من العلم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of جاء. (ما): negative. (اللام): a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (من الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of وليّ (a naʿt placed before the noun it describes) «[Note: It may be attached to the omitted khabar.]». (من): a redundant preposition. (وليّ): genitive in form, nominative in position, postponed mubtadaʾ. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): redundant, to emphasize the negation. (نصير): maʿṭūf to the form of (وليّ), genitive like it.
The clause «لن ترضى عنك اليهود»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous sentence.
The clause «تتّبع..»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.
The clause «قل..»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أنّ هدى الله هو الهدى»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اتّبعت..»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «جاءك من العلم»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «مالك من الله..»: has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath that is mentioned.

* Morphology:
(ترضى): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion. Its origin is ترضي with ḍamma on the yāʾ; when the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, it was converted into an alif.
(ملّة): a noun meaning religion, way or law; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra on the first radical and sukūn on the second.. and the second and third radicals have been assimilated together.
(أهواء): plural of هوى, maṣdar of هوي يهوى, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.. In أهواء the third radical, which is a yāʾ, was converted into a hamza because it came at the end after a quiescent alif; its origin is أهواي.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); (عفونا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (عن) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عفونا) , (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عفونا) , (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) the noun of laʿalla, in the position of accusative, (تشكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «عفونا» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «اتخذتم العجل» in the previous verse.
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عنكم», i.e.: hoping to offer thanks.]» .
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(عفونا) , the alif was returned to its origin when the verb was attributed to the pronoun of the first person plural.

safi-cedvel:121-121.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (آتينا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent). (هم): an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الكتاب): a second direct object, accusative (manṣūb). (يتلون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) direct object. (حقّ): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is originally a description of the maṣdar. (تلاوة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi in the position of genitive. (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address. (يؤمنون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون). (الواو): conjunction. (من): a conditional noun causing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (يكفر): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (به): like the first, attached to (يكفر). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (أولاء): like the first, and (الكاف) a particle of address. (هم): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is الخاسرون, and the clause is the khabar of أولئك.]». (الخاسرون): the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «الذين آتيناهم ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «آتيناهم الكتاب»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يتلونه»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in آتيناهم or of الكتاب «[Note: It may be in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين), and the clause أولئك يؤمنون..
is then resumptive and causal, with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «أولئك يؤمنون..»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «يؤمنون به..»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «من يكفر به..»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الذين آتيناهم الكتاب.
The clause «يكفر به..»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «أولئك هم الخاسرون»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(يتلونه): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion. Its origin is يتلوونه with ḍamma on the first wāw; its vowel was transferred to the lām, then it was deleted because it met, while quiescent, the wāw of the plural, so it became يتلونه. Its pattern is يفعلونه «[Translator's note: so in the source; with the third radical deleted the pattern would be يفعونه, as given for يتلون under verse 113.]» (see verse 44 of this sūra).
(تلاوته): maṣdar of تلا يتلو; its pattern is فعالة, with kasra on the first radical.

* Benefits:
فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْخاسِرُونَ: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and when the fāʾ is present the clause is parsed as being in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. The apodosis must be linked with the fāʾ in the following places: if the clause is nominal, or a request (ṭalabiyya), or its verb is inflexible (jāmid), or it is preceded by ما, لن, قد, the sīn or سوف. «[Translator's note: the source reads «من» in this list; the standard rule names لن, which appears to be intended.]»

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا آتينا) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic wording is «إذ آتينا».]» like «إذ نجّيناكم» «[Note: in verse (49) of this sūra.]» , (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الكتاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفرقان) conjoined by the wāw to «الكتاب», accusative like it; (لعلّكم تهتدون) like «لعلّكم تشكرون» in the previous verse.
The clause «آتينا ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of «إذ» to it.
The clause «لعلّكم تهتدون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تهتدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(آتينا) , the madda is converted from two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second quiescent, because the imperfect is يؤتي; and the alif, the lām of the word, returned to its origin through its connection with the pronoun of the first person plural; the pattern of آتينا is أفعلنا.
(الفرقان) , it is originally an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فرق يفرق, of the classes of نصر and ضرب; then it was made a name for the Noble Qur'an; its pattern is فعلان with ḍamma then sukūn.
(تهتدون) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its origin is تهتديون with ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the deletion in it followed the same course as in (تشتروا), in verse (41) . Its pattern is تفتعون.

safi-cedvel:122-122.t:
* I'rab:
This noble verse has come before, so refer to its i'rab in verse (47).

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ) a noun indicating past time, in the position of accusative, conjoined to «إذ», the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in the previous verse; (قال) a past verb; (موسى) fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال) , and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (يا) a vocative particle; (قوم) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ that is deleted for lightness, and the deleted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (ظلمتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (باتّخاذ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ظلمتم) , the bāʾ being causal, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (العجل) mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar «اتّخاذ», and the second object is omitted, its implied form being «إلها» (a god). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; it linked the cause with what is caused; (توبوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الى بارئ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توبوا), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (اقتلوا) like «توبوا»; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (ذا) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the killing, and (اللام) for distance, (الكاف) for address and (الميم) for the masculine plural; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خير) , (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (خير) , (بارئ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive. (الفاء) conjunction; (تاب) a past verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تاب) . (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) the noun of inna; (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is «التّواب», and the clause is the khabar of inna.]» , (التوّاب) the khabar of inna, nominative; (الرحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قال موسى ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «of the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّكم ظلمتم ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «ظلمتم ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «توبوا ... » is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you want Allah's pardon and forgiveness, then repent to Him «[Note: It may be conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative ... and the demand for repentance is caused by the wronging of the souls.]» .
The clause «اقتلوا» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause «توبوا».
The clause «ذلكم خير لكم» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تاب عليكم» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "you did so, and He turned to you in forgiveness".
The clause «إنّه هو التوّاب» has no grammatical position, being causal.

* Morphology:
(قوم) a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own wording; its singular is رجل; its derivation is from the verb قام يقوم; it is applied to men and is never applied to women alone.. and see verse (60) of this sūra.
(اتّخاذكم) , a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the five-letter verb اتّخذ; its pattern is افتعال, on the pattern of its past with kasra on the third letter and the addition of an alif before the last.
(عند) , a noun for place and for time; it occurs only as an adverb or made genitive by (من) .
(بارئ) , an active participle of برأ يبرأ, of the class of فتح, its pattern فاعل.
(خير) , an elative (ism tafḍīl) from which the hamza has been deleted because of frequent use; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Synecdochic metaphor (al-majāz al-mursal): in the words of Allah the Exalted فَاقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ.
It is related that He commanded those who had not worshipped the calf to kill those who had worshipped it; and the meaning according to that is: surrender yourselves to being killed; surrender to being killed was called killing by way of figure (majāz).
2- Change of person (al-iltifāt): in the words of Allah the Exalted فَتابَ عَلَيْكُمْ; it is an address from Him, Glorified and Exalted, by way of iltifāt from the first person, which the noble composition and its context require, to the third person; for the situation required that He say: "so I granted you success and I turned to you in forgiveness".

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is «إذ».]» like «إذ» in the previous verse; (قلتم) a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (يا) a vocative particle; (موسى) the one addressed, a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (لن) a particle of negation and accusative; (نؤمن) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن); (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نؤمن) by its being made to include the meaning of «نقرّ» (acknowledge), or the lām is causal; (حتّى) a particle of limit and genitive; (نرى) an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after «حتّى», the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif, its fāʿil "we"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by it, accusative «[Translator's note: so in the source, with «منصوب به منصوب» duplicated.]»; (جهرة) a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Name of Majesty, i.e. "you see Him manifest" «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: you spoke openly, an open speaking.. or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, for it coincides in meaning with the verb of seeing.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb «نرى» is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (نؤمن) .]» . (الفاء) conjunction; it conjoined the effect to the cause; (أخذ) a past verb, and (التاء) for the feminine, and (كم) mafʿūl bihi; (الصاعقة) fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) circumstantial; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تنظرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قلتم ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «of the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لن نؤمن ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «أخذتكم الصاعقة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تنظرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تنظرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم) .

* Morphology:
(قلتم) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the ʿayn of the verb was deleted on account of the indeclinability on the sukūn; when two quiescent letters met, the alif was deleted, its origin being (قالتم); then the first letter of the verb was given ḍamma to indicate the kind of the deleted letter, for the alif was originally a wāw. Its pattern is فلتم with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(نرى) , in it the hamza - which is the ʿayn of the word - is deleted for lightness; its origin is نرأى, its pattern نفل with two fatḥas. (جهرة) maṣdar (verbal noun) of جهر مجهر «[Translator's note: so in the source, for «جهر يجهر».]», of the class of فتح; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; there is another maṣdar of the verb, جهارا, with kasra on the jīm.
(الصاعقة) , a noun for the electric spark produced by the friction of clouds of different charge. It is on the pattern of the active participle and has its meaning.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); (بعثنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بعثنا) , (موت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi in the position of genitive. (لعلّكم تشكرون) its i'rab has preceded «[Note: in verse (52) .]» .
The clause «بعثناكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أخذتكم الصاعقة».
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) , conjunction; (ظلّلنا) like «بعثنا» in the previous verse; (على) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ظلّلنا) , (الغمام) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (أنزلنا) like «بعثنا», and (عليكم), whose i'rab has preceded, is attached to (أنزلنا) , (المنّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (السلوى) conjoined by the wāw to «المنّ», accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
(كلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من طيّبات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كلوا) , (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.. and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it, in the position of genitive.]» , in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (رزقنا) like «بعثنا», and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (ظلمونا) a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (أنفس) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (يظلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ظلّلنا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «بعثناكم» in the previous verse.
The clause «أنزلنا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ظلّلنا».
The clause «كلوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «قلنا» (We said).
The clause «رزقناكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
The clause «ما ظلمونا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لكن كانوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمونا».
The clause «يظلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».

* Morphology:
(المنّ) , a generic noun for a plant or a sweet; it is stated in the dictionary: it is what Allah sent down miraculously in the wilderness upon the Children of Israel; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(كلوا) , in it there is a change by deletion: the hamza was deleted from it irregularly; its pattern is علوا.
(طيّبات) , plural of طيّب, an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb طاب يطيب; its pattern is فيعل, and the two yāʾs have been merged together.
(السلوى) , a generic noun for the quail bird, or it is a kind of it; the pattern of السلوى is فعلى with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (الذين) relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).
(اشتروا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun, the fāʿil (agent), in the position of the nominative. (الضلالة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (بالهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb اشتروا by its being made to include the meaning of استبدلوا (they exchanged); the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif because of impossibility. (الفاء) a conjunction, serving to link the cause with the effect. (ما) negative. (ربح) past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (تجارة) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) a conjunction. (كانوا) an incomplete past verb (kāna and its sisters) with its noun. (مهتدين) khabar of كان, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «أولئك الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «اشتروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ما ربحت ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ما كانوا مهتدين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(اشتروا) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is اشتراوا. The alif was deleted because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw of the plural, and what preceded it was given fatḥa to indicate it; its pattern is افتعوا, with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(الضلالة) a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ضلّ يضلّ, of the class of ضرب, and ضلّ يضلّ, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فعالة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(تجارتهم) a heard maṣdar of the verb تجر يتجر, of the class of نصر. This maṣdar is almost regular (qiyāsī), because the verb denotes a craft; and it may denote the thing in which one trades. Its pattern is فعالة, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(مهتدين) contains iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is مهتديين, with two yāʾs. When the first came vowelless before the vowelless yāʾ of the plural, it was deleted; its pattern is مفتعين. It is the active participle of the five-letter verb اهتدى, its singular being المهتدي, on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last.

* Rhetoric:
1- The explicit metaphor with consolidation (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tarshīḥiyya): in the saying of the Exalted: اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلالَةَ بِالْهُدى.
Buying error with guidance is borrowed for taking it in exchange for guidance, a taking bound up with desire for it and turning away from guidance. They are likened to one who bought, as if they paid their guidance for the error. So the metaphor of buying for choosing was consolidated (rushshiḥat) by the profit and the trade, which are among the motives of buying.
2- Figurative attribution (al-isnād al-majāzī): where loss is attributed to the trade, while it belongs to its owners.
Figurative attribution is: that the verb is attributed to something connected with the one to whom it truly belongs, as the trade is connected with the buyers.
3- If you say: granted that the buying of error with guidance occurred figuratively in the sense of exchange, what is the point of mentioning the profit and the trade, as if there were a real sale?
I say: this is of the marvellous craft that brings the figure to the highest peak. It is that a word is brought in the manner of a figure, then followed by things of its kind and its sisters, which, when they follow one another, you will not see speech finer than it in style, nor of greater lustre and splendour. This is the consolidated figure (al-majāz al-murashshaḥ). That is like the saying of the Arabs about the dull-witted: كأن أذني قلبه خطلا (as if the two ears of his heart were long and flabby): even though they made him like the donkey, they then consolidated that to establish the dullness, so they claimed two ears for his heart, and claimed flabbiness for them, in order to represent the dullness in a way that joins it to the dullness of the donkey, seen and witnessed.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (كمثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) [Note: The kāf may be a noun in the sense of مثل, in which case it is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ and is put in construct with مثل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the thāʾ.]. (الذي) relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (استوقد) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو (he). (نارا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء) a conjunction. (لمّا) adverbial of time (ḥīniyya), containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis ذهب. (أضاء) past verb, (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هي (it). (ما) relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It may be an indefinite noun described (nakira mawṣūfa), with the implied clause to which (حول) is attached as its description.]. (حول) adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (ذهب) past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (بنور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذهب), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (ترك) past verb, and (هم) is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is هو, i.e. Allah. (في ظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of (ترك), i.e. "lost" or "wandering". (لا) negative. (يبصرون) imperfect, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «مثلهم كمثل الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «استوقد نارا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «أضاءت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ذهب الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تركهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لا يبصرون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) from the accusative pronoun in تركهم [Note: The clause may be the second object of the verb ترك, in which case the preposition is attached to the verb ترك.].

* Morphology:
(مثلهم) a noun meaning description and state, derived from المماثلة (resemblance); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(الذي) relative noun, in which (ال) is extra and permanent. Its origin is (لذ) like عم; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and kasra on the ʿayn. In it one of the two lāms has been deleted, either the lām of the definite article or the fāʾ (first radical) of the word, as in التي and الذين.
(نارا) a noun, and the alif in it is converted from a wāw, because its diminutive is نويرة and its plural is أنور with ḍamma on the wāw. As for the yāʾ in نيران, it is converted from a wāw because of the kasra before it.
(أضاءت) the alif in it is converted from a wāw, because its maṣdar (verbal noun) is الضوء. Its origin is أضوأت with sukūn on the wāw and fatḥa on the hamza: the wāw came vowelless with a fatḥa before it, so it was converted to alif. It may also be referred back to the bare past, in which case it takes the ruling of (زاد) [Note: See verse (10).].
(نورهم) a primitive (jāmid) noun perceived by sight; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(ظلمات) plural of ظلمة, a primitive noun, the opposite of light; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the saying of the Exalted مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي اسْتَوْقَدَ ناراً, where their state resembles the state of one who kindled a fire and his fire went out.
2- Observance of the counterpart (murāʿāt al-naẓīr): a device known among the scholars of rhetoric as congruity (al-tanāsub) and harmony (al-iʾtilāf). Its definition is that the speaker combines a thing and what suits it, while dropping mention of opposition, so as to exclude antithesis (al-muṭābaqa). Here it is in the mention of light (الضوء) and light (النور). The secret of mentioning النور, although the context would require Him to say بضوئهم in correspondence with أضاءت, is that الضوء indicates an increase; so had He said بضوئهم, it would have suggested taking away the increase while what is called نور remained, whereas the purpose is the removal of light from them entirely and its obliteration altogether.

* Benefits:
The context of the Qur'an continues in striking parables to depict the condition of the hypocrites, in order to uncover their nature and their fluctuations and to make their description all the clearer and plainer. They kindled the fire, and when its light shone they did not benefit from it; so Allah punished them, took away their light and left them in darknesses, not seeing.
The style of representation (al-tamthīl) is one of the Qurʾānic styles in which the eloquence of the Qur'an has appeared in its finest forms, most effective upon souls and most settled in minds and hearts.
And as we find this characteristic in the Noble Qur'an, we find it in the noble hadith, for it is among the noblest means of establishing truths and clarifying attributes.
First: in the verse there is a representative simile, because the point of similarity and the shared quality between the thing likened and what it is likened to — you extract it from multiple qualities or things.
Second: the style of simile is one of the rhetorical characteristics of the Noble Qur'an. We present some examples, and perhaps the part may suffice for the whole in clarifying what is intended, such as the saying of the Exalted:
«رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ», and His saying: «مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّوْراةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوها كَمَثَلِ الْحِمارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفاراً», and also His saying «مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُها ثابِتٌ وَفَرْعُها فِي السَّماءِ», and the saying of the Exalted: «وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثالُ نَضْرِبُها لِلنَّاسِ وَما يَعْقِلُها إِلَّا الْعالِمُونَ».
Third: in the verses there is an iltifāt (shift) from the singular to the plural, in His saying: «فَلَمَّا أَضاءَتْ ما حَوْلَهُ ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ».
Fourth: He, Glorified and Exalted is He, expressed blindness of insight by blindness of the eyes, which is one of the kinds of linguistic figure (al-majāz al-lughawī). It is explained by the saying of the Exalted: فَإِنَّها لا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصارُ وَلكِنْ تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ. This is a little of much; had we traced the characteristics and benefits in this verse, it would have led us to writing a whole tome. So glory be to Him whose speech this is and whose eloquence this is..
The author of al-Kashshāf says: For some reason Allah has made abundant use of parables in His clear Book and in all His books; they spread in the speech of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the speech of the prophets and sages; and among the chapters of the Gospel is «the Chapter of Parables».
The Arabs have many proverbs which have taken the course of maxims, and whose wording has been barred from change; they liken the situation where a proverb is applied to the situation where it originated, and volumes have been composed on them.

safi-cedvel:86-86.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف): a particle of address. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate). (اشتروا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped for the meeting of two sukūns.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الحياة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الدنيا): a naʿt (adjective) of (الحياة), accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being the implied fatḥa. (بالآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اشتروا), by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "exchanged" (استبدلوا). (الفاء): conjunctive, for causal linking. (لا): negating. (يخفّف): a passive imperfect verb, nominative. (عن): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يخفّف), (العذاب): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (ينصرون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «أولئك الذين ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اشتروا ... » has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يخفّف عنهم العذاب» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لا هم ينصرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا يخفّف.
The clause «ينصرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(الآخرة): feminine of الآخر, a name for the Day of Resurrection. See verse (4) of this sūra.

* Rhetoric:
- Consequential implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya al-tabaʿiyya): in His saying, the Exalted, اشْتَرَوُا الْحَياةَ الدُّنْيا بِالْآخِرَةِ, i.e. they preferred the life of this world and took it in exchange for the Hereafter. "Buying" is borrowed.

safi-cedvel:87-87.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (آتينا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (موسى): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (قفّينا): a verb and its fāʿil. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قفّينا), and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (بالرسل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قفّينا). (الواو): conjunction. (آتينا): like the first. (عيسى): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa. (بن): a badal (substitute) of عيسى or a naʿt (adjective) of it, accusative like it. (مريم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, since it is a diptote. (البيّنات): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, since it is a sound feminine plural. (الواو): conjunction. (أيّدنا): a verb and its fāʿil, and (الهاء): an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بروح): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أيّدناه), (القدس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disavowal and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī). (الفاء): resumptive. (كلّما): adverbial, temporal, containing the meaning of condition [Note: (كل) may be parsed as an adverb of time attached to (استكبرتم), and (ما) as a maṣdarī particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.] (جاء): a past verb, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (رسول): fāʿil, nominative. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (جاءكم), (لا): negating. (تهوى): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif. (أنفس): fāʿil, nominative, and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi. (استكبر): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم): an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil, (الفاء): conjunction. (فريقا): a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (كذّبتم): like استكبرتم, (الواو): conjunction. (فريقا): like the first. (تقتلون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «آتينا ... » has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «قفّينا ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آتينا.
The clause «آتينا (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آتينا (the first).
The clause «أيّدناه ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آتينا (the second).
The clause «جاءكم رسول» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا تهوى أنفسكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «استكبرتم» has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كذّبتم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer clause.
The clause «تقتلون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer clause.

* Morphology:
(قفّينا): the yāʾ is converted from a wāw, because its triliteral base is قفوت, [said] when you follow someone's back (قفا). The wāw is converted to an alif in the quadriliteral on the pattern فعّل, because it is voweled and what precedes it has fatḥa; then the alif — being the fourth letter — was converted to yāʾ when the verb is made indeclinable on the sukūn [Note: See al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 588.].
(الرسل): plural of الرسول, in the sense of "the one sent"; the pattern of الرسول is فعول, and the pattern of الرسل is فعل with two ḍammas; it is an irregular plural.
(عيسى): it is said to be taken from العيس, which is whiteness mixed with a reddish tinge; and it is said to be foreign (aʿjamī), not derived from anything.
(مريم): it is said to be foreign, and in Syriac it is an adjective meaning "servant".. In Lisān al-ʿArab: she is the woman who dislikes mixing with men. Its pattern is مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, if it is derived from رام يريم.
(البيّنات): plural of البيّنة, feminine of البيّن; its pattern is فيعل, with kasra on the ʿayn, from the verb بان يبين.
(روح): originally a noun for that by which souls have life, then borrowed for Jibrīl, peace be upon him.
(القدس): maṣdar (verbal noun) of قدس يقدس, paradigm كرم; here it is used as an adjective in the sense of "the hallowed". Its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas, and the dāl may come with sukūn.

safi-cedvel:88-88.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (قالوا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (قلوب): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (نا): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (غلف): khabar (predicate), nominative. (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and of beginning. (لعن): a past verb, and (هم): an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (بكفر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لعن), the bāʾ being causal, and (هم): muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (قليلا): a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its description, i.e. "they believe with little belief" [Note: It may be an adverb standing in for an omitted time, i.e. "they believe for a short period" or "a little time".. or a ḥāl (circumstantial) according to the view of Sībawayh.], (ما): redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the meaning [Note: (ما) cannot be maṣdarī, because (قليلا) would be left with nothing to put it in the accusative.. It has been said that (ما) is negating, i.e. "they do not believe, little or much"; this is stronger in meaning, and it is only somewhat weak in respect of something governed by what is within its scope preceding it.. (end of quotation from al-ʿUkbarī).], (يؤمنون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قلوبنا غلف» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «لعنهم الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, or it is parenthetical between two conjoined elements.
The clause «يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the second resumptive clause — or the first —.

* Morphology:
(غلف): plural of أغلف, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from the verb غلف يغلف, paradigm فرح; its pattern is أفعل, and the plural فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(كفر): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb كفر يكفر, paradigm نصر; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:89-89.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لمّا): an adverb meaning "when", containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the answer. (جاء): a past verb, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (كتاب): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (من عند): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (كتاب).], (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (مصدّق): a naʿt of (كتاب), nominative like it. (اللام): a preposition [Note: The lām may be redundant, for strengthening, so the relative noun is the object of the active participle مصدّق.], (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (مصدّق), (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (هم): an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): parenthetical. (كانوا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the ism of kāna. (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (يستفتحون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (يستفتحون), by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "seek victory" (يستنصرون). (كفروا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (الفاء): conjunction. (لّما جاءهم): like the preceding. (ما): a relative noun in the position of nominative, fāʿil. (عرفوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (كفروا): like عرفوا. (الباء): a preposition, (الهاء): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كفروا).
(الفاء): connecting the answer of an implied condition. (لعنة): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (على الكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.. the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «جاءهم كتاب» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the second condition.
The clause «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «يستفتحون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kānū.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «جاءهم (the second)» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «عرفوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «كفروا به» has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.. and the sentence made up of the condition, its verb and its answer is conjoined to the first sentence of condition, its verb and its answer, because it is conjoined to a preceding resumption.
The clause «لعنة الله على الكافرين» is in the position of jussive as the answer to an implied condition, i.e. "if they are thus, then the curse of Allah is upon the disbelievers".

* Morphology:
(مصدّق): an active participle from the quadriliteral صدّق, so it is on the measure of its imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving kasra to the letter before the last.
(لعنة): a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of اللعن, of the verb لعن يلعن, paradigm فتح; or it is the maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar al-marra) from لعن; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:153-153.t:
* I'rab:
(يا): a vocative particle. (أي): the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (ها) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (الذين): a relative noun in the position of accusative, a badal (substitute) of أي or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). (آمنوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (استعينوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. (بالصبر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استعينوا). (الصلاة): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الصبر by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) like it. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), for emphasis. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. (الصابرين): muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين).
The clause «استعينوا» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «إنّ الله مع الصابرين» has no grammatical position: giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(الصابرين): plural of الصابر, an active participle from the triliteral صبر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:154-154.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لا): prohibitive, jussive-governing. (تقولوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (اللام): a preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقولوا) «[Note: The saying is not addressed to the one who is killed; rather it is addressed to the living, about the one who is killed in the way of Allah.]». (يقتل): a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun. (في سبيل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقتل). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (أموات): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم". (بل): a particle of iḍrāb (digression), for beginning a new sentence. (أحياء): khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم". (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (لكن): a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect. (لا): negative. (تشعرون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لا تقولوا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause استعينوا in the previous verse.
The clause «يقتل» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
The clause « (هم) أموات» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause « (هم) أحياء» is in the position of accusative as the object of an implied saying, i.e. "rather, say: they are alive" «[Note: The clause of the implied saying has no grammatical position: resumptive.]».
The clause «لا تشعرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تقولوا.

* Morphology:
(سبيل): a noun meaning "the road", treated as masculine and feminine; its pattern is فعيل, derived from the quadriliteral سبّل. Its plurals are سبل with two ḍammas or with ḍamma then sukūn; أسبل with a fatḥa on the hamza and a ḍamma on the bāʾ; أسبلة with a fatḥa on the hamza and a kasra on the bāʾ; and سبول with a ḍamma on the sīn (verse 108). (أحياء): plural of حيّ, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from حيي يحيا of the pattern-class of فرح; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and its ʿayn and lām are the same letter. In أحياء there is substitution of the weak letter — the lām of the word — by a hamza, because the yāʾ came at the end after a quiescent alif; its original form is أحياي.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in the words of the Exalted «بَلْ أَحْياءٌ». It is concision by omission: the mubtadaʾ has been omitted, its implied form being «هم», i.e. "rather, they are alive". That is because of the importance of mentioning the khabar, since they did not imagine that they were alive, so He, glory be to Him, refuted this wondrous primitive notion with an elegant depiction.
2- Antithesis (ṭibāq): أموات and أحياء in the verse form an elegant antithesis with no artificiality in it.
ولا تقولوا لمن يقتل في سبيل الله أموات to the end of the verse:
This divine direction had the greatest effect in impelling the Muslims to jihād and the seeking of martyrdom, until states submitted to them, cities were opened to them, and people entered the religion of Allah in throngs.. Every nation that loves death has life decreed for it, and this is what we need today, an urgent need that we cannot do without ... and for which there is no substitute whatsoever ...

safi-cedvel:155-155.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (اللام): connective for the answer to an implied oath. (نبلونّ): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative; (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بشيء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نبلونّ). (من الخوف): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شيء. (الجوع): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الخوف by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) like it. (نقص): conjoined to شيء by the wāw, genitive like it. (من الأموال): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقص «[Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of نقص.]». (الأنفس، الثمرات): two nouns conjoined to الأموال by two conjunctions, genitive like it. (الواو): resumptive. (بشّر): an imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الصابرين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «نبلونكم» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «بشّر الصابرين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الجوع): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb جاع; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(نقص): a heard maṣdar of the verb نقص ينقص of the pattern-class of نصر; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الأموال): plural of المال, a noun for whatever is owned of anything; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and the alif in it is changed from a wāw.

safi-cedvel:156-156.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of الصابرين «[Note: Or in the position of nominative, either as the khabar (predicate) of an obligatorily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم", with the intention of cutting off (qaṭʿ) for praise.. or as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause أولئك عليهم صلوات ... It may also be in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أمدح".]». (إذا): an adverb of future time including the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis. (أصاب): a past verb; (التاء) marks the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (مصيبة): a nominative verb «[Translator's note: so in the source, "فعل مرفوع"; evidently فاعل (the agent) is meant.]». (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), and (نا) a pronoun, the noun (ism) of inna. (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of inna. (الواو): conjunction. (إنّا): like the first. (إلى): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (راجعون), which is the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause of the condition — the conditional word, the protasis and its apodosis — has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
The clause «أصابتهم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّا لله ... » is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّا إليه راجعون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause that is the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(أصاب): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is أصوبتهم with a fatḥa on the wāw: the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the ṣād before it, then the wāw was changed into alif because the letter before it had fatḥa and it was originally vowelled.
(مصيبة): a noun for every hateful thing, on the pattern of the active participle of أصاب. It contains iʿlāl by substitution, because its original form is مصوبة with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the wāw; then the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the ṣād before it, and when the wāw came with sukūn after a kasra it was changed into yāʾ. Its plural is مصائب and مصاوب.
(راجعون): plural of راجع, an active participle from the triliteral رجع, on the pattern فاعل.

safi-cedvel:157-157.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء): a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (على): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (صلوات): delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ). (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of صلوات, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (رحمة): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to صلوات by the wāw, nominative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (أولئك): like the first. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: Or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and (المهتدون) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).]». (المهتدون): the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «أولئك عليهم صلوات» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or it is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين إذا ...) in the previous verse, as came among the possible i'rab analyses.]».
The clause «عليهم صلوات» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «أولئك هم المهتدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one «[Note: Or it is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the resumptive one, if that is made a khabar.]». The clause «هم المهتدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (أولئك).

* Benefits:
1- One must pause before this mobilisation of souls — the mobilisation to face hardship, toil, martyrdom, being killed, hunger, fear, and loss of wealth, lives and fruits. What did Allah promise them in return for that? He promised them with His words: أُولئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَواتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ.
From Khabbāb ibn al-Aratt, who said: We complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was reclining on a cloak in the shade of the Kaʿba, and we said: Will you not seek victory for us? Will you not pray for us? He said: "Among those before you, a man would be seized, a hole would be dug for him in the ground and he would be put in it; then a saw would be brought and placed on his head and he would be split in two halves, and he would be combed with iron combs [removing] what is beneath his flesh and bone — and that would not turn him away from his religion. By Allah, Allah the Exalted will surely complete this matter until a rider travels from Ṣanʿāʾ to Ḥaḍramawt fearing none but Allah, and the wolf for his sheep; but you are hasty."
2- أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ:
In the i'rab of «هم» there are two views. The first is that it is a mubtadaʾ and المهتدون is the khabar, the clause being in the position of nominative as the khabar of «أولئك». The second is that it is a pronoun of separation with no grammatical position, in which case «المهتدون» is the khabar of «أولئك». In my view the first view is more acceptable than the second.

safi-cedvel:177-177.t:
* I'rab:
(ليس) a defective, rigid (jāmid) past verb; (البرّ) the fronted khabar (predicate) of laysa, accusative (manṣūb); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تولّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (وجوه) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تولّوا) is in the position of nominative as the postponed noun of laysa.
(قبل) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تولّوا), (المشرق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (المغرب) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المشرق by the wāw, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (البرّ) the noun of lākinna, accusative «[Note: It is permissible for it to be with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذا البرّ (the one possessing righteousness), so that predicating the relative of it is sound.]» (من) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar of lākinna, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. إيمان من آمن (the faith of the one who believed) «[Note: Or without the omission of a muḍāf if the noun of lākinna is taken as: ذا البرّ من آمن.]», (آمن) a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the referent (al-ʿāʾid); (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمن), (الواو) conjunction; (اليوم، الملائكة، الكتاب، النبيّين) words conjoined to the Name of Majesty by conjunctions, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive of the last being the yāʾ; and (الآخر) naʿt (adjective) of (اليوم), genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (آتى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), referring to من, (المال) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or it is the first object and (ذوي) the second object; the i'rab above is the view of the majority, because (ذوي) is the one who receives, so it must be put first.]», (على حبّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of المال, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ذوي) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (اليتامى، المساكين، ابن ...، السائلين) words conjoined to ذوي by conjunctions, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative in the last being the yāʾ, and (السبيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (في الرقاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted element, its implied form being دفع المال (giving the wealth).. and it is with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. في فكّ الرقاب (in freeing the necks); (الواو) conjunction; (أقام) a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (آتى الزكاة) like وآتى المال; (الموفون) conjoined to من آمن by the conjunction, nominative (marfūʿ) like it, the sign of its nominative being the wāw «[Note: It is permissible for it to be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هم (they), and the clause is circumstantial or parenthetical.]», (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle «الموفون», and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إذا) an adverb of future time, stripped of condition, attached to (الموفون), (عاهدوا) a past verb and its fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction; (الصابرين) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being أمدح (I praise), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ; (في البأساء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in الصابرين; (الضرّاء) conjoined to البأساء by the wāw, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (حين) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to what the preceding preposition-phrase is attached to, as it is conjoined to it by the wāw; (البأس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
