(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar; (صدقوا) like عاهدوا; (الواو) conjunction; (أولئك) like the first; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: Or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) having no grammatical position, coming for emphasis, so (المتّقون) is the khabar of أولئك.]», (المتّقون) khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «ليس البرّ أن تولّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تولّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لكنّ البرّ ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «آمن بالله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «آتى المال..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آمن.
The clause «(دفع) في الرقاب» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آتى.
The clause «أقام ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آمن بالله.
The clause «آتى الزكاة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أقام الصلاة.
The clause «عاهدوا» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «(أمدح) الصابرين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause «[Note: Or it is resumptive in itself, because it is cut off for praise.]».
The clause «أولئك الذين صدقوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «صدقوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أولئك» هم المتّقون has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أولئك الذين.
The clause هم المتّقون is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.

* Morphology:
(البرّ), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb برّ يبرّ, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(تولّوا), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is تولّيوا, with ḍamma on the yāʾ: the ḍamma was deemed heavy on the yāʾ, so the yāʾ was made vowelless and its vowel transferred to the lām; then the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and it became تولّوا, its pattern being تفعّوا (verse 115).
(قبل), a noun meaning "direction", meaning "at/with" (عند), and meaning "capacity and ability"; in the verse it comes in the first meaning. Its pattern is فعل, with kasra then fatḥa.
(آتى), it contains iʿlāl by qalb (conversion); its origin is آتي, with a vowelled yāʾ! Then the yāʾ was converted into an alif because it was vowelled and the letter before it had fatḥa. The madda of آتى is converted from two letters, a vowelled hamza and a vowelless hamza; its pattern is أفعل, i.e. its origin is أأتى, because its imperfect is يؤتي.
(المال), a primitive (jāmid) noun for whatever things you own. The alif in it is converted from a wāw; its plural is أموال. The wāw came vowelless after a fatḥa and was converted into an alif, so it contains iʿlāl by qalb. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 155 of this sūra).
(السائلين), plural of السائل, active participle from the triliteral سأل يسأل, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فاعل.
(الرقاب), plural of الرقبة, a noun for the well-known body part (the neck), used metaphorically here for the slave; its pattern is فعلة, with two fatḥas, and the pattern of الرقاب is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(أقام), it contains iʿlāl by qalb; its origin is أقوم on the pattern أفعل, its bare form being قام يقوم. The wāw came vowelled, so it was made vowelless and its vowel transferred to the letter before it, and it became أقوم with fatḥa on the qāf and sukūn on the wāw; then the wāw was converted into an alif because it was originally vowelled and the letter before it had fatḥa, and it became أقام.
(الموفون), plural of الموفي, active participle from the quadriliteral أوفى; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.. In the word (الموفون) there is iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is الموفيون: the yāʾ was deleted because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw.. and every defective noun (manqūṣ) has its yāʾ deleted when it is given a sound plural.
(البأساء), maṣdar of بئس يبأس, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعلاء, with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and like it is البؤس.
(الضرّاء), maṣdar of ضرّ يضرّ, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعلاء.
(البأس), maṣdar of بؤس يبؤس, of the class of كرم; it is used as a primitive noun meaning war and every severe matter. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَفِي الرِّقابِ», i.e. he gave wealth for liberating and freeing the necks, by helping those contracted for manumission (al-mukātabūn), or freeing captives, or buying slaves to set them free. The "neck" is a figurative expression for the person, so it is of the kind of the loose metonymy (al-majāz al-mursal).
2- In the verse there is one of the arts of rhetoric, namely the art of concision (al-ījāz), in His saying:
«وَلكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ»: the speech involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. برّ من آمن (the righteousness of the one who believed), since a body (من آمن) is not predicated of an abstract notion (البر). It is permissible not to resort to omission, and to make the maṣdar mean the active participle, or to say that (البر) is applied to the righteous person (al-bārr) by way of hyperbole; but the first is more fitting.
3- Cutting the follower off from the followed (qaṭʿ al-tābiʿ ʿan al-matbūʿ): its rule is that when attributes of praise or blame are mentioned, the i'rab is varied, as a stylistic variation in speech and to attract attention to the fact that what the described is described with, or the attributes ascribed to him, deserve to command concern; because changing the familiar and customary indicates an increased desire to hear what is mentioned and greater concern. The verse is an example of cutting the follower off from the followed in the case of praise.

safi-cedvel:178-178.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as badal (substitute) of أيّ or its naʿt (adjective); (آمنوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (كتب) a past verb in the passive; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كتب), which includes the meaning of فرض (imposed); (القصاص) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (في القتلى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كتب), and the preposition carries the meaning of causality, i.e. because of those killed; (الحرّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (بالحرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. مقتول بالحرّ (killed for the free) or مأخوذ بالحرّ (taken for the free), and it is a specific existence (kawn khāṣṣ); (الواو) conjunction; (العبد بالعبد) mubtadaʾ and khabar, like الحرّ بالحرّ; (الواو) conjunction; (الأنثى بالأنثى) like الحرّ بالحرّ; (الفاء) resumptive; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: It is permissible — in the opinion of some — for it to be a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause اتّباع بالمعروف, with the fāʾ redundant.]», (عفي) a past verb in the passive, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (عفي), (من أخي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء — a naʿt that has preceded the qualified noun — and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, as it is one of the five nouns; it is with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. من دم أخيه (from the blood of his brother), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شيء) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative «[Note: It is a metonymy for a maṣdar, namely the pardon.]», (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اتّباع) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and its khabar is omitted and fronted before it, i.e. فعليه اتّباع (then upon him is following); (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اتّباع because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a ḥāl of the hāʾ in (عليه), i.e. then upon him is following it while being just.]», (الواو) conjunction; (أداء) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اتّباع, nominative like it; (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to أداء since it is a maṣdar.. and the pronoun refers to the guardian of the one killed; (بإحسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أداء «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a ḥāl of the hāʾ in (عليه), i.e. then upon him is paying it while doing good.]», (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the reference is to the pardon; (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (تخفيف) khabar, nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخفيف), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رحمة) conjoined to تخفيف by the wāw, nominative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) like the first; (اعتدى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (اعتدى), (ذا) a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi, and the reference is to the pardon, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (له) like the first, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كتب عليكم القصاص» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «الحرّ بالحرّ» is in the position of nominative as badal of القصاص, and it is of the type of the badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl).
The clause «العبد بالعبد» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause الحرّ بالحرّ.
The clause «الأنثى بالأنثى» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause الحرّ بالحرّ.
The clause «من عفي..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «عفي له.. شيء» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «(عليه) اتّباع» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ذلك تخفيف» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «من اعتدى» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من عفي له ...
The clause «اعتدى» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause له عذاب is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ «[Note: Or it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) with the fāʾ redundant — if (من) is taken as a relative noun; in that case the clause اعتدى is the ṣila of the relative, having no grammatical position.]».

* Morphology:
(القصاص), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb قاصّه يقاصّه; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(القتلى), plural of قتيل in the sense of مقتول (killed). The plural of فعيل in the sense of مفعول regularly follows the pattern فعلى, like أسير and أسرى, and جريح and جرحى.
(الحرّ), an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb حرّ يحرّ, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(العبد), an adjective resembling the active participle from the verb عبد يعبد, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الأنثى), an adjective resembling the active participle from the verb أنث يأنث, of the class of كرم; its pattern is فعلى, with ḍamma on the fāʾ, or it is the noun from it.
(اتّباع), a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the five-letter verb اتّبع; its pattern is افتعال, on the pattern of its past with kasra on its third letter and an alif added before its last letter. (أداء), a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb (أدّى) يؤدّي; the regular maṣdar is تأدية, because the maṣdar of فعّل is تفعيل; so it came short of the number of the verb's letters and became a noun of maṣdar. It contains the substitution of the yāʾ by a hamza because it came at the end of the word after a vowelless alif.
(المعروف), a noun for the good and kindness a person renders; its pattern is مفعول.
(تخفيف), a regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb خفّف; its pattern is تفعيل, on the pattern of its past with a tāʾ added at its beginning, the khāʾ made vowelless, and a yāʾ added before the last letter.
(اعتدى), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is اعتدي with a vowelled yāʾ at its end: the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif. Its pattern is افتعل.

safi-cedvel:198-198.t:
* I'rab:
(ليس) an incomplete (nāqiṣ), inflexible (jāmid) past verb; (على) preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of laysa; (جناح) the noun of laysa, postponed, nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تبتغوا) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (فضلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (من ربّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبتغوا) [Note: Or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فضلا).], and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبتغوا ...) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being "in that you seek"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of جناح.
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis اذكروا; (أفضتم) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (من عرفات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أفضتم); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اذكروا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (عند) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (اذكروا) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of اذكروا.]; (المشعر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الحرام) naʿt of المشعر, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (اذكروا) like the first, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الكاف) a preposition of causation [Note: i.e. because of His guiding you; it is far-fetched that it be for comparison, so it cannot properly mean "like".]; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (هدى) past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما هداكم) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to (اذكروه), i.e. for the sake of His guiding you.
(الواو) resumptive; (إن) lightened from the heavy (inna), and here it is necessarily inoperative (muhmala) ...
(كنتم) incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (من قبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted element indicated by the word الضالّين, or attached to الضالّين that is mentioned, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) that distinguishes between the negative in and the one lightened from the heavy; (من الضالّين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of kuntum, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تبتغوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «أفضتم.» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اذكروا الله» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «اذكروه» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اذكروا الله.
The clause «كنتم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تبتغوا): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by making a letter quiescent and an iʿlāl by deletion, following the same course as تشتروا in ayah (41); its wazn is تفتعوا.
(أفضتم): it contains an iʿlāl by deletion; its original is أفاضتم — the alif in it being changed from a yāʾ — and when the alif came quiescent before the quiescent ḍād, because of the indeclinable form, it was dropped; its wazn is أفلتم.
(عرفات): a quasi-plural noun (ism jamʿ) used as the name of a specific place, like أذرعات; it is declined as a triptote even though it has two causes (of diptote status) because its tanwīn is the tanwīn of correspondence (muqābala), not the tanwīn of full declension (tamkīn), i.e. this tanwīn is the counterpart of the nūn in (مسلمون) and not evidence of full declension. This name is among the improvised (murtajal) names, except according to the view that its origin is a plural.
(المشعر): the name of a mountain; it was called مشعر, on the pattern of معبد, from الشعار, which is the sign, because it is one of the landmarks of the Hajj.

* Benefits:
1- The word «عرفات» is among the words attached (mulḥaq) to the sound feminine plural. Its due is to be nominative with the ḍamma and accusative and genitive with the kasra. The words attached to the feminine plural are of two kinds:
a- The first: words that have the form of the feminine plural but have no singular from their wording; rather they have a singular from their meaning, such as «أولات» meaning "possessors (fem.)", whose singular is «ذات» meaning "possessor (fem.)". Since the word «أولات» is always in construct, it is parsed with the i'rab of the feminine plural without tanwīn. Like it is the word «اللات», a relative noun for the plural of females, parsed with its i'rab; some make it indeclinable on the kasra, so for them it is a quasi-plural of the word (التي).
b- The second kind of words attached to the sound feminine plural is everything that was a feminine plural or attached to it and then shifted to become a proper name of a man, a woman, a place or the like; among its examples are «سعادات وزينبات، وعنايات، ونعمات، وعرفات، وأذرعات». Their wording is the wording of the feminine plural, but they are applied to a single thing, whether masculine or feminine. In the i'rab of this last kind of noun there are three views: the first parses it with the i'rab of the sound feminine plural with tanwīn; the second parses it with the i'rab of the sound feminine plural but without tanwīn; the third parses it with the i'rab of the diptote: nominative with the ḍamma, and accusative and genitive with the fatḥa, but without tanwīn.
All three opinions are permissible, but preference goes to the last opinion, and we urge using it rather than the others.
2- People often ask about the Hajj if some benefit results from it, such as someone trading during the Hajj or someone hiring himself out during the Hajj, whether for service or to perform Hajj on behalf of another who was unable to perform it, and other such benefits. To answer this question we cite these hadiths:
a- Al-Bukhārī narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās; he said: ʿUkāẓ, Majanna and Dhū al-Majāz were markets in the Jāhiliyya, and people felt it sinful to trade during the season, so there was revealed «ليس عليكم جناح أن تبتغوا فضلا من ربكم» in the seasons of the Hajj.
b-
In a narration from Abū Umāma al-Taymī, he said: I said to Ibn ʿUmar: We hire out (our animals); is there Hajj for us? He said: Do you not circumambulate the House, come to al-Maʿrūf, stone the stones [Translator's note: the source has «وتأتون بالمعروف» and «الحجار»; known versions of this narration read «وتأتون المعرَّف» (i.e. ʿArafāt) and «وترمون الجمار» (the pillars).] and shave your heads? He said: We said: Yes. So Ibn ʿUmar said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him about what you asked me, and he did not answer him until Jibrīl came down to him with this ayah: «ليس عليكم جناح أن تبتغوا فضلا من ربكم».
Thus the permissibility of selling, buying and hiring during the Hajj was revealed, and the Qur'an called it seeking of the bounty of Allah, so that whoever engages in it feels that he is seeking of the bounty of Allah when he trades, when he works for a wage, and when he pursues the means of livelihood; he is only seeking of the bounty of Allah.

safi-cedvel:199-199.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) conjunction; (أفيضوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من) preposition; (حيث) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أفيضوا); (أفاض) past verb; (الناس) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) conjunction; (استغفروا) like أفيضوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of (إنّ), accusative; (غفور) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «أفيضوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اذكروا الله in the previous ayah.
The clause «أفاض الناس» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «استغفروا الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أفيضوا.
The clause «إنّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(أفاض): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by substitution; its original is أفيض: the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the ḍād, then it was changed to alif because what precedes it is now with fatḥa and it was originally vowelled.

safi-cedvel:200-200.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb اذكروا; (قضيتم) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (مناسك) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اذكروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كذكر) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a remembrance like your remembrance" [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in اذكروا, i.e. "remember, going to great lengths, like your remembrance".], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (آباء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) a conjunction for choice, or for permission, or meaning "and"; (أشدّ) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ذكر, genitive (majrūr) like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, due to being an adjective and on the pattern أفعل [Note: The i'rab above was chosen by al-ʿUkbarī. As for al-Jalāl, he has another explanation in which he agreed with Abū Ḥayyān: the word (أشدّ) is accusative as a ḥāl of the word (ذكرا) that comes after it, which is the mafʿūl muṭlaq of the verb اذكروا الله; the word أشد is a naʿt (adjective) of the mentioned maṣdar, and when it was placed before it, it was parsed as a ḥāl, i.e. "remember Allah with a remembrance similar to your remembrance of your fathers, or a stronger remembrance". On this basis the preposition and its genitive noun (كذكركم) is also a ḥāl of the word (ذكرا) mentioned, and it too is a naʿt placed before what it qualifies. And each has a direction.], (ذكرا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; the meaning is: "be stronger in remembrance of Allah than you are of your fathers". (الفاء) resumptive; (من الناس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), placed first; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: This is the apparent reading, but soundness of meaning and eloquence of expression call for making the preposition and its genitive noun a naʿt of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "some of the people are those who say..", and (من) may be a relative noun, or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and it is in the position of nominative as khabar.]; (يقول) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), and it is the referent (ʿāʾid); (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative; (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the vocative particle has been omitted; (آت) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (You); (في الدنيا) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the omitted (second) object of آت, i.e. "give us our share, obtained in this world"; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative, inoperative (muhmala); (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (في الآخرة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of خلاق; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (خلاق) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «قضيتم.» is in the position of genitive by the annexation of إذا to it.
The clause «اذكروا الله» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «من الناس» من يقول has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقول..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause), or it is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of من.
The clause «النداء وجوابها» (the vocative and its response) is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «آتنا في الدنيا» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «ما له في الآخرة من خلاق» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a resumptive clause, i.e. "so he is given, and he has no.. share".

* Morphology:
(ذكر): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ذكر يذكر, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(آتنا): in the word there is a change (iʿlāl) by deletion because of the indeclinable form in the imperative; its original in the imperfect is يؤتي. The yāʾ — the weak letter — was dropped because the verb is indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter. Its wazn is أفعنا (see ayah 43 of this sūra to learn the composition of the madd).

* Rhetoric:
- «أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْراً», i.e. remember Allah with a remembrance like your remembrance of your fathers, or like a remembrance stronger and more intense than it; this is by making the remembrance itself a rememberer, by way of rational metaphor (majāz ʿaqlī).

* Benefits:
1- His saying: أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْراً. The grammarians have stood up and sat down over the i'rab of this conjunction; they tried to clarify it but made it obscure and threw the student into perplexity. Some of them made the conjunction to the «الكاف», some made it to «الآباء», some conjoined «أشد» to «الذكر» itself, and some said: the speech is construed according to the meaning, the implied form being «or be in remembrance of Allah like yourselves toward your fathers». As for Abū Ḥayyān, he reviewed these opinions and judged them weak, then said: «As long as it is possible for us to construe the ayah as their being commanded to remember Allah with a remembrance equal to the remembrance of their fathers or stronger, it would have been more fitting for them to make «أشدّ» accusative as a ḥāl because it came first; had it come later it would have been a naʿt of His saying «ذكرا», as in the poet's saying:
لميّه موحشا طلل ... يلوح كأنه خلل.
(Mayya has a desolate ruin that gleams as though it were the ornamented sheath of a sword.)

Had موحشا come later it would have been a naʿt of الطلل, but when it came first it became a ḥāl; so consider ...
2- The reader at first glance thinks that Allah asks the pilgrim to remember Him as he remembers his father, his mother and his relatives, but the matter is not so: in the markets of the Jāhiliyya they used to boast of their fathers and forefathers and mention their exploits and virtues, so Allah wanted them to change this bad custom for a better and more upright custom, which is to remember Allah instead of occupying themselves with mentioning fathers and forefathers.

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(صمّ) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هم (they). (بكم) a second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ). (عمي) a third khabar, nominative. (الفاء) a conjunction. (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (لا) negative. (يرجعون) imperfect, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «هم صمّ» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «هم لا يرجعون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause and connected with it by a link of causality.
The clause «لا يرجعون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(صمّ) plural of أصمّ, ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from صمّ يصمّ, of the class of فتح; its pattern is أفعل, and صمّ is on the pattern فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn. Likewise every adjective on the pattern أفعل has its regular (qiyāsī) plural on the pattern فعل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(بكم) plural of أبكم, ṣifa mushabbaha from بكم يبكم, of the class of فرح; its pattern is أفعل, and بكم is on the pattern فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(عمي) ṣifa mushabbaha from عمي يعمى, of the class of فرح; its pattern is أفعل, and عمي is on the pattern فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Is what is in the noble verse called a metaphor (istiʿāra)?
In fact it is disputed. The verifying scholars call it an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh), not a metaphor, because the one for whom the term is borrowed is mentioned, namely the hypocrites. Metaphor is applied only where mention of the one for whom the term is borrowed is folded away, and the speech is made free of it, fit to be taken as meaning what it has been transferred to, were it not for the indication of the circumstances or the drift of the speech.

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(أو) a conjunction [Note: either for doubt, or for choice, or for permission, or for vagueness.]. (كصيّب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being مثلهم (their likeness); and in the speech there is the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "their likeness is like the people of a rainstorm" [Note: The kāf may be a noun in the sense of مثل, in which case it is in the position of the nominative, either conjoined to the kāf in كمثل, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.]. (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (صيّب). (في) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (ظلمات) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو) is a conjunction in the two successive places. (رعد، برق) two nouns conjoined to ظلمات, nominative like it. (يجعلون) imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent). (أصابع) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (في آذان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجعلون) by its being made to include the meaning of يضعون (they put), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (من الصواعق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجعلون), and (من) is causal [Note: The preposition and its genitive noun here are in the place of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).]. (حذر) mafʿūl li-ajlihi, accusative [Note: Or an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they beware with a bewaring like the bewaring of death", the maṣdar being put in construct with the object.]. (الموت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) resumptive or parenthetical. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (محيط) khabar, nominative. (بالكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (محيط); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, and (النون) is a compensation for the tanwīn in the singular noun.
The clause «(مثلهم) كصيّب» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in verse 17.
The clause «فيه ظلمات» is in the position of the genitive as a second naʿt of (صيّب) [Note: It may be in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), because the indefinite noun here has been described; but what governs the ḥāl is the ibtidāʾ (the state of being a subject).].
The clause «يجعلون ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāfiyya bayāniyya).
The clause «الله محيط بالكافرين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical [Note: Parenthesis is according to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, since he made the clause يجعلون أصابعهم and the clause يكاد البرق one thing, because they are from one story.]

* Morphology:
(صيّب) a derived adjective on the pattern فيعل, from صاب المطر يصوب, i.e. "the rain poured down". In the word there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is صيوب, with sukūn on the yāʾ and kasra on the wāw. The yāʾ and the wāw met in the word, the first of them being vowelless, so the wāw was converted to yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ, and it became صيّب.
(السماء) a primitive (jāmid) noun in which the wāw was converted to hamza, because it is derived from السمو. Every wāw or yāʾ that comes final after a vowelless alif is converted to hamza.
(رعد) a primitive noun in the sense of الراعد (the thundering), or a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رعد يرعد, of the class of نصر and the class of فتح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(برق) a primitive noun in the sense of البارق (the flashing), or a heard maṣdar of the verb برق يبرق, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أصابعهم) plural of إصبع, a noun for the well-known member. Nine dialectal forms are valid in its pronunciation: with fatḥa on the hamza and fatḥa, ḍamma or kasra on the bāʾ; with ḍamma on the hamza and fatḥa, ḍamma or kasra on the bāʾ; and with kasra on the hamza and fatḥa, ḍamma or kasra on the bāʾ.
(آذان) plural of أذن, a noun for the well-known organ; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma on the hamza and sukūn or ḍamma on the dhāl.
(الصواعق) plural of صاعقة, a primitive noun from the verb صعق, on the pattern of the active participle.
(حذر) a heard maṣdar of the verb حذر يحذر, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(الموت) a heard maṣdar of the verb مات يموت, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(محيط) active participle of the four-letter verb أحاط; it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last. In the word there is iʿlāl by taskīn (making vowelless) and by qalb: its origin is محوط with kasra on the wāw; the kasra was felt heavy on the wāw, so it was made vowelless and its vowel transferred to the ḥāʾ — iʿlāl by taskīn — then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because it is vowelless and preceded by a kasra, and it became محيط — this is iʿlāl by qalb. It also contains the deletion of the hamza from its beginning, because its verb is on the pattern أفعل.
(الكافرين) plural of الكافر, active participle of كفر يكفر, of the class of نصر, on the pattern فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the saying of the Exalted أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ. It is a representation of their state following a representation, so that the exposition may cover every fine and great aspect of it and give it its due of making it hideous and dreadful. For their diversification in the kinds of unbelief and error, and their moving in them from state to state, deserves that parables be struck concerning it, that the reins of speech be [Translator's note: printed يرضى; probably يُرخى, "slackened"] in its race-course, that the tent-ropes of elaboration be stretched out for explaining it, and that chapters and sections be devoted to it; since every speech that has a share of eloquence and a portion of forcefulness and excellence must give each of the two stations of elaboration (al-iṭnāb) and concision (al-ījāz) its due.
2- The non-metaphorical figure (al-majāz al-mursal): in the saying of the Exalted يَجْعَلُونَ أَصابِعَهُمْ فِي آذانِهِمْ.
Here the fingers are used to express their fingertips, and what is meant is some of them, because they put only some of their fingertips. It is of the type of using the whole and meaning the part.
It is a wondrous scene, full of movement, mixed with agitation; in it there is wandering and straying, terror and fright, lights and echoes. It is a sensory scene symbolising a psychological state, and it embodies an emotional image as if it were a perceptible scene.

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(بئس): a past verb, inflexible (jāmid), for expressing blame. (ما): an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun that is the fāʿil (agent) of biʾsa, i.e. "evil is the thing, as a thing they bought ...". (اشتروا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اشتروا), by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "exchanged" (استبدلوا). (أنفس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, (أن): a maṣdarī and subjunctive particle. (يكفروا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause بئس.., and it is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) [Note: Or the khabar of a necessarily omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", and the clause بئس.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
(الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكفروا). (أنزل): a past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (بغيا): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.], (أن): like the first. (ينزّل): an imperfect verb, accusative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (من فضل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينزل), and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أن) and the verb is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being على أن ينزّل.., attached to (بغيا).
(على): a preposition. (من): a relative noun [Note: It may be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, i.e. "upon a man upon whom Allah wills its sending down".] in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to (ينزل), (يشاء): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من عباد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted pronoun in (يشاء), i.e. "upon whom He wills its sending down upon him from among His servants", and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (باءوا): a verb and its fāʿil. (بغضب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the wāw in (باءوا), i.e. "they returned clothed in wrath", i.e. as ones upon whom there is wrath. (على غضب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the first (غضب). (الواو): resumptive. (للكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (عذاب): a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (مهين): a naʿt of (عذاب), nominative like it.
The clause «بئسما ... » is in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar of the one specified for blame (أن يكفروا ...).
The clause «اشتروا» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما) [Note: (ما) may be a definite noun in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of biʾsa, and the clause after it has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of mā.. There are other ways of parsing mā which there is no need to mention, because they involve artificiality and much far-fetched interpretation.]. The clause «أنزل الله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «باءوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the nominal resumptive clause أن يكفروا بما أنزل الله بئسما اشتروا به أنفسهم.
The clause «للكافرين عذاب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بغيا): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb بغى يبغي, paradigm ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other maṣdars of the verb: بغاء with ḍamma on the bāʾ, بغي with ḍamma on the bāʾ, and بغية with ḍamma or kasra on the bāʾ.
(عباده): plural of عبد, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) for a human being, whether free or owned, from the verb عبد يعبد, paradigm نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(غضب): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb غضب يغضب, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas (see verse 61 of this sūra).
(مهين): an active participle from the quadriliteral أهان, so it is on the measure of its imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving kasra to the letter before the last. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is مهون, because it is taken from الهوان: the kasra on the wāw was found heavy, so it was given sukūn and the vowel was transferred to the hāʾ — this is iʿlāl by vowel-removal (taskīn) — then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because of its sukūn and the kasra before it, giving مهين.

safi-cedvel:91-91.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the answer قالوا. (قيل): a passive past verb. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قيل), (آمنوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (آمنوا), (أنزل): a past verb. (الله): fāʿil, nominative. (قالوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (نؤمن): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (بما): like the first, attached to (نؤمن), (أنزل): a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على): a preposition, and (نا): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزل), (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (يكفرون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بما): like the first, attached to (يكفرون), (وراء): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الحق): khabar (predicate), nominative. (مصدّقا): a confirming ḥāl of the pronoun of الحقّ. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (مصدّقا) [Note: The lām may be considered redundant, for strengthening; then (ما) is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle (مصدّقا). See verse (41) of this sūra.], (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما, and (هم): an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الفاء): connecting the answer of an implied condition. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (تقتلون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أنبياء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (تقتلون), because it has the meaning of قتلتم. (إن): a jussive conditional particle [Note: It may be a particle of negation, i.e. "you were not believers".. (said by al-Jamal in his Ḥāshiya on al-Jalālayn).], (كنتم): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive.. and (تم): an attached pronoun, the ism of kāna. (مؤمنين): the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قيل ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (إذا) to it.
The clause «آمنوا» is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil [Note: See verse (11) of this sūra, where there is a comment on the reasons calling for the clause to be considered a nāʾib fāʿil, contrary to some grammarians.].
The clause «أنزل الله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative (ما).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نؤمن» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «أنزل علينا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of قالوا, which is the governor, i.e. "they said that while they disbelieve".
The clause «هو الحقّ» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of (ما).
The clause «قل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تقتلون» is in the position of jussive as the answer to an implied condition, joined with the fāʾ, i.e. "if you are thus, then why do you kill".. and the implied conditional clause together with its answer is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, namely His saying: لم تقتلون.

* Morphology:
(وراء): there are two views about the hamza in it. The first is that it is original; Ibn Jinnī held this view, taking as evidence its retention in the diminutive, in their saying وريئة. The second is that it is converted from a yāʾ, because of their saying تواريت; and it cannot be converted from a wāw, because a word whose fāʾ is a wāw does not have a wāw as its lām except rarely.
(الحقّ): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb حقّ يحق, paradigm ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 26).

safi-cedvel:92-92.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (جاء): a past verb, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (موسى): fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (بالبيّنات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاءكم) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of موسى.], (ثمّ): conjunction. (اتّخذتم): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (تم): an attached pronoun, fāʿil. (العجل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. The second object is omitted, its implied form being "إلها" (as a god).. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اتّخذ), and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (أنتم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (ظالمون): khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw..
The clause «جاءكم موسى» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath, and the oath clause is conjoined to a preceding resumption.
The clause «اتّخذتم ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جاءكم.
The clause «أنتم ظالمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(جاءكم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: the yāʾ was converted to an alif because it came voweled after a fatḥa. Its origin is جيأ, with fatḥa on the yāʾ, and its imperfect is يجيء.
(العجل): a primitive (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:230-230.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (طلّق) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (ها) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) negating; (تحلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحلّ); (من) a preposition; (بعد) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (تحلّ); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition, in the sense of إلّا; (تنكح) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by a concealed (أن), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (زوجا) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (غيره) a naʿt (adjective) of زوج, accusative like it, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنكح) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (تحلّ).
(الفاء) a conjunction; (إن طلّقها) like the first, and the fāʿil refers to the second husband; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (على) a preposition and (هما) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يتراجعا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الألف) a pronoun, the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتراجعا) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being في, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to the omitted khabar of lā.
(إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (ظنّ) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and (الألف) a pronoun, the fāʿil; (أن) like the first; (يقيما) like يتراجعا.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقيما) is in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi of (ظنّ), and the second object is implied, i.e. if the two think the keeping of the limits of Allah will come about [Note: The interpreted maṣdar may stand in place of both objects of ظنّ.]; (حدود) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (تلك حدود الله) its i'rab was given in the preceding ayah; (يبيّن) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو", and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبيّن); (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «طلقها» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا تحل» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هي", i.e. فهي لا تحلّ له.. and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تنكح has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «طلّقها (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first clause طلّقها.
The clause «لا جناح عليهما» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يتراجعا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ظنّا» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.. and the apodosis clause is omitted, indicated by what preceded, i.e.: if the two think they will keep the limits of Allah, then there is no blame on them in returning to each other.
The clause «يقيما» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تلك حدود الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يبيّنها» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of حدود الله.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of قوم.

* Benefits:
1- A man would divorce a woman and leave her until her waiting period was nearly over, then take her back, not out of need but to lengthen the waiting period upon her; this is the "retaining to cause harm".
2- There are views about a marriage contracted on the condition of making the woman lawful (taḥlīl). Sufyān, al-Awzāʿī, Abū ʿUbayd, Mālik and others held that it is not permissible.
It is reported from the Prophet ﷺ that he cursed the one who makes lawful (al-muḥallil) and the one for whom it is made lawful (al-muḥallal lahu),
and from ʿUmar, may Allah be pleased with him: "No muḥallil or muḥallal lahu will be brought to me but I will stone them both."

safi-cedvel:231-231.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (طلّق) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (النساء) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) a conjunction; (بلغن) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (النون) a pronoun, the fāʿil; (أجل) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أمسكوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and (هنّ) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of أمسكوهنّ, i.e. being engaged in what is right; (أو) a conjunction of choice; (سرّحوا) like أمسكوا, and (هنّ) mafʿūl bihi; (بمعروف) like the first, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of سرّحوهنّ; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تمسكوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هنّ) mafʿūl bihi; (ضرارا) a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: al-Jamal said in his Ḥāshiya on the Jalālayn: it is not permissible to make it a second cause — i.e. it is not permissible to attach it to the verb — because the mafʿūl li-ajlihi is not multiplied except by conjunction, and that is absent here.]; (اللام) of cause; (تعتدوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by a concealed (أن), the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and.. the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعتدوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (ضرارا).
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يفعل) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (قد) a particle of realization; (ظلم) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (نفس) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (لا تتّخذوا) like لا تمسكوا; (آيات) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (هزوا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (اذكروا) like أمسكوا; (نعمة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of نعمة الله [Note: Or attached to the maṣdar نعمة, i.e.: that Allah bestowed favour upon you.]; (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to نعمة [Note: (ما) may be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يعظكم.]; (أنزل) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (عليكم) like the first, attached to (أنزل); (من الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the implied object of أنزل, i.e. what He sent down to you of the Book; (الواو) a conjunction; (الحكمة) conjoined to الكتاب, genitive like it; (يعظ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يعظ). (الواو) resumptive; (اتّقوا) like أمسكوا; (الله) the word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (اعلموا) like أمسكوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative; (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عليم) the khabar (predicate) of أنّ, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar from أنّ, its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «طلّقتم النساء» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «بلغن ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause طلّقتم.
The clause «أمسكوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «سرّحوهن» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أمسكوهنّ.
The clause «لا تمسكوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أمسكوهنّ.
The clause «تعتدوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «من يفعل» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, carrying the sense of giving a reason.
The clause «يفعل ذلك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.].
The clause «قد ظلم نفسه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا تتّخذوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It may be conjoined to the clause (لا تمسكوهنّ.), so that the clause (من يفعل.) is parenthetical.].
The clause «اذكروا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
The clause «أنزل عليكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يعظكم به» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of أنزل or of its object.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اعلموا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.

* Morphology:
(أجلهنّ): maṣdar of the triliteral أجل يأجل (category فرح); its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(ضرارا): maṣdar of ضارّ, which means ضرّ (to harm).. and ضارّ امرأته also means: he took a co-wife (ضرّة, with fatḥa on the ḍād) over her.
(هزوا): lightened from هزؤا, the maṣdar of هزأ and هزئ — with fatḥa or kasra on the zāy — بفلان and منه (to mock someone) [Note: There are other maṣdars of the verb: هزءا, with fatḥa or ḍamma on the hāʾ, هزؤا, and مهزأة.].
(يعظكم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the first radical of the verb was deleted; its original form is يوعظكم, because it is an assimilated verb (mithāl) with kasra on the ʿayn; its pattern is يعلكم.
(عليم): an adjective on the pattern فعيل; it comes in the sense of permanence, so it is an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha), even though it is formed from a transitive verb, because it is one of the attributes of Allah, Mighty and Majestic (and see ayah 29).

safi-cedvel:232-232.t:
* I'rab:
(وإذا طلّقتم النساء فبلغن أجلهنّ) its i'rab has passed, in its words and its clauses [Note: In ayah (231).], and (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تعضلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (ينكحن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative.. and (النون) the fāʿil; (أزواج) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (هنّ) muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينكحن) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being من أن ينكحن, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعضلوهنّ).
(إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis; (تراضوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the deleted alif.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تراضوا), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تراضوا) [Note: Or to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. a mutual agreement by what is right; it may also be attached to (ينكحن), in the view of Abū Ḥayyān.]; (ذا) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (يوعظ) a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يوعظ); (من) a relative noun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (كان) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to من; (من) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (يؤمن), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to من; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمن); (اليوم) conjoined by the wāw to the word of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الآخر) a naʿt (adjective) of اليوم, genitive like it; (ذلكم) like ذلك; (أزكى) a khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (لكم) like منكم, attached to أزكى; (أطهر) conjoined by the wāw to أزكى, nominative like it; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (الواو) a conjunction; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (لا) negating; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لا تعضلوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ينكحن أزواجهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «تراضوا» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis is omitted, explained by the absence of preventing (ʿaḍl) [Note: The adverb (إذا) may be stripped of the conditional sense, and then it is attached to the mentioned (يعضلوهنّ) or to (ينكحن).].
The clause «ذلك يوعظ..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يوعظ به من..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.
The clause «كان منكم يؤمن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative من.
The clause «يؤمن بالله» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.
The clause «ذلكم أزكى» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله يعلم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعلم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «أنتم لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الله يعلم.
The clause «لا تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.

* Morphology:
(تراضوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the quiescent alif was deleted before the quiescent wāw of the plural, and the fatḥa was left on the letter before the wāw as an indication of the deleted alif; its pattern is تفاعوا. The deleted alif was originally a wāw, because its heard (samāʿī) maṣdar is الرضوان.
(أزكى): the alif in the word was originally a wāw, because the verb is زكا يزكو; it is written as an undotted yāʾ because it is the fourth letter. The pattern of أزكى is أفعل, either because it is an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) in its original sense, with the thing surpassed omitted, i.e. it is purer than anything else, or because it is an adjective stripped of the elative sense, i.e. it is pure and clean.
(أطهر): an elative noun from طهر يطهر (category نصر and category كرم); its pattern is أفعل, and the thing surpassed is omitted, i.e. cleaner than anything else.. It may be an adjective stripped of the elative sense, i.e. it is clean.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَإِذا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّساءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ», i.e. the end of their term; this is a figurative usage (majāz) of the type of using the whole for the part, if we say that الأجل literally denotes the entire term.
2- «أَنْ يَنْكِحْنَ أَزْواجَهُنَّ»: calling those who divorced them "husbands" is a majāz mursal (metonymic figure) whose relation is consideration of what was

safi-cedvel:179-179.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (في القصاص) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of حياة — an adjective that has preceded the qualified noun; (حياة) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يا) a vocative particle; (أولي) the one addressed (munādā), in a construct, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, as it is assimilated to the masculine plural; (الألباب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) a pronoun, the noun of laʿalla; (تتقون) an imperfect verb, nominative.
And the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «لكم في القصاص حياة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause كتب عليكم ... «[Note: In verse (178) of this sūra.]».
The clause «يا أولي الألباب» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «لعلّكم تتّقون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya), either for what is mentioned, namely making retribution a life, or for an omitted element whose implied form is "that was legislated for you".
The clause «تتّقون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الألباب), plural of اللبّ, a noun for the intellect or the heart; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn, and the pattern of ألباب is أفعال.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصاصِ حَياةٌ»: this is speech of the utmost eloquence. The most concise speech they had on this meaning was "killing is the best preventer of killing" (القتل أنفى للقتل), and this speech is preferred to it in several respects:
First: the fewness of letters.
Second: general validity (al-iṭṭirād): in every retribution there is life, whereas not every killing is the best preventer of killing, for killing unjustly invites more killing.
Third: what the tanwīn of «حياة» carries of kind (naw ʿiyya) or magnification (taʿẓīm).
Fourth: the feature of antithesis (al-ṭibāq) between retribution and life, for «retribution» is the taking away of life, so it is its opposite.
Fifth: explicitly stating what is sought in itself — I mean life — for the negation of killing is sought only for its sake, not for its own.
Sixth: the strangeness, in that a thing is made to be found within its opposite.
Seventh: freedom from repetition along with closeness (of the elements).
Eighth: the sweetness and fluency of the expression, since it does not have what their saying has of a succession of light syllables (al-asbāb al-khafīfa), for in their saying there are not two vowelled letters in succession except in one place, and there is no doubt that this reduces the fluency of the expression and its flow on the tongue.
Unlike the verse of the Qur'an.
Ninth: its freedom from what the outward form of their saying suggests, namely that a thing is a cause of its own negation — which is impossible.
Tenth: the definiteness of «القصاص» with the generic lām, indicating the reality of this ruling, which includes striking, wounding, killing and other things. So glory be to Him whose word is exalted and whose sign is dazzling.

safi-cedvel:180-180.t:
* I'rab:
(كتب عليكم) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (178) of this sūra.]», (إذا) an adverb of future time including the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis «[Note: It is permissible for it to be purely adverbial and attached to الوصيّة, i.e.: that one of you make a bequest at the time death is present.]», (حضر) a past verb including the meaning of أتى (came); (أحد) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الموت) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the causes of death; (إن) a relative particle «[Translator's note: so in the source (حرف موصول); إن here is the conditional particle.]»; (ترك) a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (خيرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الوصيّة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative «[Note: It is permissible to parse الوصيّة as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is للوالدين, and the clause then becomes the apodosis of the condition with the fāʾ omitted.. and the nāʾib fāʿil is the preposition and its genitive noun (عليكم).]», (للوالدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الوصيّة, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (الأقربين) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الوالدين by the wāw, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second ḥāl of الوصيّة; (حقّا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it is its adjective, i.e. إيصاء حقّا (a true bequeathing) or كتبا حقّا (a true prescribing), or emphasising the content of الحمد «[Translator's note: so in the source; probably meant: the content of the clause.]», i.e. حق ذلك حقا (that is truly due); (على المتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حقّا) or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (حقّا).
The clause «كتب عليكم ... الوصيّة» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause حضر أحدكم الموت is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the apodosis of إذا is omitted, i.e. فليوص (then let him make a bequest).
The clause «ترك خيرا» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.

* Morphology:
(خيرا), a noun for wealth; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الوصيّة), the noun from الإيصاء, or it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the quadriliteral وصّى, because its regular maṣdar is توصية..
(الأقربين), plural of الأقرب, a noun meaning "near", on the pattern أفعل.

safi-cedvel:181-181.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (بدّل) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), i.e. the bequeathing; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بدّل), (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (سمع) a past verb and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما سمعه) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّما) the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect; (إثم) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (يبدّلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (سميع) the khabar of inna, nominative; (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «من بدّله ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause كتب عليكم ...
The clause «بدّله» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «إنّما إثمه على الذين» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يبدّلونه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative الذين.
The clause «إنّ الله سميع» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
- «فَإِنَّما إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ»: the relative is put in the place of the pronoun referring back to من, to emphasise the announcement that what lies within the scope of the first ṣila is the cause; and the plural is preferred to signal the multiplicity of the alterers in kinds, or their great number as individuals, and to announce that the sin encompasses all the individuals.

safi-cedvel:182-182.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خاف) a past verb in the position of jussive, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (من موص) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خاف), since it is made to include the meaning of علم (knew) «[Note: It is permissible to attach it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (جنفا) — an adjective that has preceded the qualified noun.]», and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the deleted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (manqūṣ); (جنفا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أو) a conjunction; (إثما) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (جنفا), accusative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (أصلح) like خاف; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أصلح), and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إثم) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (إنّ الله غفور رحيم) like إنّ الله سميع عليم «[Note: In the previous verse.]».
The clause «من خاف..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من بدّله «[Note: In the previous verse.]». The clause «خاف..» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ من «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «أصلح بينهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause خاف.
The clause «لا إثم عليه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(خاف), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is خوف, its maṣdar being الخوف: the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.
(موص), active participle from the quadriliteral أوصى; its pattern is «[Translator's note: the pattern is missing in the source.]»; it contains iʿlāl by deletion. Its origin is الموصي: the yāʾ was deleted from it to suit the tanwīn, through the meeting of two vowelless letters. It also contains the deletion of the hamza from its beginning: by analogy it would be المؤوصي, with ḍamma on the mīm, fatḥa on the hamza and sukūn on the wāw; the hamza was deemed heavy and deleted, and it became الموصي.
(جنفا), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb جنف يجنف, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
The meaning of خاف is "expected" and "knew". The thing may be thought likely to occur or known to occur, so it is used for both at a second level; and because the first is more frequent, its use in it is more evident. Moreover, its origin is to be used for thinking or knowing something dreaded, and its application may be broadened to the unrestricted sense. It was taken as figurative (majāz) here only because there is no sense in fearing deviation and sin after the bequest has taken place.

safi-cedvel:183-183.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا كتب عليكم الصيام) the i'rab of its like has preceded, both the words and the clauses «[Note: See verse (178) of this sūra.]», (الكاف) a preposition of likening; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a relative noun in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الصيام, i.e.: fasting has been prescribed for you, being similar to that which was prescribed for those before you; or it is the naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: fasting has been prescribed as a fast similar to that which was prescribed for those before you.]», (كتب) a past verb in the passive, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), i.e. the fasting; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كتب).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كتب) is in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. a prescribing like its prescribing upon those before you.
(من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) the noun of laʿalla; (تتقّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «كتب على الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The clause «لعلّكم تتّقون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
