The clause «يسألونك عن اليتامى» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يسألونك عن الخمر in the previous ayah.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إصلاح لهم خير» is the mafʿūl bihi of (قل), in the position of accusative.
The clause «إن تخالطوهم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إصلاح..
The clause «(هم) إخوانكم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «الله يعلم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعلم..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «لو شاء الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الله يعلم.
The clause «أعنتكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ الله عزيز» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(إصلاح): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أصلح; its wazn is إفعال with kasra on the hamza.
(إخوانكم): plural of أخ, a noun whose third radical (lām) has been dropped; its original is أخو, because its dual is أخوان; its wazn is فع.
(المفسد): active participle from the quadriliteral أفسد; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(المصلح): active participle from the quadriliteral أصلح; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:196-196.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أتموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الحجّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (العمرة) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الحج by the wāw, accusative like it; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أتمّوا) (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussivizing particle of condition; (أحصرتم) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being واجب عليكم (is incumbent upon you) «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: الواجب ما استيسر (what is incumbent is whatever is easy).. It is also permissible for ما to be in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being اهدوا (offer) or أدّوا (render).]», (استيسر) a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو); (من الهدي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of استيسر; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تحلقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (رؤوس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يبلغ) an imperfect verb, accusative by an (أن) implied (muḍmara) after حتّى; (الهدي) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the overt ḍamma; (محلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلغ ...) is in the position of genitive, attached to (تحلقوا).
The clause «أتمّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أحصرتم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause أتمّوا ...
The clause «(واجب عليكم) ما استيسر» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «استيسر» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تحلقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يبلغ الهدى ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative أن.
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كان) a defective past verb in the position of jussive as protasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the noun of kāna; (مريضا) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (أو) a conjunction; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (أذى) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (من رأس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أذى, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (فدية) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and its khabar is omitted, its implied form being عليه فدية (upon him is a ransom); (من صيام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of فدية; (أو) a conjunction; (صدقة) conjoined to صيام, genitive like it, and likewise (نسك).
The clause «من كان منكم مريضا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تحلقوا..
The clause «كان منكم مريضا» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]». The clause «به أذى» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the khabar of kāna.
The clause «(عليه) فدية» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time including the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis, which is the meaning of settledness (al-istiqrār), i.e. فعليه ما استيسر (then upon him is whatever is easy), i.e. the offering is settled upon him; (أمنتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition إذا; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī allows it to be taken as a relative noun, with the khabar being the clause ما استيسر من الهدي, the fāʾ being redundant.]» in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (تمتّع) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as protasis, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (بالعمرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تمتّع), (إلى الحجّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of تمتّع, i.e. he enjoyed, continuing in the enjoyment until the Hajj; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition من; (ما استيسر من الهدي) like the first in the same verse; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) like the first; (لم) a particle of negation «[Note: It is better for (لم) to be for negation only, so that the future sense remains, encompassing the condition, and the jussive is the effect of the conditional noun.]», (يجد) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition من; (صيام) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being عليه صيام (upon him is a fast); (ثلاثة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (أيّام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (في الحجّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صيام; (الواو) conjunction; (سبعة) conjoined to ثلاثة, genitive like it; (إذا) an adverb of future time, stripped of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to صيام; (رجعتم) a past verb and its fāʿil.
The clause «إذا أمنتم ...», consisting of the condition, its protasis and its apodosis, has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من كان منكم مريضا..
The clause «أمنتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «من تمتّع..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition, namely إذا.
The clause «تمتّع بالعمرة» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «(عليه) ما استيسر..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (من), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من لم يجد» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the conditional clause فمن تمتّع, and the clause «لم يجد» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «2».
The clause «(عليه) صيام..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «رجعتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ that is deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (عشرة) khabar, nominative; (كاملة) naʿt of عشرة, nominative like it; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the reference is to the ruling mentioned, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (اللام) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذا; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (to the past) and jussive; (يكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive; (أهل) the noun of yakun, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (حاضري) the khabar of yakun, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, and the nūn was deleted because of the construct; (المسجد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الحرام) naʿt of المسجد, genitive like it.
The clause «تلك عشرة كاملة» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «ذلك لمن لم يكن..» has no grammatical position, being an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لم يكن أهله..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative «[Note: Or in the position of genitive as naʿt of (من), on the view that it is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.]».
(الواو) resumptive; (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) like اتّقوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (شديد) khabar, nominative; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar fills the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: It is permissible to conjoin it to the clause أتموا الحجّ at the opening of the verse.]».
The clause «اعلموا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.

* Morphology:
(العمرة), a maṣdar, or a noun for the acts of the lesser pilgrimage; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(الهدي), plural of هدية, on the measure of تمرة; a noun for the animal that the pilgrim or the one performing ʿumra drives as a gift to the people of the Sanctuary; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(رؤوس), plural of رأس, a primitive (jāmid) noun for what lies above the neck, at its top or front; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other plurals: أرؤس, روس and آراس. The pattern of رؤوس is فعول, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(محلّه), a noun of place — or time — from حلّ يحلّ, of the class of ضرب, i.e. to come out of the state of iḥrām.
(أذى), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb أذي يأذى, of the class of فرح. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion): the yāʾ was converted into an alif because it came after a fatḥa; its origin is أذي with a vowelled yāʾ at its end. Its alif is deleted in pronunciation because of the tanwīn, since it is a noun ending in alif maqṣūra (ism maqṣūr). Its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(صدقة), a noun for what is given seeking reward; its pattern is فعلة, with two fatḥas.
(نسك), a heard maṣdar of the verb نسك ينسك, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with two ḍammas. There are other maṣdars of the verb: نسك with ḍamma, fatḥa or kasra on the nūn and sukūn on the sīn; نسوك with ḍamma on the nūn; نسكة with fatḥa then sukūn; and منسك on the measure مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn.
(يجد), it contains iʿlāl by deletion: its fāʾ (first radical) was deleted, since it is a mithāl (initial-weak) verb with kasra on the ʿayn in the imperfect. Its pattern is يعل, with kasra on the ʿayn.
(ثلاثة), see verse (7) of Sūrat al-Wāqiʿa.
(سبعة), see verse (23) of Sūrat al-Kahf.
(عشرة), a numeral noun, and it is the first of the decades. The shīn in it is given fatḥa because the thing counted is masculine, namely the days. Its plural is عشرات.
(كاملة), feminine of كامل, active participle from كمل يكمل, of the class of نصر, the class of كرم and the class of فرح; its pattern is فاعل.
(أهل), a collective noun (ism jamʿ) that has no singular from its own letters; it is pluralised as أهلين, assimilated to the sound masculine plural. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 105 of this sūra).
(حاضري), plural of حاضر, active participle from حضر يحضر, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فاعل.
(العقاب), a heard maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb عاقب; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. As for its regular maṣdar, it is المعاقبة.

* Rhetoric:
1- «تلك عشرة كاملة»: the reference is to the three and the seven.
So that the number is known in total just as it was known in detail, and it is thus grasped from two angles and the knowledge is confirmed. Among their proverbs is (two knowledges are better than one), especially as most of the Arabs were not good at arithmetic. So what befits the common address, by which both the elite and the common folk — who are people of natural disposition, not people trained in learning — understand, is that it proceed by repeating the speech and increasing comprehension, and announcing that what is meant by "the seven" is the number and not multitude, for it is used in both these senses.

* Benefits:
The jurists have much to say concerning His saying, Exalted is He: وَأَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ. We would like to cite it in brief; perhaps there is benefit in it for one who seeks benefit.
Al-Zamakhsharī says: i.e. perform them both complete and whole, with their rites and conditions, for the sake of Allah, without any slackness or deficiency occurring on your part in them.
a- It was said: completing them is that you enter iḥrām for them from your family's home.
b- It was said: that you devote a separate journey to each of them.
c- It was said: that you make them purely for worship and do not mix them with anything of trade and worldly aims.
d- The evidence has indicated that ʿumra is not obligatory: the Messenger of Allah was asked: Is ʿumra obligatory like the Hajj? He said: No, but that you perform ʿumra is better for you.

safi-cedvel:262-262.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ينفقون أموالهم في سبيل الله) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (ثمّ) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يتبعون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (أنفقوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أنفقوا) is in the position of an accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
(منا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (أذى) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (منّا), accusative like it, and the sign of the accusative is the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; (اللام) preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (أجر) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (عند) adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أجرهم; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of a genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative, without governing effect (muhmala) «[Note: Or governing like ليس, with (خوف) its noun and (عليهم) its khabar.]»; (خوف) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive by the preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted khabar «[Translator's note: so in the source — the closing parenthesis after على is missing and the description of (هم) is repeated.]»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يحزنون) imperfect verb, nominative..
The clause «الذين ينفقون.. «[Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source.]» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ينفقون أموالهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يتبعون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أنفقوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «لهم أجرهم» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause.
The clause «هم يحزنون» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(ينفقون): its origin is يؤنفقون; the hamza was dropped for lightness (see verse 3 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(يتبعون): its origin is يؤتبعون; the hamza was dropped for lightness.
(منّا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb منّ يمنّ, of the bāb نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أذى): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb أذي يأذى, of the bāb فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas (see verse 222).

* Rhetoric:
«ثُمَّ لا يُتْبِعُونَ»: ثم here is for the disparity in rank between spending and refraining from reproach and harm, and the distance between them in degree. It has been borrowed for that from its original meaning, which is distance in time — and this is the well-known view in such contexts. In al-Intiṣāf another aspect is mentioned, namely indicating the permanence of the verb conjoined by it and the extension of its continuance. On this view it does not depart from conveying distance in time; but its original meaning is the delay of the time of the verb's occurrence and coming about, while the meaning for which it is borrowed is the permanence of the verb's existence and the extension of the time of its continuance.

safi-cedvel:263-263.t:
* I'rab:
(قول) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: What permitted beginning with an indefinite noun is its being qualified.]»; (معروف) naʿt (adjective) of قول, nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (مغفرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to قول, nominative like it; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (من صدقة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خير); (يتبع) imperfect verb, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أذى) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (غنيّ) khabar, nominative; (حليم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قول معروف.. خير» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يتبعها أذى» is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt of صدقة.
The clause «الله غنيّ حليم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(غنيّ): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective); its pattern is فعيل, from غني يغني, of the bāb فرح.

safi-cedvel:264-264.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as badal (substitute) of أيّ; (آمنوا) past verb.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لا) prohibitive; (تبطلوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (صدقات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the kasra, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بالمنّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تبطلوا), and the bāʾ is causal; (الواو) conjunction; (الأذى) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to المنّ, genitive like it, and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra; (الكاف) preposition «[Note: Or a noun meaning مثل (like), in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "an invalidating like the invalidating of the one who spends ..."; or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in تبطلوا, i.e. "do not invalidate your charities, resembling the one who spends his wealth to be seen by people."]»; (الذي) a relative noun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the wāw in تبطلوا, i.e. "do not invalidate your charities, being losers like the one who spends his wealth to be seen by people.."]»; (ينفق) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he"; (مال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رئاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative «[Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "showing off"; or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its type, i.e. "he spends his wealth with a spending of showing off to people."]»; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يؤمن) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "he"; (بالله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمن); (الواو) conjunction; (اليوم) maʿṭūf to the Divine Name, genitive like it; (الآخر) naʿt of اليوم, genitive like it; (الفاء) causal; (مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (كمثل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (صفوان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (على) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (تراب) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أصاب) past verb, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (وابل) fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (تركه) like أصابه, and the fāʿil is "it", the downpour; (صلدا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لا) negative; (يقدرون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على شيء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقدرون); (من) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of شيء; (كسبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لا) negative; (يهدي) imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "He"; (القوم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الكافرين) naʿt of القوم, accusative like it, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يأيها الذين..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا تبطلوا» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «ينفق ماله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذي).
The clause «لا يؤمن ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the second ṣila clause.
The clause «مثله كمثل صفوان» has no grammatical position: resumptive and causal.
The clause «عليه تراب» is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt of صفوان.
The clause «أصابه وابل» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause عليه تراب.
The clause «تركه صلدا» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause أصابه وابل.
The clause «لا يقدرون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كسبوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «الله لا يهدي..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يهدي القوم..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Morphology:
(رئاء): the first hamza is the ʿayn of the word, because it is from رأى; the second is substituted for the yāʾ because it occurs at the end after an additional quiescent alif. It is a maṣdar annexed to its object. The first hamza may be lightened and changed into a yāʾ, i.e. رياء. Its pattern is فعال, a maṣdar of (راءى), [on the pattern] فاعل.
(صفوان): plural of صفوانة or of صفا; or it is a generic noun (ism jins); it is also said to be singular, its pattern being فعلان, with fatḥa on the fāʾ, which may also take kasra.
(وابل): active participle from وبل مطر السماء, i.e. the rain of the sky became heavy; its pattern is فاعل.
(صلدا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective); its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, from the bāb فرح or ضرب.

* Rhetoric:
- Allegorical simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): He likened the one who spends to show off, and his strange condition, to a smooth stone with a little dust on it, which is struck by a rain of heavy drops that leaves it smooth with no dust on it at all.

safi-cedvel:247-247.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (قال) a past verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (نبيّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (قد) a particle of realization; (بعث) like قال, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (لكم) like لهم, attached to (بعث); (طالوت) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and it is barred from nunation because it is a proper name and foreign; (ملكا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّى) an interrogative noun meaning كيف (how), indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الملك, its governor being يكون if it is complete, and the khabar (predicate) if it is defective; (يكون) an imperfect verb, nominative, complete — or defective —; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكون) if complete, or to the omitted khabar of يكون if defective; (الملك) the fāʿil of يكون, nominative — or the noun of يكون —; (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الملك [Note: Or attached to الملك in the sense of being over (istiʿlāʾ); you say: so-and-so is king over the tribe of so-and-so (al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ of Abū Ḥayyān).]; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (نحن) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative; (أحقّ) a khabar, nominative; (بالملك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحقّ; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to أحقّ; (الواو) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (to the past) and jussive; (يؤت) a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (سعة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من المال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سعة [Note: Abū Ḥayyān attached it to the verb (يؤت) and nothing else.]; (قال) like the first, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (إنّ الله اصطفاه عليكم) like إنّ الله بعث لكم.. and the hāʾ is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, in (اصطفاه); (الواو) a conjunction; (زاد) like قال, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (بسطة) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (في العلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of بسطة; (الجسم) conjoined to العلم by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الواو) resumptive or parenthetical; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يؤتي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (ملك) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (الواو) a conjunction; (الله واسع) a mubtadaʾ and a khabar, both nominative; (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قال لهم نبيهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an earlier resumptive clause.
The clause «إنّ الله قد بعث» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قد بعث..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أنّى يكون له الملك» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «نحن أحقّ بالملك» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لم يؤت سعة» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause نحن أحقّ ...
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الله اصطفاه» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «اصطفاه» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «زاده بسطة» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اصطفاه.
The clause «الله يؤتي..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical.
The clause «يؤتي ملكه» is in the position of the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «الله واسع» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الله يؤتي.

* Morphology:
(طالوت): it is said to be a nickname of Saul (Shāwul) son of Kish (Qays), of the descendants of Benjamin, so nicknamed for his height (ṭūl), for he was the tallest of the people of his time; but the truth is that it is a foreign name and not derived.
(يؤت): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because of the jussive; its pattern is يفع with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(سعة): it contains iʿlāl by deletion: its first radical was deleted; its original form is وسعة, and that is by analogy with its deletion in the imperfect. Its pattern is علة with fatḥa on the ʿayn, which may also take kasra. Its verb is of the category وثق; therefore the wāw was deleted, and the fatḥa appeared on the ʿayn of the word in place of the kasra because the final radical of the word is a guttural letter, namely the ʿayn, and the maṣdar came with fatḥa on the ʿayn of the word.
(اصطفاه): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution) of the tāʾ — the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form — into ṭāʾ because it comes after the ṣād (see ayah 132).
(بسطة): maṣdar of بسط يبسط (category نصر), or a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the verb تبسّط or انبسط; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(العلم): maṣdar of علم يعلم (category فرح); its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn (see ayah 32).
(الجسم): a non-derived noun for the body; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn. [Translator's note: so in the source; الجسم is normally vocalized with ḍamma on the jīm.]
(يشاء): it contains iʿlāl by conversion (qalb); its original form is يشيأ with sukūn (on the shīn) and fatḥa on the yāʾ; then the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the shīn, then the yāʾ was converted into an alif because it came quiescent after a fatḥa.

safi-cedvel:248-248.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (قال لهم نبيّهم) its i'rab was given in the preceding ayah; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (آية) the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (ملك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يأتي) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of accusative; (التابوت) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (سكينة) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سكينة, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (بقيّة) conjoined to سكينة, nominative like it; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of بقيّة; (ترك) a past verb; (آل) fāʿil, nominative; (موسى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (ال) [Translator's note: i.e. آل] conjoined to the first, nominative like it; (هارون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote, like موسى, because it is a proper name and foreign; (تحمل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الملائكة) fāʿil, nominative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (في) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إنّ, and (الكاف) for address; (اللام) for emphasis; (آية) the delayed noun of إنّ, accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of آية; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) the noun of كان, in the position of nominative; (مؤمنين) the khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال لهم نبيّهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an earlier resumptive clause.
The clause «إنّ آية ملكه ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتيكم التابوت) is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يأتيكم التابوت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «فيه سكينة» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of التابوت.
The clause «ترك آل موسى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تحمله الملائكة» is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl of التابوت.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. if you are believers, then accept Ṭālūt as king.

* Morphology:
(التابوت): the tāʾ in it is a root letter; its pattern is فاعول, and its derivation is not known [Note: It is established in the Ṣaḥīḥ that Zayd ibn Thābit wanted to write (التابوت) with hāʾ, according to the dialect of the Anṣār, but the Companions prevented him from that and referred it to ʿUthmān, may Allah be pleased with him, who ordered them to write it with tāʾ, according to the dialect of Quraysh (Shudhūr al-Dhahab).].
(سكينة): a maṣdar, or a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar), of the verb تسكّن meaning "to be at ease"; its pattern is فعيلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(بقيّة): a noun for what remains of a thing; its pattern is فعيلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(مؤمنين): plural of مؤمن, an active participle from آمن; in it the hamza was deleted for lightening; its original form is مؤأمن, with ḍamma on the mīm, fatḥa on the first hamza and sukūn on the second; and the deletion in the imperfect is likewise (and see ayah 8) of this sūra.
(هارون): a foreign name; al-Muḥīṭ mentions it, saying: a name; and it seems its pattern is فاعول, because it is mentioned under the root هرن.

safi-cedvel:249-249.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive or a conjunction; (لمّا) temporal (ḥīniyya), containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (فصل) a past verb; (طالوت) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (بالجنود) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فصل), by making it include the meaning of سار (set out) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of طالوت, i.e. accompanied by the troops.]; (قال) like فصل, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (مبتلي) the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بنهر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مبتليكم; (الفاء) a conjunction; (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شرب) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شرب); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ليس) a defective, inflexible (jāmid) past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to من; (منّي) like منه, attached to the omitted khabar of ليس; (الواو) a conjunction; (من) like the first; (لم) a particle of negation [Note: The majority hold that (لم) is negating and jussive-governing, and the verb after it is jussive by it, since it is the chief of the jussive-governing particles; but it is better to limit its effect to negation, and that the verb after it be jussive by (من), since it is the protasis (see al-Naḥw al-Wāfī).]; (يطعم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (إنّ) like the first, and (الهاء) a pronoun, the noun of إنّ; (منّي) like منه, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the excepted; (اغترف) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun; (غرفة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: In one reading (غرفة) with fatḥa on the ghayn; it is a maṣdar of single instance, accusative as a maṣdar, and the object is omitted, its implied form being "ماء" (water).]; (بيد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اغترف), or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غرفة, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.. (الفاء) resumptive; (شربوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (منه) like the first, attached to (شربوا); (إلّا) a particle of exception; (قليلا) excepted by (إلّا), accusative [Note: It is originally a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. except a small portion of them.]; (منهم) like منه, attached to an omitted naʿt of (قليلا), and it is a qualification of قليل. (الفاء) resumptive; (لمّا جاوز) like لمّا فصل, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, a tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil of جاوز, coming so that the conjunction is valid; (الواو) a conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, conjoined to the agent pronoun of the verb جاوز; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (مع) an adverb of place, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), accusative, attached to (آمنوا), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) like شربوا; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (طاقة) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the overt fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of lā [Note: It may not be attached to طاقة, otherwise it would have come with nunation.]; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the notion of "being established" to which لنا is attached; (بجالوت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the notion of "being established" to which لنا is attached, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, for it is a diptote because it is a proper name and foreign; and there is an omitted muḍāf in it, i.e. بقتال جالوت (to fight Goliath); (الواو) a conjunction; (جنود) conjoined to جالوت, genitive (majrūr) like it, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (قال) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (يظنّون) an imperfect verb, nominative. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ; (ملاقو) the khabar of أنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم ملاقو الله) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يظنّون.
(كم) declarative (khabariyya), an allusive term for number, an indeclinable noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (من فئة) a preposition and its genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of كم; (قليلة) a naʿt of فئة, genitive like it; (غلب) a past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (فئة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كثيرة) a naʿt of the second فئة, accusative; (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (غلبت) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of غلبت.]; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) a conjunction or resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (مع) like the preceding, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الصابرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «فصل طالوت» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ الله مبتليكم» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «من شرب» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object of saying.
The clause «شرب منه» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.].
The clause «ليس» منّي is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من لم يطعمه» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause من شرب ...
The clause «لم يطعمه» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «إنّه منّي» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the second condition.
The clause «اغترف ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «شربوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «جاوزه» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا طاقة لنا» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «قال الذين يظنّون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يظنّون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «كم من فئة..» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «غلبت فئة» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كم).
The clause «الله مع الصابرين» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause كم من فئة ..., or has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(جنود): plural of جنديّ, a noun for one who works in the army; it is originally a derived adjective on the pattern فعليّ with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn. [Translator's note: so in the source; جنود is usually given as the plural of جند.]
(مبتليكم): an active participle from the five-letter verb ابتلى, meaning "to test"; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(نهر): its hāʾ may take fatḥa or sukūn; its plural is أنهر, أنهار, نهر with two ḍammas, and نهور with ḍamma on the nūn.
(غرفة): a noun meaning "that which is scooped"; its plural is غراف with kasra on the ghayn; likewise الغرافة, with ḍamma on the ghayn, means الغرفة.
(جالوت): on the pattern of طالوت, a foreign word, not one of the derivations of Arabic [Note: In al-Muḥīṭ: جالوت is foreign.].
(ملاقو): plural of ملاق, an active participle from لاقى, on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving kasra to the letter before the last (see ayah 46 of this sūra).
(فئة): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning "a group", with no singular from its own root-form. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is فئية or فئوة, because its maṣdar is فأى or فأو; then its final radical — the weak letter — was deleted for lightening, as it was deleted from أخ and أب.. and أمة; its pattern is فعة.
(قليلة): a ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from the intransitive قلّ, so it is of the second category, the category ضرب (and see ayah 246).
(كثيرة): feminine of كثير, a ṣifa mushabbaha from the intransitive كثر, on the pattern فعيل, of the category كرم (see ayah 26).
(الصبرين): plural of الصابر, an active participle from صبر; its pattern is فاعل (and see ayah 153).

safi-cedvel:221-221.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تنكحوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (المشركات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition [Translator's note: the source has the typo «عرف» for «حرف».]; (يؤمنّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by (أن) implied after حتّى, and the nūn is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنّ) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by (حتّى), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تنكحوا).
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the inceptive (lām al-ibtidāʾ), conveying emphasis; (أمة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (مؤمنة) naʿt (adjective) of أمة, nominative like it; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (من مشركة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (أعجب) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي" (she); (الواو) conjunction; (لا تنكحوا المشركين حتّى يؤمنوا) like the i'rab of its counterpart that came before; (الواو) resumptive; (لعبد مؤمن خير من مشرك ولو أعجبكم) like the i'rab of its counterpart that came before; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (يدعون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلى النار) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعون); (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يدعو) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (إلى الجنّة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعو); (الواو) conjunction; (المغفرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الجنّة, genitive like it; (بإذن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعو), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يبيّن) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (آيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (للناس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبيّن); (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (يتذكّرون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لا تنكحوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يؤمنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «أمة.» خير has no grammatical position, being resumptive or causal [Note: A causal explanation for the prohibition of marrying polytheist women.].
The clause «أعجبتكم» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "even if the polytheist woman pleased you, the believing woman is better".
The clause «عبد.. خير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or causal.
The clause «أعجبكم» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "even if the polytheist man pleased you, the believing man is better".
The clause «لا تنكحوا المشركين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تنكحوا المشركات.
The clause «يؤمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «أولئك يدعون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يدعون إلى النار» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «الله يدعو..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أولئك يدعون.
The clause «يدعو إلى الجنّة» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يبيّن آياته» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يدعو إلى الجنّة.
The clause «لعلّهم يتذكّرون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتذكّرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(المشركات): plural of المشركة, the feminine of المشرك, an active participle from the quadriliteral أشرك; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(أمة): a noun for a female servant or a female owned (slave); an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb أمت الجارية تأمو, of the pattern (bāb) نصر, أميت تأمى, of the pattern فرح, and أمت تأمي, of the pattern ضرب.
It contains a change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original is أموة, because its plural is إماء, whose original is إما and أموات [Translator's note: so in the source; the wording here appears garbled — the plurals of أمة include إماء and أَمَوات.]; its wazn is فعة.
(مؤمنة): feminine of مؤمن.. see ayah (8) of this sūra.
(مشركة): feminine of مشرك. See ayah (105) of this sūra.
(يدعون): it contains an iʿlāl by deletion; its original is يدعوون with ḍamma on the first wāw: the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the ʿayn before it, so two quiescent letters met, and the first wāw was dropped to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters; its wazn is يفعون.
(إذنه): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb أذن يأذن, of the pattern فرح; its wazn is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymic trope (majāz mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِ».
What is meant by forgiveness here is repentance, so the relationship here is that of being caused (musabbabiyya), because forgiveness is caused by repentance.

* Benefits:
1- The lām has many divisions and meanings, and altogether they go back to two divisions: operative and non-operative. The operative: genitive-governing and jussive-governing. The non-operative are eight:
«the lām of the inceptive (ibtidāʾ), the lām of distance, the lām of wonder, the lām of the answer, the redundant (zāʾida) lām, the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa), the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the lām that prepares for the oath (al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam).
The lām in this ayah is the lām of the inceptive, which conveys emphasis of the content of the clause — and restricts the imperfect to the present; it enters only on the noun, as in «لَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً», or on the imperfect verb, as in «ليحب الله المحسنين» [Translator's note: so in the source; this wording is not found in the Qur'an, which has «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ».], and it enters on the non-inflecting verb, as in «لَبِئْسَ ما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ». Among the lām of the inceptive is «the shifted lām» (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and we may treat it fully in another place in this book.

safi-cedvel:222-222.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (يسألونك عن المحيض) like يسألونك عن الشهر [Note: In ayah (217) of this sūra.]; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أذى) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (اعتزلوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (النساء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (في المحيض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of النساء [Note: Or attached to (اعتزلوا).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تقربوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يطهرن) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by (أن) implied after حتّى, and the nūn is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يطهرن) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by (حتّى), attached to (تقربوهنّ).
(الفاء) resumptive; (إذا) an adverb of future time, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis, i.e. "then come to them"; (تطهّرن) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; a past verb has no such position here — perhaps "the nūn is in the position of nominative" was meant.].. and (النون) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (ائتوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هنّ) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من) preposition; (حيث) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (ائتوهنّ); (أمر) past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (يحبّ) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (التوّابين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunction; (يحبّ المتطهرين) like its counterpart يحبّ التوّابين.
The clause «يسألونك عن المحيض» is conjoined to the clause يسألونك عن الشهر [Note: In ayah (217) of this sūra.].
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هو أذى» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعتزلوا النساء» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if it is so, then keep away".
The clause «لا تقربوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اعتزلوا النساء.
The clause «يطهرن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تطهّرن» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ائتوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أمركم الله» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّ الله يحبّ» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) [Note: In the opinion of Ibn Hishām and others, the clause is parenthetical between فأتوهنّ.. and نساؤكم حرث لكم, because the second is an explanation of the first.].
The clause «يحبّ التوّابين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يحبّ المتطهّرين» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يحبّ التوّابين.

* Morphology:
(المحيض): a mīm-maṣdar meaning الحيض (menstruation), suitable for the event, the time and the place; it contains a change (iʿlāl) by making a letter quiescent, in that the kasra of the yāʾ was transferred to the ḥāʾ before it.
(أذى): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) whose verb is أذي, of the pattern (bāb) فرح; it contains an iʿlāl: its original is أذيا; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif.
(فأتوهنّ): it contains the deletion of the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl); its original is ائتوهنّ, and when the fāʾ was attached to it the connecting hamza was dropped and the hamza after it was written on an alif.
(التوّابين): plural of التوّاب, an intensive form of the active participle; its wazn is فعّال (see ayah 37 of this sūra).
(المتطهّرين): plural of المتطهّر, active participle from تطهّر; its wazn is متفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:265-265.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (مثل الذين ينفقون أموالهم) its i'rab has been given «[Note: In verse (261) of this sūra.]»; (ابتغاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) «[Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "seeking".]», accusative (manṣūb); (مرضاة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (تثبيتا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (ابتغاء), accusative like it; (من أنفس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective), i.e. "a strengthening coming from themselves" «[Note: It may be attached to the maṣdar تثبيت, with من in that case being partitive. Abū Ḥayyān said: whoever gives his wealth for the sake of Allah has strengthened part of himself, and whoever gives his wealth and his life together is the one who has strengthened all of it. Scholars have explained التثبيت with various meanings: certainty, seeking reward (iḥtisāb), affirmation, acknowledgement, resolve, carrying through.. etc.]», and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كمثل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) مثل; (جنة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (بربوة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ربوة «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "a naʿt of جنة" is meant.]»; (أصاب) past verb, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (وابل) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) conjunction; (آتت) like أصاب.. and (التاء) for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "it" (feminine); (أكل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ضعفين) ḥāl, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being "صاحبها" (its owner); (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (لم) a particle of negation «[Note: It is better that the verb (يصبها) be governed by (إنّ) «[Translator's note: so in the source, apparently for إن.]», not by (لم).]»; (يصب) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (وابل) fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (طلّ) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "مصيبها" (what strikes it).. or "الذي يصيبها".. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الباء) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to (بصير), with the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) omitted «[Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar-forming particle, with the interpreted maṣdar in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ..
attached to (بصير).]»; (تعلمون) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads تعملون, as in the clause list below.]» imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بصير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «مثل الذين ينفقون..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to a previous resumption.
The clause «ينفقون أموالهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أصابها وابل» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of جنّة, since it is qualified, or in the position of a genitive as a naʿt of جنّة.
The clause «آتت ...» is conjoined to the clause أصابها وابل, in the position of an accusative or a genitive.
The clause «إن لم يصبها وابل» is conjoined to the clause أصابها, in the position of an accusative or a genitive «[Note: The clause may be cut off as a resumption, so that it has no grammatical position.]».
The clause «(مصيبها) طلّ» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «الله ... بصير» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما), whether nominal or maṣdar-forming.

* Morphology:
(تثبيتا): maṣdar of the four-letter verb ثبّت, so it is regular (qiyāsī); its pattern is تفعيل.
(ربوة): the rāʾ may take ḍamma, fatḥa or kasra; it is a non-derived (jāmid) noun, and its pattern here is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(أكل): a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with two ḍammas, and its ʿayn may take sukūn.
(ضعفين): dual of ضعف, which is a derived adjective from ضعف يضعف, of the bāb فتح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra on the fāʾ (verse 245).
(طلّ): a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Allegorical simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): He likened those who spend their wealth, free of showing off, in pursuit of Allah's pleasure, to a garden situated on a high place which is struck by heavy rain, so that it bears twice what it bore at other times because of the downpour that struck it.

safi-cedvel:266-266.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation, containing the sense of making [something] remote, close to negation; (يودّ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (أحد) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تكون) incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of تكون, fronted; (جنّة) the noun of تكون, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by يودّ.
(من نخيل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جنّة; (الواو) conjunction; (أعناب) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to نخيل, genitive like it; (تجري) imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; (من تحت) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, and it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "flowing from beneath its trees"; (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative; (له) like the first, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (في) preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted khabar «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied mubtadaʾ (subject) — an adjective placed before what it qualifies.]»; (من كلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "he has in it fruit — or provision — of all the fruits"; (الثمرات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya), with قد implied; (أصاب) past verb, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (الكبر) fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) circumstantial; (له) like the first, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ذرّيّة) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (ضعفاء) naʿt of ذريّة, nominative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (أصابها) like أصابه; (إعصار) fāʿil, nominative; (فيه) like فيها, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (نار) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (احترق) past verb, and (التاء) for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "it" (feminine). (الكاف) a preposition of comparison; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by يبيّن; (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (يبيّن) imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Divine Name, fāʿil, nominative; (لكم) like له, attached to (يبيّن); (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of an accusative as the noun of لعلّ; (تتفكرون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يودّ أحدكم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تكون له جنّة» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl «[Note: Or in the position of a nominative as a naʿt of جنّة.]» of جنّة, since it has been qualified.
The clause «له فيها من كلّ الثمرات» is in the position of an accusative as a second ḥāl of جنّة «[Note: Or in the position of a nominative as another naʿt of جنّة.]».
The clause «أصابه الكبر» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (له) فيها..
The clause «له ذريّة» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in أصابه.
The clause «أصابها إعصار» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause تجري.
The clause «فيه نار» is in the position of a nominative as a naʿt of إعصار.
The clause «احترقت» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause أصابها إعصار. The clause «يبيّن الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تتفكّرون» has no grammatical position: causal.
The clause «تتفكّرون» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(نخيل): it may be a generic noun (ism jins) whose singular is نخلة, or it is the plural of أنخل, which is a generic noun; a non-derived (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعيل.
(أعناب): plural of عنب, which is a generic noun whose singular is عنبة; the pattern of أعناب is أفعال.
(الكبر): maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb كبر يكبر, of the bāb فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(ذرّيّة): the following appears in Lisān al-ʿArab: "ذرّ الله الخلق في الأرض: He spread them. الذرّيّة is فعليّة — with ḍamma on the fāʾ — from it, and it is a relational form (nisba) of الذرّ, which is small ants. By analogy it should have been ذريّة — with fatḥa on the dhāl — but it is an irregular nisba that has only come with ḍamma on the first letter.. The readers agreed on omitting the hamza in الذريّة. Yūnus said: the people of Mecca differ from the other Arabs and pronounce النبيّ, البريّة and الذرّيّة with hamza, from ذرأ الله الخلق, i.e. He created them. Abū Isḥāq the grammarian said: الذريّة is without hamza.. Some grammarians said: its origin is ذرّورة, which is فعلولة, but when the doubling became frequent, the last rāʾ was replaced by a yāʾ, so it became ذرّوية — with the rāʾ doubled — then the wāw was assimilated into the yāʾ, so it became ذرّيّة. He said: the view of those who say it is فعليّة — with ḍamma on the fāʾ — is more regular and better according to the grammarians ... الذريّة: a noun comprising a person's offspring, male and female. Its origin has a hamza, but they dropped it and use it only without hamza. It is also said that its origin is from الذرّ in the sense of scattering, because Allah the Exalted scattered them in the earth." End quote. Al-ʿUkbarī said ... that it is from ذرأ with hamza, so on this view its origin is ذروءة, on the measure فعولة; then the hamza was replaced by a yāʾ, and the wāw was replaced by a yāʾ, to escape the heaviness of the hamza, the wāw and the ḍamma. (See verse 124 of this sūra.)
(ضعفاء): plural of ضعيف, which is a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from the verb ضعف يضعف, of the bāb نصر and the bāb كرم; its pattern is فعيل.
(إعصار): a non-derived noun meaning a violent wind. It was so called because it twists as a wrung garment twists, or because it wrings the clouds. The word الإعصار is masculine.

* Rhetoric:
1- «أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ»: the hamza is for denying the occurrence, as when you say "Would you strike your father?"
However, the object of the denial is not everything the wishing relates to; rather it is only the striking of the whirlwind and the burning that follows it.
2- «لَهُ فِيها مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَراتِ»: this is mentioning the general after the specific for completion (tatmīm), and tatmīm is one of the devices of rhetoric.

safi-cedvel:223-223.t:
* I'rab:
(نساء) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (حرث) khabar (predicate), nominative, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "possessors of tilth"; (اللام) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حرث; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (ائتوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (حرث) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (أنّى) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the sukūn, not containing the meaning of condition, attached to (ائتوا) [Note: أنّى may mean "how", or "where", or "when", in which case it indicates an adverb of time in the ayah. Abū Ḥayyān does not strip it of the conditional meaning in the ayah, so it is attached to the content of the implied apodosis, i.e.: "however you wish, come to your tilth".]; (شئتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (قدّموا) like ائتوا; (لأنفس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدّموا), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like ائتوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) resumptive; (اعلموا) like ائتوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna; (ملاقو) the khabar of anna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (بشر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «نساؤكم حرث» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: Or it is explicative of the clause ائتوهن in the previous ayah.].
The clause «فأتوا» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you desire them, then come"..
The clause «قدّموا» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause ائتوا.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause ائتوا.
The clause «اعلموا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar is in the position of accusative, taking the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «بشّر المؤمنين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اعلموا.

* Morphology:
(حرث): a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning sowing, i.e. the sowing of offspring; the khabar was made singular because it is a maṣdar, and it has the meaning of the passive participle, i.e. "things tilled" (see ayah 205 of this sūra).
(ملاقوه): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original is ملاقيوه with ḍamma on the yāʾ: its vowel was transferred to the qāf for lightening, so two quiescent letters met and the yāʾ was dropped, and it became ملاقوه; its wazn is مفاعوه (see ayah 46 of this sūra).

* Rhetoric:
1- «نِساؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ», i.e. places of tilth for you; they are likened to them because of the resemblance between what is cast into their wombs and seeds, in that each of them is the material for what comes from it.
This is an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh).
2- «فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ», i.e. what is like tilth; in it there is an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya).

* Benefits:
1- «أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ»: the lexicon gives four meanings for the word «أنّى»: it comes in the sense of «from where», as in «أنّى لك هذا», i.e. "from where do you have this?", and it comes in the sense of «how», as in «أنّى شئتم», so it means "however you wish", "whenever you wish" and "wherever you wish".
2- The Muslims kept away from their women, acting on the apparent sense of the ayah, and put them out of the houses. When that reached the Messenger of Allah, he said: I only commanded you to refrain from intercourse with them; you were not commanded to put them out of the houses, as the non-Arabs do.

safi-cedvel:224-224.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تجعلوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عرضة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (لأيمان) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرضه; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تبرّوا) imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (تتقّوا) like تبرّوا [Note: The verb may be taken as affirmative, i.e. "do not swear by Allah much, even though you are righteous, God-conscious and making peace", and the verb may be taken as negated, i.e. "do not swear by Allah that you will not be righteous, nor be God-conscious, nor make peace ..."].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبرّوا) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of (ايمان) or a badal (substitute) of it [Note: Because righteousness, God-consciousness and making peace are the subject matter of the oaths and their outcome, i.e. swearing not to undertake righteousness and God-consciousness. The interpreted maṣdar may also be in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "in that you be righteous..", attached to (عرضة).] ... and likewise أن تتّقوا and أن تصلحوا ...
(الواو) conjunction; (تصلحوا) like تبرّوا; (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تصلحوا); (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (سميع) khabar (predicate), nominative; (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لا تجعلوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تبرّوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تبرّوا.
The clause «تصلحوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تبرّوا.
The clause «الله سميع» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(عرضة): it may mean العارض, i.e. the barrier, or المعروض (what is set up), like القبضة and الغرفة meaning المقبوض (what is grasped) and المغروف (what is scooped); it is the thing that is set across and set up.
(أيمان): plural of يمين, a maṣdar meaning oath, or a noun meaning oath; its wazn is فعيل, and its plural is أفعال.

safi-cedvel:225-225.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) negative; (يؤاخذ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (باللغو) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤاخذ); (في أيمان) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of اللغو, or to the maṣdar اللغو, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect; (يؤاخذكم) like the first, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (الباء) preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (يؤاخذكم) [Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to (يؤاخذكم).]; (كسب) past verb; (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine; (قلوب) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (الله غفور حليم) like الله سميع عليم [Note: In the previous ayah.].
The clause «لا يؤاخذكم الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يؤاخذكم (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «كسبت قلوبكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «الله غفور» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(اللغو): maṣdar (verbal noun) of لغا يلغو; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(حليم): an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حلم يحلم, of the pattern (bāb) كرم; its wazn is فعيل.

* Benefits:
And لكن: its meaning is rectification (istidrāk), and rectification with it comes only after negation. It is one of the sisters of «إنّ», and its rulings are the same as its rulings. When it is lightened it is necessarily made inoperative. It is also made inoperative when the redundant «ما», which is the restraining (kāffa) one, is attached to it, as in the saying of Imruʾ al-Qays:
ولكنما أسعى لمجد مؤثل ... وقد يدرك المجد المؤثل أمثالي.
(But I strive only for deep-rooted glory, and the likes of me may attain deep-rooted glory.)

safi-cedvel:226-226.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (يؤلون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من نساء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of يؤولون, i.e. "keeping away from their women", and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (تربّص) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (أربعة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أشهر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) conjunction; (إنّ) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive [Translator's note: so in the source; the conditional particle is إن, without shadda.]; (فاءوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (غفور) the khabar of inna, nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يؤلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «للذين.. تربّص» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «فاءوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «إن الله غفور» is a causal explanation for the omitted apodosis, i.e.: "if they return, Allah will forgive them, because Allah is Forgiving ...".

* Morphology:
